<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Super Mario Bros</title>
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
body{background:#111;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;height:100vh;overflow:hidden}
canvas{image-rendering:pixelated;image-rendering:crisp-edges;border:2px solid #333}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
const C=document.getElementById('c'),X=C.getContext('2d');
C.width=800;C.height=500;

const T=32,G=0.55,MAXF=12,JF=-11.5,ACC=0.45,FRIC=0.82,MSPD=4.5;
const SKY=0,GROUND=1,BRICK=2,QB=3,PIPE=4,USED=5,EMPTY=6;

let state='title',score=0,lives=3,coins=0,tmr=300,frame=0,dt=0,dTimer=0,lcTimer=0;
let P={x:80,y:0,vx:0,vy:0,w:24,h:30,gnd:false,dir:1,big:false,inv:0,af:0,dead:false};
let tiles=[],bricks=[],qbs=[],pipesArr=[],coinsArr=[],enemies=[],plats=[];
let parts=[],floats=[];
let cam={x:0},flag={x:0,y:0,h:0,reached:false},ldComplete=false;
let keys={},kMap={ArrowLeft:'left',ArrowRight:'right',ArrowUp:'up',ArrowDown:'down',
  KeyA:'left',KeyD:'right',KeyW:'up',KeyS:'down',Space:'jump',KeyZ:'jump',KeyX:'jump'};

document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[kMap[e.code]||e.code]=true;
  if(['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Space'].includes(e.code))e.preventDefault()});
document.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[kMap[e.code]||e.code]=false});

let aC;
function initA(){if(!aC)aC=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)()}
function tone(f,d,t='square',v=0.06){if(!aC)return;try{let o=aC.createOscillator(),g=aC.createGain();
  o.type=t;o.frequency.value=f;g.gain.value=v;g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001,aC.currentTime+d);
  o.connect(g);g.connect(aC.destination);o.start();o.stop(aC.currentTime+d)}catch(e){}}
function sfxJump(){tone(400,0.1);setTimeout(()=>tone(600,0.08),30)}
function sfxCoin(){tone(988,0.07,'square',0.05);setTimeout(()=>tone(1319,0.15,'square',0.05),70)}
function sfxBump(){tone(200,0.08,'triangle',0.08)}
function sfxStomp(){tone(150,0.12,'sawtooth',0.06)}
function sfxPwr(){for(let i=0;i<6;i++)setTimeout(()=>tone(400+i*100,0.06),i*40)}
function sfxDie(){tone(400,0.15,'triangle',0.07);setTimeout(()=>tone(200,0.3,'triangle',0.07),150)}
function sfxBreak(){tone(100,0.1,'sawtooth',0.06);tone(80,0.15,'sawtooth',0.04)}

function buildLevel(){
  tiles=[];bricks=[];qbs=[];pipesArr=[];coinsArr=[];enemies=[];plats=[];parts=[];floats=[];
  ldComplete=false;flag.reached=false;
  for(let x=0;x<=220;x++)tiles[x]=[];
  for(let x=0;x<=220;x++)for(let y=0;y<16;y++)tiles[x][y]=EMPTY;
  for(let x=0;x<=220;x++){tiles[x][14]=GROUND;tiles[x][15]=GROUND}
  for(let x=22;x<=28;x++)for(let y=12;y<=13;y++)tiles[x][y]=EMPTY;
  for(let x=39;x<=42;x++)for(let y=12;y<=13;y++)tiles[x][y]=EMPTY;
  for(let x=58;x<=61;x++)for(let y=12;y<=13;y++)tiles[x][y]=EMPTY;
  for(let x=80;x<=84;x++)for(let y=12;y<=13;y++)tiles[x][y]=EMPTY;

  [[8,10],[22,10],[24,10],[25,6],[26,10],[27,10],[30,10],[33,6],
   [38,10],[39,10],[40,10],[41,10],[44,10],[45,10],[46,10],[47,10],
   [50,10],[51,10],[52,10],[55,6],[56,6],[57,6],[58,10],[59,10],[60,10],
   [64,10],[65,10],[66,10],[67,10],[70,6],[71,6],[72,6],
   [78,10],[79,10],[80,10],[81,10],[82,10],[83,10],[84,10],[85,10]
  ].forEach(([x,y])=>{tiles[x][y]=QB;qbs.push({x,y,bt:0})});

  [[16,10],[17,10],[18,10],[19,10],[20,10],[21,10],
   [23,10],[28,10],[29,10],[31,10],[32,10],[34,10],[35,10],[36,10],[37,10],
   [42,10],[43,10],[48,10],[49,10],[53,10],[54,10],[61,10],[62,10],[63,10],
   [68,10],[69,10],[73,10],[74,10],[75,10],[76,10],[77,10],[86,10],[87,10]
  ].forEach(([x,y])=>{tiles[x][y]=BRICK;bricks.push({x,y})});

  for(let s=0;s<5;s++)for(let dx=0;dx<2;dx++)for(let dy=0;dy<=s;dy++)
    tiles[100+s*2+dx][13-dy]=BRICK;

  [[15,11],[16,11],[24,11],[30,11],[38,11],[45,11],[50,11],
   [55,7],[56,7],[57,7],[70,7],[71,7],[72,7],[75,11],[76,11]
  ].forEach(([x,y])=>coinsArr.push({x:x*T+10,y:y*T+8,got:false}));

  [[11,11],[21,11],[31,11],[41,11],[51,11],[61,11],[71,11],[76,11]
  ].forEach(([x,y])=>coinsArr.push({x:x*T+10,y:y*T+8,got:false}));

  pipesArr=[{x:14,y:12,w:2,h:2},{x:35,y:11,w:2,h:3},{x:55,y:12,w:2,h:2},{x:78,y:11,w:2,h:3}];
  flag.x=150;flag.y=6;flag.h=8;
  enemies=[
    {x:18*T,y:13*T,vx:-1,vy:0,w:26,h:26,type:'g',alive:true,af:0,shell:false,sm:0},
    {x:32*T,y:13*T,vx:-1,vy:0,w:26,h:26,type:'g',alive:true,af:0,shell:false,sm:0},
    {x:44*T,y:13*T,vx:-1,vy:0,w:26,h:26,type:'g',alive:true,af:0,shell:false,sm:0},
    {x:52*T,y:13*T,vx:-1,vy:0,w:26,h:26,type:'g',alive:true,af:0,shell:false,sm:0},
    {x:54*T,y:13*T,vx:-1,vy:0,w:26,h:26,type:'g',alive:true,af:0,shell:false,sm:0},
    {x:65*T,y:13*T,vx:-1,vy:0,w:26,h:26,type:'k',alive:true,af:0,shell:false,sm:0},
    {x:74*T,y:13*T,vx:-1,vy:0,w:26,h:26,type:'g',alive:true,af:0,shell:false,sm:0},
    {x:76*T,y:13*T,vx:-1,vy:0,w:26,h:26,type:'g',alive:true,af:0,shell:false,sm:0},
    {x:82*T,y:13*T,vx:-1,vy:0,w:26,h:26,type:'k',alive:true,af:0,shell:false,sm:0},
    {x:88*T,y:13*T,vx:-1,vy:0,w:26,h:26,type:'g',alive:true,af:0,shell:false,sm:0}
  ];
}

function initGame(){score=0;lives=3;coins=0;tmr=300;P.big=false;P.inv=0;buildLevel();spawnP()}
function spawnP(){P.x=80;P.y=12*T;P.vx=0;P.vy=0;P.gnd=false;P.dir=1;P.af=0;P.dead=false;P.inv=120;cam.x=0}
function gTile(x,y){let c=Math.floor(x/T),r=Math.floor(y/T);if(c<0||c>=tiles.length||r<0||r>=16)return EMPTY;return tiles[c][r]||EMPTY}
function solid(x,y){let t=gTile(x,y);return t===GROUND||t===BRICK||t===QB||t===USED||t===PIPE}

function addPart(x,y,vx,vy,col,sz,life){parts.push({x,y,vx,vy,col,sz,life,ml:life})}
function addFloat(x,y,txt,col='#fff'){floats.push({x,y,txt,col,life:50})}

function update(){
  frame++;
  if(state==='playing')updatePlay();
  else if(state==='dead'){dTimer++;if(dTimer>120){lives<=0?state='gameover':state='playing';spawnP()}}
  else if(state==='levelcomplete'){lcTimer++;if(lcTimer>180)state='levelclear'}
}

function updatePlay(){
  if(P.dead)return;
  if(flag.reached){
    if(P.y<13*T){P.y+=3;P.af++}else{state='levelcomplete';lcTimer=0}return;
  }
  let ml=keys.left,mr=keys.right,mu=keys.up,jk=keys.jump;
  if(ml){P.vx-=ACC;P.dir=-1}if(mr){P.vx+=ACC;P.dir=1}
  if(!ml&&!mr)P.vx*=FRIC;
  P.vx=Math.max(-MSPD,Math.min(MSPD,P.vx));
  if(Math.abs(P.vx)<0.1)P.vx=0;
  if(jk&&P.gnd){P.vy=JF;P.gnd=false;sfxJump()}
  if(!jk&&P.vy<-3)P.vy*=0.85;
  P.vy=Math.min(P.vy+G,MAXF);

  P.x+=P.vx;
  if(P.x<0)P.x=0;
  let L=P.x,R=P.x+P.w;
  if(solid(L,P.y+2)||solid(L,P.y+P.h-2)){P.x=Math.ceil(L/T)*T;P.vx=0}
  if(solid(R-1,P.y+2)||solid(R-1,P.y+P.h-2)){P.x=Math.floor((R-1)/T)*T-P.w;P.vx=0}

  P.y+=P.vy;P.gnd=false;
  if(P.vy>=0){let bY=P.y+P.h;
    for(let c=Math.floor(P.x/T);c<=Math.floor((P.x+P.w-1)/T);c++)
      if(solid(c*T,bY)&&bY-P.vy<=c*T){P.y=c*T-P.h;P.vy=0;P.gnd=true}}
  else{let tY=P.y;
    for(let c=Math.floor(P.x/T);c<=Math.floor((P.x+P.w-1)/T);c++)
      if(solid(c*T,tY)&&tY-P.vy>=(c+1)*T){P.y=(c+1)*T;P.vy=0}}

  if(P.gnd){if(ml||mr)P.af+=Math.abs(P.vx)>2.5?0.2:0.12;else P.af=0}

  if(P.y>P.h+16*T){killP();return}

  // Hit blocks from below
  if(P.vy<0){let tY=P.y,hc=Math.floor((P.x+2)/T),hc2=Math.floor((P.x+P.w-3)/T),hr=Math.floor(tY/T);
    for(let c=hc;c<=hc2;c++){if(c<0||c>=tiles.length||hr<0||hr>=16)continue;let t=tiles[c][hr];
      if(t===QB){tiles[c][hr]=USED;let b=qbs.find(q=>q.x===c&&q.y===hr);if(b)b.bt=10;sfxBump();
        if(Math.random()<0.15){spawnMush(c*T,hr*T);sfxPwr()}else{coins++;score+=200;sfxCoin();addFloat(c*T+8,hr*T-15,'200','#FFD700')}}
      if(t===BRICK){sfxBreak();tiles[c][hr]=EMPTY;let bi=bricks.findIndex(b=>b.x===c&&b.y===hr);if(bi>=0)bricks.splice(bi,1);
        for(let i=0;i<6;i++)addPart(c*T+T/2,hr*T+T/2,(Math.random()-0.5)*5,-Math.random()*6,'#C84C0C',4+Math.random()*4,35+Math.random()*20)}}}

  // Coins
  coinsArr.forEach(cn=>{if(!cn.got&&Math.abs(P.x+P.w/2-cn.x)<16&&Math.abs(P.y+P.h/2-cn.y)<16){
    cn.got=true;coins++;score+=200;sfxCoin();addFloat(cn.x-5,cn.y-15,'200','#FFD700')}});

  // Power-ups
  for(let i=pw.length-1;i>=0;i--){let p=pw[i];
    if(p.anim){p.y-=2;if(p.y<=p.ty)p.anim=false;continue}
    p.vy=Math.min(p.vy+G,6);p.x+=p.vx;
    if(solid(p.x,p.y+8)||solid(p.x+p.w,p.y+8)||solid(p.x,p.y+p.h-1)||solid(p.x+p.w,p.y+p.h-1))p.vx*=-1;
    p.y+=p.vy;
    if(solid(p.x+2,p.y+p.h)||solid(p.x+p.w-2,p.y+p.h)){p.y=Math.floor((p.y+p.h)/T)*T-p.h;p.vy=0}
    if(Math.abs(P.x+P.w/2-p.x-p.w/2)<22&&Math.abs(P.y+P.h/2-p.y-p.h/2)<22){
      if(!P.big){P.big=true;P.h=56;P.y-=26}sfxPwr();score+=1000;addFloat(p.x,p.y-15,'1000','#FFD700');pw.splice(i,1)}}

  // Enemies
  for(let i=enemies.length-1;i>=0;i--){let e=enemies[i];if(!e.alive)continue;
    if(e.shell&&e.sm===0){if(Math.abs(P.x+P.w/2-e.x-e.w/2)<22&&Math.abs(P.y+P.h/2-e.y-e.h/2)<22){
      e.sm=P.x<e.x?1:-1;e.vx=e.sm*7;sfxStomp()}}
    if(P.inv>0)continue;
    if(Math.abs(P.x+P.w/2-e.x-e.w/2)<(P.w+e.w)/2-2&&Math.abs(P.y+P.h/2-e.y-e.h/2)<(P.h+e.h)/2-2){
      if(P.vy>0&&P.y+P.h-8<e.y+e.h/2){P.vy=JF*0.65;sfxStomp();
        if(e.type==='k'&&!e.shell){e.shell=true;e.sm=0;e.vx=0;e.h=22;e.y+=4;score+=100;addFloat(e.x,e.y-15,'100','#fff')}
        else if(e.shell&&e.sm===0){e.sm=P.x<e.x?1:-1;e.vx=e.sm*7}
        else{e.alive=false;score+=100;addFloat(e.x,e.y-15,'100','#fff')}}
      else{if(e.shell&&e.sm===0){e.sm=P.x<e.x?1:-1;e.vx=e.sm*7}else hurtP()}}}

  // Shells hitting enemies
  enemies.forEach(e=>{if(!e.alive||!e.shell||e.sm===0)return;
    enemies.forEach(o=>{if(o===e||!o.alive)return;
      if(Math.abs(e.x+e.w/2-o.x-o.w/2)<(e.w+o.w)/2&&Math.abs(e.y+e.h/2-o.y-o.h/2)<(e.h+o.h)/2){
        o.alive=false;e.sm*=-1;e.vx=e.sm*7;score+=200;sfxStomp();addFloat(o.x,o.y-15,'200','#FFD700')}})});

  // Update enemies physics
  enemies.forEach(e=>{if(!e.alive||e.shell)return;
    e.af+=0.05;e.vy=Math.min((e.vy||0)+G,10);e.x+=e.vx;
    if(solid(e.x,e.y+e.h/2)||solid(e.x+e.w,e.y+e.h/2)){e.vx*=-1;e.x+=e.vx}
    e.y+=e.vy;
    if(solid(e.x+2,e.y+e.h)||solid(e.x+e.w-2,e.y+e.h)){e.y=Math.floor((e.y+e.h)/T)*T-e.h;e.vy=0}});

  // Update shells
  enemies.forEach(e=>{if(!e.alive||!e.shell)return;
    if(e.sm!==0){e.vx=e.sm*7;e.vy=Math.min((e.vy||0)+G,10);e.x+=e.vx;
      if(solid(e.x,e.y+e.h/2)||solid(e.x+e.w,e.y+e.h/2)){e.sm*=-1;e.vx=e.sm*7;e.x+=e.vx}
      e.y+=e.vy;if(solid(e.x+2,e.y+e.h)||solid(e.x+e.w-2,e.y+e.h)){e.y=Math.floor((e.y+e.h)/T)*T-e.h;e.vy=0}
      if(P.inv<=0&&Math.abs(P.x+P.w/2-e.x-e.w/2)<(P.w+e.w)/2&&Math.abs(P.y+P.h/2-e.y-e.h/2)<(P.h+e.h)/2)hurtP()}});

  // Flag
  if(!flag.reached&&P.x+P.w>flag.x-4&&P.x<flag.x+10){
    flag.reached=true;score+=5000;addFloat(flag.x-20,flag.y*T,'5000','#FFD700');sfxCoin()}

  // Particles
  for(let i=parts.length-1;i>=0;i--){let p=parts[i];p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.vy+=0.3;p.life--;if(p.life<=0)parts.splice(i,1)}
  for(let i=floats.length-1;i>=0;i--){floats[i].y-=1;floats[i].life--;if(floats[i].life<=0)floats.splice(i,1)}

  if(P.inv>0)P.inv--;
  cam.x=Math.max(0,Math.min(P.x-300,220*T-800));
  if(P.dead){dTimer++;if(dTimer>100){if(lives<=0)state='gameover';else{state='playing';spawnP()}}}
  if(!flag.reached){tmr--;if(tmr<=0)killP()}
}

function killP(){if(P.dead)return;P.dead=true;P.vy=-8;P.vx=0;dTimer=0;lives--;sfxDie()}
function hurtP(){if(P.inv>0)return;if(P.big){P.big=false;P.h=30;P.inv=120;sfxBump()}else killP()}
function spawnMush(x,y){pw.push({x,y,vx:0,vy:0,w:24,h:24,anim:true,ty:y-T})}

function draw(){
  X.fillStyle='#6B8CFF';X.fillRect(0,0,800,500);
  if(state==='title')drawTitle();
  else if(state==='gameover')drawGO();
  else if(state==='levelcomplete')drawLC();
  else{drawWorld();if(state==='dead')drawDeath()}
}

function drawWorld(){
  let cx=cam.x;
  // Sky gradient
  let grd=X.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,500);
  grd.addColorStop(0,'#6BB3FF');grd.addColorStop(0.7,'#9EC5FF');grd.addColorStop(1,'#B8D4FF');
  X.fillStyle=grd;X.fillRect(0,0,800,500);

  // Clouds
  [[100,60],[300,40],[520,70],[700,30],[900,55],[1150,45],[1400,65],[1650,35],[1900,55]].forEach(([x,y])=>{
    let sx=x*0.6-cx*0.3;
    X.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
    X.beginPath();X.arc(sx,y,18,0,Math.PI*2);X.arc(sx+16,y-6,14,0,Math.PI*2);
    X.arc(sx+32,y-2,16,0,Math.PI*2);X.arc(sx+16,y+4,12,0,Math.PI*2);X.fill()});

  // Hills
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++){let hx=i*400+100-cx*0.4;
    X.fillStyle='#4A8B3F';X.beginPath();X.arc(hx,14*T+2,80,Math.PI,0);X.fill();
    X.fillStyle='#5CA64F';X.beginPath();X.arc(hx,14*T+2,55,Math.PI,0);X.fill()}

  // Ground
  for(let c=Math.max(0,Math.floor(cx/T));c<Math.min(tiles.length,Math.ceil((cx+800)/T)+1);c++)
    for(let r=14;r<16;r++){if(!tiles[c])continue;let t=tiles[c][r],sx=c*T-cx,sy=r*T;
      if(t===GROUND){X.fillStyle=r===14?'#43B047':'#C84C0C';X.fillRect(sx,sy,T,T);
        if(r===14){X.fillStyle='#5CD65C';X.fillRect(sx,sy,T,4);X.fillStyle='#43B047';X.fillRect(sx,sy+3,T,3)}}}

  // Platforms
  plats.forEach(p=>{let sx=p.x-cx,sy=p.y;X.fillStyle='#C84C0C';X.fillRect(sx,sy,p.w*T,T);
    X.fillStyle='#E8A060';X.fillRect(sx+2,sy+2,p.w*T-4,4);
    X.fillStyle='#A0380A';X.fillRect(sx,sy+T-3,p.w*T,3)});

  // Pipes
  pipesArr.forEach(p=>{let sx=p.x-cx,sy=p.y*T;
    X.fillStyle='#43B047';X.fillRect(sx+4,sy,T*p.w-8,T*p.h);
    X.fillStyle='#5CD65C';X.fillRect(sx,sy,T,6);X.fillRect(sx+T-4,sy,4,6);
    X.strokeStyle='#2A6B2F';X.lineWidth=1;X.strokeRect(sx+4,sy,T*p.w-8,T*p.h);
    X.fillStyle='#5CD65C';X.fillRect(sx,sy,T*p.w,8);
    X.fillStyle='#2A6B2F';X.fillRect(sx,sy+8,T*p.w,2);
    X.fillStyle='#36923A';X.fillRect(sx,sy+8,T*p.w,T*p.h-8)});

  // Question blocks
  qbs.forEach(b=>{let sx=b.x*T-cx,sy=b.y*T,off=b.bt>0?Math.sin(b.bt*0.5)*4:0;
    X.fillStyle='#FFB800';X.fillRect(sx,sy-off,T,T);
    X.fillStyle='#D49800';X.strokeStyle='#8B6914';X.lineWidth=2;X.strokeRect(sx+1,sy+1-off,T-2,T-2);
    X.fillStyle='#FFF';X.font='bold 18px Arial';X.textAlign='center';X.textBaseline='middle';
    X.fillText('?',sx+T/2,sy+T/2-off);
    if(b.bt>0)b.bt--});

  // Bricks
  bricks.forEach(b=>{let sx=b.x*T-cx,sy=b.y*T;
    X.fillStyle='#C84C0C';X.fillRect(sx,sy,T,T);
    X.fillStyle='#E8A060';X.fillRect(sx,sy,T,2);X.fillRect(sx+14,sy,2,T);
    X.fillStyle='#A0380A';X.fillRect(sx,sy+14,T,2);X.fillRect(sx,sy,2,T);X.fillRect(sx+T-2,sy,2,T);
    X.strokeStyle='#7A2800';X.lineWidth=1;X.strokeRect(sx,sy,T,T)});

  // Used blocks
  for(let c=Math.max(0,Math.floor(cx/T));c<Math.min(tiles.length,Math.ceil((cx+800)/T)+1);c++)
    for(let r=0;r<14;r++){if(!tiles[c]||tiles[c][r]!==USED)continue;let sx=c*T-cx,sy=r*T;
      X.fillStyle='#8B7355';X.fillRect(sx,sy,T,T);X.fillStyle='#6B5335';X.fillRect(sx+3,sy+3,T-6,T-6)}

  // Coins
  coinsArr.forEach(cn=>{if(cn.got)return;let sx=cn.x-cx,sy=cn.y;
    X.fillStyle='#FFD700';X.beginPath();X.ellipse(sx+6,sy+6,7,9,0,0,Math.PI*2);X.fill();
    X.strokeStyle='#D49800';X.lineWidth=1.5;X.stroke();
    X.fillStyle='#FFF8DC';X.beginPath();X.ellipse(sx+4,sy+4,2,3,0,0,Math.PI*2);X.fill()});

  // Power-ups
  pw.forEach(p=>{let sx=p.x-cx,sy=p.y;
    X.fillStyle='#FF0000';X.beginPath();X.arc(sx+p.w/2,sy+6,12,Math.PI,0);X.fill();
    X.fillStyle='#FFF';X.beginPath();X.arc(sx+p.w/2-5,sy+1,3.5,0,Math.PI*2);
    X.arc(sx+p.w/2+5,sy+1,3.5,0,Math.PI*2);X.fill();
    X.fillStyle='#FFE4C4';X.fillRect(sx+p.w/2-6,sy+6,12,14);
    X.strokeStyle='#C0A080';X.lineWidth=1;X.strokeRect(sx+p.w/2-6,sy+6,12,14)});

  // Enemies
  enemies.forEach(e=>{if(!e.alive)return;let sx=e.x-cx,sy=e.y;
    if(e.shell&&e.sm===0){X.fillStyle='#43B047';X.fillRect(sx+2,sy+2,e.w-4,e.h-4);
      X.strokeStyle='#2A6B2F';X.lineWidth=2;X.strokeRect(sx+2,sy+2,e.w-4,e.h-4);
      X.fillStyle='#8FD65C';X.fillRect(sx+6,sy+e.h/2-2,e.w-12,4);return}
    if(e.type==='g'){X.fillStyle='#C84C0C';X.beginPath();X.arc(sx+e.w/2,sy+e.w/2,e.w/2,Math.PI,0);X.fill();
      X.fillRect(sx+2,sy+e.w/2,e.w-4,e.h/2);
      X.fillStyle='#FFE4C4';X.fillRect(sx+4,sy+e.w/2-4,e.w-8,e.h/4);
      X.fillStyle='#000';let ey=Math.sin(e.af*4)>0?1:0;
      X.fillRect(sx+5,sy+e.w/2-7+ey,4,4);X.fillRect(sx+e.w-9,sy+e.w/2-7+ey,4,4);
      X.fillStyle='#000';X.fillRect(sx+1,sy+e.h-6,7,5);X.fillRect(sx+e.w-8,sy+e.h-6,7,5)}
    else{X.fillStyle='#43B047';X.beginPath();X.arc(sx+e.w/2,sy+e.h/2,e.w/2-1,0,Math.PI*2);X.fill();
      X.fillStyle='#8FD65C';X.beginPath();X.arc(sx+e.w/2,sy+e.h/2+2,e.w/3,0,Math.PI*2);X.fill();
      X.fillStyle='#FFE4C4';X.beginPath();X.arc(sx+e.w/2+(e.vx>0?5:-5),sy+6,6,0,Math.PI*2);X.fill();
      X.fillStyle='#000';X.fillRect(sx+e.w/2+(e.vx>0?3:0),sy+4,3,3);
      X.fillStyle='#FFF';X.fillRect(sx+e.w/2-4,sy+e.h/2-2,8,3)}});

  // Player
  if(!P.dead||dTimer<60){
    let sx=P.x-cx,sy=P.y;
    if(P.dead)sy=P.y;
    if(P.inv>0&&Math.floor(frame/3)%2===0)X.globalAlpha=0.4;
    if(P.big){let d=P.dir;
      X.fillStyle='#F83800';X.fillRect(sx+2,sy+2,20,10);
      X.fillStyle='#FFA040';X.fillRect(sx+4,sy+12,16,6);
      X.fillStyle='#0050D8';X.fillRect(sx+2,sy+18,20,20);
      X.fillStyle='#F83800';X.fillRect(sx+6,sy+20,12,4);
      X.fillStyle='#FFE4C4';X.fillRect(sx+4,sy+4,16,10);
      X.fillStyle='#F83800';X.fillRect(sx+(d>0?0:8),sy,14,6);
      X.fillStyle='#000';X.fillRect(sx+(d>0?14:6),sy+6,3,3);
      X.fillStyle='#0050D8';X.fillRect(sx+2,sy+38,8,8);X.fillRect(sx+14,sy+38,8,8);

question: mario-level-ui
prompt: Recreate a Super Mario Bros. level element (like a question block, brick block interaction, a simple jump sequence, or more if you want to get creative) — make it interactive and fun, feel free to get creative and showcase your skills. Stick to the spirit of nintendo games. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Super Mario Bros. Level</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #87ceeb; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
canvas.height = window.innerHeight;

const player = {
    x: 50,
    y: 300,
    width: 30,
    height: 40,
    velocityY: 0,
    onGround: false
};

const blocks = [
    { x: 100, y: 350, width: 32, height: 32, type: 'question', hasCoin: true },
    { x: 150, y: 350, width: 32, height: 32, type: 'brick', hits: 1 },
    { x: 200, y: 350, width: 32, height: 32, type: 'brick', hits: 2 }
];

let coins = [];

let keys = {
    left: false,
    right: false,
    up: false
};

document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = true;
    if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = true;
    if (e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'Space') keys.up = true;
});

document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = false;
    if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = false;
    if (e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'Space') keys.up = false;
});

const gravity = 0.5;
const playerSpeed = 3;

function gameLoop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

function update() {
    // Player movement
    if (keys.left) player.x -= playerSpeed;
    if (keys.right) player.x += playerSpeed;

    // Jump
    if (keys.up && player.onGround) {
        player.velocityY = -10;
        player.onGround = false;
    }

    // Apply gravity
    player.velocityY += gravity;
    player.y += player.velocityY;

    // Check collision with blocks
    player.onGround = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) {
        const block = blocks[i];
        if (checkCollision(player, block)) {
            // Check if landing on top
            if (player.velocityY > 0 && player.y + player.height <= block.y + 1) {
                player.y = block.y - player.height;
                player.velocityY = 0;
                player.onGround = true;

                // Handle block interaction
                if (block.type === 'question' && block.hasCoin) {
                    coins.push({ x: block.x + 10, y: block.y - 10 });
                    block.hasCoin = false;
                } else if (block.type === 'brick') {
                    block.hits -= 1;
                    if (block.hits <= 0) {
                        blocks.splice(i, 1);
                        i--;
                    }
                }
            } else {
                // Handle other collisions
                if (player.velocityY > 0) {
                    player.y = block.y - player.height;
                    player.velocityY = 0;
                    player.onGround = true;
                } else if (player.velocityY < 0) {
                    player.y = block.y + block.height;
                    player.velocityY = 0;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Check collision with coins
    for (let i = 0; i < coins.length; i++) {
        const coin = coins[i];
        if (checkCollision(player, coin)) {
            coins.splice(i, 1);
            i--;
        }
    }

    // Keep player within canvas
    if (player.x < 0) player.x = 0;
    if (player.x + player.width > canvas.width) player.x = canvas.width - player.width;
    if (player.y + player.height > canvas.height) {
        player.y = canvas.height - player.height;
        player.velocityY = 0;
        player.onGround = true;
    }
}

function checkCollision(a, b) {
    return !(
        a.x + a.width < b.x ||
        b.x + b.width < a.x ||
        a.y + a.height < b.y ||
        b.y + b.height < a.y
    );
}

function draw() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#87ceeb'; // Sky blue
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    // Draw player
    ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
    ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.width, player.height);

    // Draw blocks
    for (const block of blocks) {
        if (block.type === 'question') {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'brown';
        } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
        }
        ctx.fillRect(block.x, block.y, block.width, block.height);
        if (block.type === 'question' && block.hasCoin) {
            // Draw a question mark (simplified)
            ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(block.x + 16, block.y + 16, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }
    }

    // Draw coins
    ctx.fillStyle = 'yellow';
    for (const coin of coins) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(coin.x, coin.y, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    }
}

gameLoop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

const W = 800, H = 480;
canvas.width = W;
canvas.height = H;

// Audio context
const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
let audioCtx;
function ensureAudio() {
    if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new AudioCtx();
}

function playSound(type) {
    ensureAudio();
    const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
    const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    const t = audioCtx.currentTime;

    switch(type) {
        case 'jump':
            osc.type = 'square';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(500, t);
            osc.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(800, t + 0.1);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, t);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, t + 0.15);
            osc.start(t); osc.stop(t + 0.15);
            break;
        case 'coin':
            osc.type = 'square';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(988, t);
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(1319, t + 0.07);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, t);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, t + 0.2);
            osc.start(t); osc.stop(t + 0.2);
            break;
        case 'stomp':
            osc.type = 'square';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(400, t);
            osc.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(100, t + 0.1);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, t);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, t + 0.15);
            osc.start(t); osc.stop(t + 0.15);
            break;
        case 'bump':
            osc.type = 'triangle';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(260, t);
            osc.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(100, t + 0.08);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, t);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, t + 0.1);
            osc.start(t); osc.stop(t + 0.1);
            break;
        case 'powerup':
            osc.type = 'square';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(523, t);
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(659, t + 0.1);
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(784, t + 0.2);
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(1047, t + 0.3);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, t);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, t + 0.5);
            osc.start(t); osc.stop(t + 0.5);
            break;
        case 'die':
            osc.type = 'square';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(600, t);
            osc.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(100, t + 0.6);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, t);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, t + 0.7);
            osc.start(t); osc.stop(t + 0.7);
            break;
        case 'flag':
            osc.type = 'square';
            [523,659,784,1047,784,1047].forEach((f,i) => {
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(f, t + i*0.12);
            });
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, t);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, t + 0.9);
            osc.start(t); osc.stop(t + 0.9);
            break;
        case 'brick':
            osc.type = 'sawtooth';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(200, t);
            osc.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(80, t + 0.1);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, t);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, t + 0.12);
            osc.start(t); osc.stop(t + 0.12);
            break;
        case '1up':
            osc.type = 'square';
            [262,330,392,523,659,784].forEach((f,i) => {
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(f, t + i*0.08);
            });
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, t);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, t + 0.6);
            osc.start(t); osc.stop(t + 0.6);
            break;
    }
}

// Game constants
const TILE = 32;
const GRAVITY = 0.55;
const FRICTION = 0.82;
const MAX_SPEED = 4.5;
const RUN_SPEED = 6;
const JUMP_FORCE = -10.5;
const LEVEL_WIDTH = 210;

// Game state
let gameState = 'title'; // title, playing, dead, gameover, win
let score = 0;
let coins = 0;
let lives = 3;
let time = 400;
let timeTimer = 0;
let deathTimer = 0;
let winTimer = 0;
let screenShake = 0;
let cameraX = 0;
let level = [];
let entities = [];
let particles = [];
let floatingTexts = [];
let blockAnimations = [];

// Input
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    keys[e.code] = true;
    if (['Space','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight'].includes(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
    if (gameState === 'title' && (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter')) {
        ensureAudio();
        startGame();
    }
    if (gameState === 'gameover' && (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter')) {
        lives = 3;
        score = 0;
        coins = 0;
        startGame();
    }
    if (gameState === 'win' && (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter')) {
        gameState = 'title';
    }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });

// Player
let player = {
    x: 80, y: 0, w: 24, h: 32,
    vx: 0, vy: 0,
    onGround: false,
    facing: 1,
    big: false,
    star: false,
    starTimer: 0,
    invincible: 0,
    animFrame: 0,
    animTimer: 0,
    sliding: false,
    dead: false
};

// Sprite drawing functions
function drawMario(x, y, frame, facing, big, star) {
    ctx.save();
    const px = Math.round(x);
    const py = Math.round(y);
    const f = facing;

    if (star && Math.floor(Date.now() / 50) % 2) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
    }

    const hatColor = star ? '#ff0' : '#e44020';
    const shirtColor = star ? '#0ff' : '#e44020';
    const overallColor = star ? '#f0f' : '#5c94fc';
    const skinColor = '#ffb880';
    const shoeColor = '#5c2d00';

    if (big) {
        // Big Mario - 24x64
        const bh = 64;
        ctx.save();
        if (f === -1) { ctx.translate(px + 12, 0); ctx.scale(-1, 1); ctx.translate(-12, 0); }
        else { ctx.translate(px, 0); }

        // Hat
        ctx.fillStyle = hatColor;
        ctx.fillRect(4, py, 16, 8);
        ctx.fillRect(2, py + 4, 20, 4);

        // Face
        ctx.fillStyle = skinColor;
        ctx.fillRect(2, py + 8, 20, 12);
        // Eyes
        ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        ctx.fillRect(6, py + 10, 4, 4);
        ctx.fillRect(14, py + 10, 4, 4);
        // Mustache
        ctx.fillStyle = '#5c2d00';
        ctx.fillRect(4, py + 16, 16, 3);

        // Body
        ctx.fillStyle = shirtColor;
        ctx.fillRect(2, py + 20, 20, 8);

        // Overalls
        ctx.fillStyle = overallColor;
        ctx.fillRect(2, py + 28, 20, 16);
        // Buttons
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
        ctx.fillRect(8, py + 30, 3, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(13, py + 30, 3, 3);

        // Legs
        if (frame === 0 || !player.onGround) {
            // Standing / jumping
            ctx.fillStyle = overallColor;
            ctx.fillRect(2, py + 44, 8, 12);
            ctx.fillRect(14, py + 44, 8, 12);
            ctx.fillStyle = shoeColor;
            ctx.fillRect(0, py + 56, 10, 8);
            ctx.fillRect(14, py + 56, 10, 8);
        } else if (frame === 1) {
            ctx.fillStyle = overallColor;
            ctx.fillRect(0, py + 44, 8, 12);
            ctx.fillRect(16, py + 44, 8, 12);
            ctx.fillStyle = shoeColor;
            ctx.fillRect(-2, py + 56, 10, 8);
            ctx.fillRect(16, py + 56, 10, 8);
        } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = overallColor;
            ctx.fillRect(4, py + 44, 8, 12);
            ctx.fillRect(12, py + 44, 8, 12);
            ctx.fillStyle = shoeColor;
            ctx.fillRect(2, py + 56, 10, 8);
            ctx.fillRect(12, py + 56, 10, 8);
        }
        ctx.restore();
    } else {
        // Small Mario - 24x32
        ctx.save();
        if (f === -1) { ctx.translate(px + 12, 0); ctx.scale(-1, 1); ctx.translate(-12, 0); }
        else { ctx.translate(px, 0); }

        // Hat
        ctx.fillStyle = hatColor;
        ctx.fillRect(4, py, 14, 6);
        ctx.fillRect(2, py + 3, 18, 3);

        // Face
        ctx.fillStyle = skinColor;
        ctx.fillRect(2, py + 6, 18, 10);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        ctx.fillRect(6, py + 8, 3, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(13, py + 8, 3, 3);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#5c2d00';
        ctx.fillRect(4, py + 13, 14, 2);

        // Body
        ctx.fillStyle = shirtColor;
        ctx.fillRect(2, py + 16, 20, 4);

        // Overalls
        ctx.fillStyle = overallColor;
        ctx.fillRect(2, py + 20, 20, 6);

        // Legs & shoes
        if (frame === 0 || !player.onGround) {
            ctx.fillStyle = shoeColor;
            ctx.fillRect(2, py + 26, 8, 6);
            ctx.fillRect(14, py + 26, 8, 6);
        } else if (frame === 1) {
            ctx.fillStyle = shoeColor;
            ctx.fillRect(0, py + 26, 8, 6);
            ctx.fillRect(16, py + 26, 8, 6);
        } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = shoeColor;
            ctx.fillRect(4, py + 26, 8, 6);
            ctx.fillRect(12, py + 26, 8, 6);
        }
        ctx.restore();
    }
    ctx.restore();
}

function drawGoomba(x, y, frame, dead) {
    const px = Math.round(x);
    const py = Math.round(y);
    if (dead) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#8b4513';
        ctx.fillRect(px + 2, py + 24, 28, 8);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        ctx.fillRect(px + 6, py + 26, 3, 2);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 20, py + 26, 3, 2);
        return;
    }
    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8b4513';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 4, py + 4, 24, 20);
    ctx.fillRect(px + 2, py + 8, 28, 16);
    // Face
    ctx.fillStyle = '#d4a574';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 6, py + 10, 20, 12);
    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 8, py + 12, 4, 5);
    ctx.fillRect(px + 18, py + 12, 4, 5);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 9, py + 12, 2, 3);
    ctx.fillRect(px + 19, py + 12, 2, 3);
    // Feet
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    if (frame === 0) {
        ctx.fillRect(px, py + 24, 12, 8);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 20, py + 24, 12, 8);
    } else {
        ctx.fillRect(px + 2, py + 24, 12, 8);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 18, py + 24, 12, 8);
    }
}

function drawKoopa(x, y, frame, inShell) {
    const px = Math.round(x);
    const py = Math.round(y);
    if (inShell) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2';
        ctx.fillRect(px + 4, py + 12, 24, 20);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
        ctx.fillRect(px + 8, py + 16, 16, 12);
        return;
    }
    // Shell
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 4, py + 8, 24, 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 8, py + 12, 16, 12);
    // Head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 18, py, 12, 14);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 22, py + 3, 5, 5);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 24, py + 4, 3, 3);
    // Feet
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f80';
    if (frame === 0) {
        ctx.fillRect(px + 2, py + 28, 10, 4);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 18, py + 28, 10, 4);
    } else {
        ctx.fillRect(px + 4, py + 28, 10, 4);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 16, py + 28, 10, 4);
    }
}

function drawCoin(x, y, frame) {
    const px = Math.round(x);
    const py = Math.round(y);
    const widths = [16, 12, 4, 12];
    const w = widths[frame % 4];
    const ox = (16 - w) / 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
    ctx.fillRect(px + ox, py, w, 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fa0';
    if (w > 6) {
        ctx.fillRect(px + ox + 2, py + 2, w - 4, 16);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
    if (w > 8) {
        ctx.fillRect(px + ox + 4, py + 6, w - 8, 8);
    }
}

function drawMushroom(x, y) {
    const px = Math.round(x);
    const py = Math.round(y);
    // Cap
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e44020';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 2, py, 28, 14);
    ctx.fillRect(px, py + 4, 32, 10);
    // Spots
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 6, py + 2, 8, 8);
    ctx.fillRect(px + 18, py + 2, 8, 8);
    // Stem
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f8d8a0';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 6, py + 14, 20, 14);
    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 8, py + 18, 4, 4);
    ctx.fillRect(px + 20, py + 18, 4, 4);
}

function drawStar(x, y, frame) {
    const px = Math.round(x);
    const py = Math.round(y);
    const colors = ['#ff0', '#f80', '#0ff', '#f0f'];
    ctx.fillStyle = colors[frame % 4];
    // Star shape
    ctx.fillRect(px + 8, py, 16, 6);
    ctx.fillRect(px + 4, py + 6, 24, 6);
    ctx.fillRect(px, py + 12, 32, 6);
    ctx.fillRect(px + 4, py + 18, 8, 6);
    ctx.fillRect(px + 20, py + 18, 8, 6);
    ctx.fillRect(px + 2, py + 24, 10, 6);
    ctx.fillRect(px + 20, py + 24, 10, 6);
    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 8, py + 10, 4, 4);
    ctx.fillRect(px + 18, py + 10, 4, 4);
}

function drawFireFlower(x, y, frame) {
    const px = Math.round(x);
    const py = Math.round(y);
    const colors = ['#e44020', '#ff0', '#f80', '#fff'];
    // Stem
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 12, py + 16, 8, 16);
    // Petals
    ctx.fillStyle = colors[frame % 4];
    ctx.fillRect(px + 4, py, 24, 8);
    ctx.fillRect(px, py + 4, 32, 8);
    ctx.fillRect(px + 4, py + 8, 24, 8);
    // Center
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 8, py + 4, 16, 8);
}

// Level building
function buildLevel() {
    level = [];
    for (let x = 0; x < LEVEL_WIDTH; x++) {
        level[x] = [];
        for (let y = 0; y < 15; y++) {
            level[x][y] = 0;
        }
    }

    // Ground
    for (let x = 0; x < LEVEL_WIDTH; x++) {
        if ((x >= 69 && x <= 70) || (x >= 86 && x <= 88) || (x >= 153 && x <= 154)) continue; // gaps
        level[x][13] = 1; // ground top
        level[x][14] = 2; // ground bottom
    }

    // Pipes
    function addPipe(x, height) {
        for (let h = 0; h < height; h++) {
            level[x][12 - h] = 3;
            level[x + 1][12 - h] = 3;
        }
        level[x][12 - height] = 4; // pipe top left
        level[x + 1][12 - height] = 5; // pipe top right
    }
    addPipe(28, 2);
    addPipe(38, 3);
    addPipe(46, 4);
    addPipe(57, 4);
    addPipe(163, 2);
    addPipe(179, 2);

    // Brick blocks
    function addBricks(x, y, count) {
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) level[x + i][y] = 6;
    }

    // Question blocks
    function addQuestion(x, y, content) {
        level[x][y] = 7;
        level[x + '_content'] = content || 'coin';
    }

    // Section 1: Intro area
    level[16][9] = 7; // question block with coin
    level[16]['_content'] = 'coin';
    addBricks(20, 9, 1);
    level[21][9] = 7;
    level[21]['_content'] = 'mushroom';
    level[22][9] = 7;
    level[22]['_content'] = 'coin';
    addBricks(23, 9, 1);

    level[22][5] = 7;
    level[22]['_content2'] = 'coin';

    // Section 2
    addBricks(77, 9, 1);
    level[78][9] = 7;
    level[78]['_content'] = 'coin';
    addBricks(79, 9, 3);
    level[80][9] = 7;
    level[80]['_content'] = 'coin';
    level[82][9] = 7;
    level[82]['_content'] = 'coin';

    // Upper platform
    addBricks(80, 5, 8);

    // Section 3: After first gap
    addBricks(91, 9, 2);
    level[93][9] = 7;
    level[93]['_content'] = 'mushroom';
    addBricks(94, 9, 1);

    // Staircase 1
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            level[100 + i][12 - j] = 8; // stone block
        }
    }
    // Descending
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j <= 3 - i; j++) {
            level[105 + i][12 - j] = 8;
        }
    }

    // More blocks
    level[109][9] = 7;
    level[109]['_content'] = 'star';
    level[112][9] = 7;
    level[112]['_content'] = 'coin';
    addBricks(110, 9, 2);
    addBricks(113, 9, 1);

    // Upper bricks
    addBricks(118, 5, 3);
    level[121][5] = 7;
    level[121]['_content'] = 'coin';
    addBricks(122, 5, 3);

    // Section 4
    addBricks(128, 9, 1);
    level[129][9] = 7;
    level[129]['_content'] = 'coin';
    level[130][9] = 7;
    level[130]['_content'] = 'coin';
    addBricks(131, 9, 1);

    // Second gap area
    addBricks(140, 9, 3);
    level[141][9] = 7;
    level[141]['_content'] = 'mushroom';

    // Floating platforms over gap
    addBricks(150, 10, 3);
    addBricks(155, 8, 3);

    // Staircase to flag
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            level[180 + i][12 - j] = 8;
        }
    }

    // Flag pole
    level[190][12] = 8;
    for (let y = 3; y <= 12; y++) {
        level[190][y] = 9; // flag pole
    }
    level[190][3] = 10; // flag top

    // Extra bricks for fun
    addBricks(170, 9, 4);
    level[171][9] = 7;
    level[171]['_content'] = 'coin';
    level[172][9] = 7;
    level[172]['_content'] = 'coin';

    // Upper platforms near end
    addBricks(170, 5, 6);
}

function spawnEntities() {
    entities = [];

    // Goombas
    const goombaPositions = [22, 40, 51, 52.5, 80, 82, 97, 98.5, 114, 115.5, 125, 126.5, 130, 145, 146.5, 170, 171.5];
    goombaPositions.forEach(gx => {
        entities.push({
            type: 'goomba', x: gx * TILE, y: 11 * TILE, w: 32, h: 32,
            vx: -1, vy: 0, alive: true, deadTimer: 0, animFrame: 0, animTimer: 0
        });
    });

    // Koopas
    [45, 95, 135, 168].forEach(kx => {
        entities.push({
            type: 'koopa', x: kx * TILE, y: 10 * TILE, w: 32, h: 40,
            vx: -1, vy: 0, alive: true, inShell: false, shellMoving: false,
            deadTimer: 0, animFrame: 0, animTimer: 0
        });
    });

    // Coins in the air
    const coinPositions = [
        [17, 7], [35, 10], [36, 10], [65, 10], [66, 10], [67, 10],
        [108, 10], [109, 10], [138, 10], [139, 10], [160, 10], [161, 10],
        [175, 10], [176, 10], [177, 10]
    ];
    coinPositions.forEach(([cx, cy]) => {
        entities.push({
            type: 'coin', x: cx * TILE + 8, y: cy * TILE, w: 16, h: 20,
            collected: false, animFrame: 0, animTimer: 0
        });
    });
}

function startGame() {
    gameState = 'playing';
    time = 400;
    timeTimer = 0;
    buildLevel();
    spawnEntities();
    resetPlayer();
    cameraX = 0;
    particles = [];
    floatingTexts = [];
    blockAnimations = [];
}

function resetPlayer() {
    player.x = 80;
    player.y = 11 * TILE;
    player.vx = 0;
    player.vy = 0;
    player.onGround = false;
    player.facing = 1;
    player.big = false;
    player.star = false;
    player.starTimer = 0;
    player.invincible = 0;
    player.dead = false;
    player.sliding = false;
}

function getTile(x, y) {
    const tx = Math.floor(x / TILE);
    const ty = Math.floor(y / TILE);
    if (tx < 0 || tx >= LEVEL_WIDTH || ty < 0 || ty >= 15) return 0;
    return level[tx][ty];
}

function isSolid(tile) {
    return tile === 1 || tile === 2 || tile === 3 || tile === 4 || tile === 5 ||
           tile === 6 || tile === 7 || tile === 8 || tile === 9;
}

function hitBlock(tx, ty) {
    const tile = level[tx][ty];
    if (tile === 7) { // Question block
        level[tx][ty] = 11; // used block
        const content = level[tx]['_content'] || level[tx]['_content2'] || 'coin';
        if (content === 'coin') {
            collectCoin(tx * TILE + 8, ty * TILE - 16);
        } else if (content === 'mushroom') {
            entities.push({
                type: 'mushroom', x: tx * TILE, y: (ty - 1) * TILE, w: 32, h: 32,
                vx: 2, vy: 0, emerging: true, emergeY: ty * TILE, active: true
            });
            playSound('powerup');
        } else if (content === 'star') {
            entities.push({
                type: 'star', x: tx * TILE, y: (ty - 1) * TILE, w: 32, h: 32,
                vx: 2, vy: -6, emerging: true, emergeY: ty * TILE, active: true,
                animFrame: 0, animTimer: 0
            });
            playSound('powerup');
        }
        blockAnimations.push({ x: tx * TILE, y: ty * TILE, timer: 8, origY: ty * TILE });
        playSound('coin');
    } else if (tile === 6) { // Brick
        if (player.big) {
            level[tx][ty] = 0;
            playSound('brick');
            screenShake = 4;
            // Brick particles
            for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                particles.push({
                    x: tx * TILE + (i % 2) * 16 + 4,
                    y: ty * TILE + Math.floor(i / 2) * 8,
                    vx: (i % 2 === 0 ? -2 : 2) + Math.random() * 2 - 1,
                    vy: -6 - Math.random() * 4,
                    life: 60,
                    color: '#c84',
                    size: 8
                });
            }
        } else {
            blockAnimations.push({ x: tx * TILE, y: ty * TILE, timer: 8, origY: ty * TILE });
            playSound('bump');
        }
    }
}

function collectCoin(x, y) {
    coins++;
    score += 200;
    playSound('coin');
    floatingTexts.push({ x, y, text: '200', timer: 40, vy: -2 });
    if (coins >= 100) {
        coins -= 100;
        lives++;
        playSound('1up');
        floatingTexts.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y - 20, text: '1UP!', timer: 60, vy: -2 });
    }
}

function updatePlayer() {
    if (player.dead) {
        player.vy += GRAVITY;
        player.y += player.vy;
        return;
    }

    if (player.sliding) {
        player.vy = 2;
        player.y += player.vy;
        if (player.y >= 12 * TILE) {
            player.y = 12 * TILE;
            player.sliding = false;
            player.onGround = true;
            winTimer = 120;
            score += Math.max(0, Math.floor(time)) * 50;
            gameState = 'win';
            playSound('flag');
        }
        return;
    }

    const running = keys['ShiftLeft'] || keys['ShiftRight'] || keys['KeyX'];
    const maxSpd = running ? RUN_SPEED : MAX_SPEED;

    if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA']) {
        player.vx -= 0.4;
        player.facing = -1;
    }
    if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD']) {
        player.vx += 0.4;
        player.facing = 1;
    }

    if (!keys['ArrowLeft'] && !keys['KeyA'] && !keys['ArrowRight'] && !keys['KeyD']) {
        player.vx *= FRICTION;
        if (Math.abs(player.vx) < 0.1) player.vx = 0;
    }

    player.vx = Math.max(-maxSpd, Math.min(maxSpd, player.vx));

    // Jump
    if ((keys['Space'] || keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW'] || keys['KeyZ']) && player.onGround) {
        player.vy = JUMP_FORCE;
        player.onGround = false;
        playSound('jump');
    }

    // Variable jump height
    if (!(keys['Space'] || keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW'] || keys['KeyZ']) && player.vy < -3) {
        player.vy = -3;
    }

    player.vy += GRAVITY;
    if (player.vy > 12) player.vy = 12;

    // Animation
    player.animTimer++;
    if (Math.abs(player.vx) > 0.5 && player.onGround) {
        if (player.animTimer > (running ? 3 : 5)) {
            player.animTimer = 0;
            player.animFrame = (player.animFrame + 1) % 3;
        }
    } else if (player.onGround) {
        player.animFrame = 0;
        player.animTimer = 0;
    }

    // Star timer
    if (player.star) {
        player.starTimer--;
        if (player.starTimer <= 0) player.star = false;
    }

    // Invincibility
    if (player.invincible > 0) player.invincible--;

    // Horizontal collision
    player.x += player.vx;
    resolveCollisionX(player);

    // Vertical collision
    player.y += player.vy;
    player.onGround = false;
    resolveCollisionY(player);

    // Prevent going left of camera or below level
    if (player.x < cameraX) player.x = cameraX;
    if (player.y > 15 * TILE) {
        die();
    }

    // Flag pole check
    const flagX = 190 * TILE;
    if (player.x + player.w > flagX && player.x < flagX + TILE && !player.sliding) {
        player.sliding = true;
        player.x = flagX - player.w / 2;
        player.vx = 0;
        player.vy = 0;
    }
}

function resolveCollisionX(obj) {
    const left = Math.floor(obj.x / TILE);
    const right = Math.floor((obj.x + obj.w - 1) / TILE);
    const top = Math.floor(obj.y / TILE);
    const bottom = Math.floor((obj.y + obj.h - 1) / TILE);

    for (let tx = left; tx <= right; tx++) {
        for (let ty = top; ty <= bottom; ty++) {
            if (isSolid(getTile(tx * TILE, ty * TILE))) {
                if (obj.vx > 0) {
                    obj.x = tx * TILE - obj.w;
                    obj.vx = obj === player ? 0 : -obj.vx;
                } else if (obj.vx < 0) {
                    obj.x = (tx + 1) * TILE;
                    obj.vx = obj === player ? 0 : -obj.vx;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

function resolveCollisionY(obj) {
    const left = Math.floor(obj.x / TILE);
    const right = Math.floor((obj.x + obj.w - 1) / TILE);
    const top = Math.floor(obj.y / TILE);
    const bottom = Math.floor((obj.y + obj.h - 1) / TILE);

    for (let tx = left; tx <= right; tx++) {
        for (let ty = top; ty <= bottom; ty++) {
            const tile = getTile(tx * TILE, ty * TILE);
            if (isSolid(tile)) {
                if (obj.vy > 0) {
                    obj.y = ty * TILE - obj.h;
                    obj.vy = 0;
                    if (obj === player) obj.onGround = true;
                } else if (obj.vy < 0) {
                    obj.y = (ty + 1) * TILE;
                    obj.vy = 0;
                    if (obj === player) {
                        hitBlock(tx, ty);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

function updateEntities() {
    entities.forEach(e => {
        if (e.collected || (!e.alive && e.deadTimer <= 0)) return;

        if (e.type === 'coin') {
            e.animTimer++;
            if (e.animTimer > 10) { e.animTimer = 0; e.animFrame = (e.animFrame + 1) % 4; }

            // Check player collision
            if (!e.collected && rectsOverlap(player, e)) {
                e.collected = true;
                collectCoin(e.x, e.y);
            }
            return;
        }

        if (e.type === 'mushroom' || e.type === 'star') {
            if (e.emerging) {
                e.y -= 1;
                if (e.y <= e.emergeY - TILE) {
                    e.emerging = false;
                }
                return;
            }
            if (!e.active) return;

            if (e.type === 'star') {
                e.vy += GRAVITY;
                e.animTimer++;
                if (e.animTimer > 5) { e.animTimer = 0; e.animFrame = (e.animFrame + 1) % 4; }
            }

            e.x += e.vx;
            resolveCollisionX(e);
            e.y += e.vy;
            resolveCollisionY(e);

            if (e.type === 'star' && e.onGround) {
                e.vy = -8;
            }

            // Player pickup
            if (rectsOverlap(player, e) && !player.dead) {
                e.active = false;
                if (e.type === 'mushroom') {
                    if (!player.big) {
                        player.big = true;
                        player.h = 64;
                        player.y -= 32;
                    }
                    score += 1000;
                    floatingTexts.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, text: '1000', timer: 40, vy: -2 });
                    playSound('powerup');
                } else if (e.type === 'star') {
                    player.star = true;
                    player.starTimer = 600;
                    score += 1000;
                    floatingTexts.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, text: 'STAR!', timer: 40, vy: -2 });
                    playSound('powerup');
                }
            }

            if (e.y > 15 * TILE) e.active = false;
            return;
        }

        if (!e.alive) {
            e.deadTimer--;
            return;
        }

        // Only update if near player
        if (Math.abs(e.x - player.x) > W + 200) return;

        // Goomba / Koopa AI
        e.vy += GRAVITY;
        e.x += e.vx;
        resolveCollisionX(e);
        e.y += e.vy;
        e.onGround = false;
        resolveCollisionY(e);

        e.animTimer++;
        if (e.animTimer > 12) { e.animTimer = 0; e.animFrame = (e.animFrame + 1) % 2; }

        // Koopa shell
        if (e.type === 'koopa' && e.inShell && e.shellMoving) {
            // Shell kills other enemies
            entities.forEach(other => {
                if (other !== e && other.alive && (other.type === 'goomba' || other.type === 'koopa') && rectsOverlap(e, other)) {
                    other.alive = false;
                    other.deadTimer = 30;
                    score += 100;
                    floatingTexts.push({ x: other.x, y: other.y, text: '100', timer: 40, vy: -2 });
                    playSound('stomp');
                }
            });
        }

        // Fall off
        if (e.y > 15 * TILE) { e.alive = false; e.deadTimer = 0; }

        // Player collision
        if (!player.dead && !player.sliding && rectsOverlap(player, e)) {
            if (player.star) {
                e.alive = false;
                e.deadTimer = 30;
                score += 200;
                floatingTexts.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, text: '200', timer: 40, vy: -2 });
                playSound('stomp');
            } else if (player.vy > 0 && player.y + player.h - 10 < e.y + e.h / 2) {
                // Stomp
                player.vy = -8;
                if (e.type === 'goomba') {
                    e.alive = false;
                    e.deadTimer = 40;
                    score += 100;
                    floatingTexts.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, text: '100', timer: 40, vy: -2 });
                } else if (e.type === 'koopa') {
                    if (!e.inShell) {
                        e.inShell = true;
                        e.h = 32;
                        e.y += 8;
                        e.vx = 0;
                        score += 100;
                    } else if (!e.shellMoving) {
                        e.shellMoving = true;
                        e.vx = player.x < e.x ? 6 : -6;
                        score += 100;
                    } else {
                        e.shellMoving = false;
                        e.vx = 0;
                    }
                    floatingTexts.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, text: '100', timer: 40, vy: -2 });
                }
                playSound('stomp');
            } else if (e.type === 'koopa' && e.inShell && !e.shellMoving) {
                e.shellMoving = true;
                e.vx = player.facing * 6;
                playSound('stomp');
            } else if (player.invincible <= 0) {
                hurtPlayer();
            }
        }
    });
}

function hurtPlayer() {
    if (player.invincible > 0) return;
    if (player.big) {
        player.big = false;
        player.h = 32;
        player.invincible = 120;
        playSound('bump');
        screenShake = 6;
    } else {
        die();
    }
}

function die() {
    if (player.dead) return;
    player.dead = true;
    player.vy = -10;
    player.vx = 0;
    playSound('die');
    lives--;
    deathTimer = 90;
}

function rectsOverlap(a, b) {
    return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
}

function updateParticles() {
    particles = particles.filter(p => {
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;
        p.vy += 0.3;
        p.life--;
        return p.life > 0;
    });
}

function updateFloatingTexts() {
    floatingTexts = floatingTexts.filter(t => {
        t.y += t.vy;
        t.timer--;
        return t.timer > 0;
    });
}

function updateBlockAnimations() {
    blockAnimations = blockAnimations.filter(b => {
        b.timer--;
        if (b.timer > 4) b.y = b.origY - 6;
        else b.y = b.origY;
        return b.timer > 0;
    });
}

function updateCamera() {
    const targetX = player.x - W / 3;
    cameraX = Math.max(cameraX, targetX);
    cameraX = Math.max(0, Math.min(cameraX, LEVEL_WIDTH * TILE - W));
}

// Drawing
function drawBackground() {
    // Sky gradient
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#5c94fc');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#87CEEB');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Clouds (parallax)
    const cloudX = cameraX * 0.3;
    drawCloud(200 - cloudX % 600, 60);
    drawCloud(500 - cloudX % 600, 40);
    drawCloud(800 - cloudX % 600, 80);
    drawCloud(1100 - cloudX % 600, 50);
    drawCloud(1400 - cloudX % 600, 70);

    // Hills (parallax)
    const hillX = cameraX * 0.5;
    drawHill(100 - hillX % 700, 13 * TILE, 120, 60);
    drawHill(400 - hillX % 700, 13 * TILE, 200, 90);
    drawHill(750 - hillX % 700, 13 * TILE, 100, 50);
    drawHill(1050 - hillX % 700, 13 * TILE, 180, 80);

    // Bushes
    const bushX = cameraX * 0.7;
    drawBush(150 - bushX % 500, 13 * TILE - 12, 60);
    drawBush(350 - bushX % 500, 13 * TILE - 8, 40);
    drawBush(600 - bushX % 500, 13 * TILE - 12, 70);
    drawBush(850 - bushX % 500, 13 * TILE - 8, 50);
}

function drawCloud(x, y) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(x + 20, y - 10, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(x + 45, y, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(x + 20, y + 5, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
}

function drawHill(x, baseY, w, h) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4a4';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, baseY);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w / 2, baseY - h, x + w, baseY);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5b5';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + w * 0.2, baseY);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w / 2, baseY - h + 10, x + w * 0.8, baseY);
    ctx.fill();
}

function drawBush(x, y, w) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, w * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(x + w * 0.35, y - 4, w * 0.25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(x + w * 0.65, y, w * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
}

function drawTiles() {
    const startX = Math.floor(cameraX / TILE);
    const endX = Math.min(LEVEL_WIDTH, startX + Math.ceil(W / TILE) + 2);

    for (let tx = startX; tx < endX; tx++) {
        for (let ty = 0; ty < 15; ty++) {
            const tile = level[tx][ty];
            if (tile === 0) continue;

            let drawY = ty * TILE;
            // Block animation offset
            const anim = blockAnimations.find(b => Math.floor(b.x / TILE) === tx && Math.floor(b.origY / TILE) === ty);
            if (anim) drawY = anim.y;

            const dx = tx * TILE - cameraX;
            const dy = drawY;

            switch(tile) {
                case 1: // Ground top
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#c84';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx, dy, TILE, TILE);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#6b3';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx, dy, TILE, 6);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#a63';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx, dy + 6, TILE, 2);
                    break;
                case 2: // Ground bottom
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#c84';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx, dy, TILE, TILE);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#a63';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx + 4, dy + 4, 10, 10);
                    ctx.fillRect(dx + 18, dy + 16, 10, 10);
                    break;
                case 3: // Pipe body
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx, dy, TILE, TILE);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#4d4';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx + 4, dy, 8, TILE);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#181';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx + 24, dy, 8, TILE);
                    break;
                case 4: // Pipe top left
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx - 4, dy, TILE + 4, TILE);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#4d4';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx - 2, dy + 2, 10, TILE - 4);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#181';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx + 20, dy + 2, 10, TILE - 4);
                    break;
                case 5: // Pipe top right
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx, dy, TILE + 4, TILE);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#4d4';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx + 2, dy + 2, 10, TILE - 4);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#181';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx + 22, dy + 2, 10, TILE - 4);
                    break;
                case 6: // Brick
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#c84';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx, dy, TILE, TILE);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#a63';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx, dy, TILE, 2);
                    ctx.fillRect(dx, dy + 14, TILE, 2);
                    ctx.fillRect(dx + 15, dy, 2, 14);
                    ctx.fillRect(dx + 7, dy + 16, 2, 16);
                    ctx.fillRect(dx + 23, dy + 16, 2, 16);
                    break;
                case 7: // Question block
                    const qFrame = Math.floor(Date.now() / 200) % 4;
                    const qColors = ['#fa0', '#fc0', '#f80', '#fa0'];
                    ctx.fillStyle = qColors[qFrame];
                    ctx.fillRect(dx, dy, TILE, TILE);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#a60';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx, dy, TILE, 2);
                    ctx.fillRect(dx, dy + TILE - 2, TILE, 2);
                    ctx.fillRect(dx, dy, 2, TILE);
                    ctx.fillRect(dx + TILE - 2, dy, 2, TILE);
                    // Question mark
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
                    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Courier New';
                    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                    ctx.fillText('?', dx + 16, dy + 23);
                    break;
                case 8: // Stone
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx, dy, TILE, TILE);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx + 2, dy + 2, TILE - 4, TILE - 4);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#999';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx + 4, dy + 4, TILE - 8, TILE - 8);
                    break;
                case 9: // Flag pole
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx + 14, dy, 4, TILE);
                    break;
                case 10: // Flag top
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx + 14, dy + 10, 4, TILE - 10);
                    // Flag
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx - 10, dy + 4, 24, 16);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#4d4';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx - 6, dy + 6, 16, 12);
                    break;
                case 11: // Used block
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#886';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx, dy, TILE, TILE);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#664';
                    ctx.fillRect(dx + 2, dy + 2, TILE - 4, TILE - 4);
                    break;
            }
        }
    }
}

function drawEntities() {
    entities.forEach(e => {
        if (e.collected) return;
        const dx = e.x - cameraX;
        if (dx < -64 || dx > W + 64) return;

        if (e.type === 'coin') {
            drawCoin(dx, e.y, e.animFrame);
        } else if (e.type === 'goomba') {
            if (!e.alive && e.deadTimer > 0) {
                drawGoomba(dx, e.y, 0, true);
            } else if (e.alive) {
                drawGoomba(dx, e.y, e.animFrame, false);
            }
        } else if (e.type === 'koopa') {
            if (e.alive) {
                drawKoopa(dx, e.y, e.animFrame, e.inShell);
            }
        } else if (e.type === 'mushroom' && e.active) {
            drawMushroom(dx, e.y);
        } else if (e.type === 'star' && e.active) {
            drawStar(dx, e.y, e.animFrame);
        }
    });
}

function drawParticles() {
    particles.forEach(p => {
        ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
        ctx.fillRect(p.x - cameraX, p.y, p.size, p.size);
    });
}

function drawFloatingTexts() {
    ctx.font = 'bold 14px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    floatingTexts.forEach(t => {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.globalAlpha = t.timer / 40;
        ctx.fillText(t.text, t.x - cameraX, t.y);
    });
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(`MARIO`, 30, 24);
    ctx.fillText(`${String(score).padStart(6, '0')}`, 30, 42);

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(`🪙×${String(coins).padStart(2, '0')}`, W / 2 - 80, 42);

    ctx.fillText(`WORLD`, W / 2 + 60, 24);
    ctx.fillText(`1-1`, W / 2 + 60, 42);

    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText(`TIME`, W - 30, 24);
    ctx.fillText(`${Math.max(0, Math.floor(time))}`, W - 30, 42);

    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    // Lives
    ctx.fillText(`❤️×${lives}`, W - 160, 42);
}

function drawTitleScreen() {

    grad.addColorStop(1, '#000080');

    // Ground
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c84';
    ctx.fillRect(0, H - 80, W, 80);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#6b3';
    ctx.fillRect(0, H - 80, W, 12);

    // Title
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.font = 'bold 56px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('SUPER HTML BROS.', W / 2 + 3, 143);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#e44020';
    ctx.fillText('SUPER HTML BROS.', W / 2, 140);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('★ A Canvas Adventure ★', W / 2, 175);

    ctx.font = '12px Courier New';

        ctx.fillStyle = '#fa0';
        ctx.fillRect(bx, by, TILE, TILE);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#a60';
        ctx.fillRect(bx, by, TILE, 2);
        ctx.fillRect(bx, by + TILE - 2, TILE, 2);
        ctx.fillRect(bx, by, 2, TILE);
        ctx.fillRect(bx + TILE - 2, by, 2, TILE);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.font = 'bold 18px Courier New';
        ctx.fillText('?', bx + 16, by + 23);
    }
}

function drawGameOver() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, H / 2 - 30);
    ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, W / 2, H / 2 + 20);

    const blink = Math.floor(Date.now() / 500) % 2;
    if (blink) {
        ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO RETRY', W / 2, H / 2 + 70);
    }
}

function drawWinScreen() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Fireworks
    const t = Date.now();
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const fx = 100 + i * 150;
        const fy = 100 + Math.sin(t / 300 + i * 2) * 30;
        const colors = ['#e44020', '#ff0', '#0f0', '#0ff', '#f0f'];
        ctx.fillStyle = colors[i];
        for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
            const angle = (j / 8) * Math.PI * 2 + t / 500;
            const dist = 15 + Math.sin(t / 200 + j) * 10;
            ctx.fillRect(fx + Math.cos(angle) * dist, fy + Math.sin(angle) * dist, 4, 4);
        }
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('COURSE CLEAR!', W / 2, H / 2 - 60);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, W / 2, H / 2);
    ctx.fillText(`Coins: ${coins}`, W / 2, H / 2 + 35);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ccc';
    ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Thank you for playing!', W / 2, H / 2 + 80);

    const blink = Math.floor(Date.now() / 500) % 2;
    if (blink) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE FOR TITLE SCREEN', W / 2, H / 2 + 130);
    }
}

// Main game loop
function update() {
    if (gameState === 'playing') {
        if (!player.dead) {
            updatePlayer();
            updateEntities();
            updateCamera();

            // Timer
            timeTimer++;
            if (timeTimer >= 24) {
                timeTimer = 0;
                time--;
                if (time <= 0) die();
            }
        } else {
            player.vy += GRAVITY;
            player.y += player.vy;
            deathTimer--;
            if (deathTimer <= 0) {
                if (lives <= 0) {
                    gameState = 'gameover';
                } else {
                    resetPlayer();
                    cameraX = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        updateParticles();
        updateFloatingTexts();
        updateBlockAnimations();

        if (screenShake > 0) screenShake--;
    }
}

function draw() {
    ctx.save();

    if (screenShake > 0) {
        ctx.translate(Math.random() * screenShake - screenShake / 2, Math.random() * screenShake - screenShake / 2);
    }

    if (gameState === 'title') {
        drawTitleScreen();
    } else if (gameState === 'gameover') {
        drawGameOver();
    } else if (gameState === 'win') {
        drawWinScreen();
    } else {
        drawBackground();
        drawTiles();
        drawEntities();

        // Draw player
        if (!player.dead || deathTimer > 0) {
            if (player.invincible <= 0 || Math.floor(Date.now() / 50) % 2) {
                const ph = player.big ? 64 : 32;
                drawMario(player.x - cameraX, player.y, player.animFrame, player.facing, player.big, player.star);
            }
        }

        drawParticles();
        drawFloatingTexts();
        drawHUD();
    }

    ctx.restore();
}

function gameLoop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// Handle resize
function resize() {
    const scale = Math.min(window.innerWidth / W, window.innerHeight / H) * 0.95;
    canvas.style.width = (W * scale) + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = (H * scale) + 'px';
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

gameLoop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Mini Mario Level</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; background: #5c94fc; overflow: hidden; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; height: 100vh; font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace; }
        canvas { border: 4px solid #000; background: #5c94fc; image-rendering: pixelated; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="400"></canvas>

<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

const player = { x: 50, y: 300, w: 30, h: 30, vx: 0, vy: 0, onGround: false };
const blocks = [
    {x: 0, y: 350, w: 800, h: 50}, // Floor
    {x: 200, y: 250, w: 100, h: 20},
    {x: 400, y: 200, w: 100, h: 20},
    {x: 600, y: 250, w: 100, h: 20}
];

const keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.code] = true);
window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.code] = false);

function update() {
    // Physics
    if (keys['ArrowLeft']) player.vx = -5;
    else if (keys['ArrowRight']) player.vx = 5;
    else player.vx *= 0.8;

    if ((keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['Space']) && player.onGround) {
        player.vy = -15;
        player.onGround = false;
    }

    player.vy += 0.8; // Gravity
    player.x += player.vx;
    player.y += player.vy;

    // Collision
    player.onGround = false;
    blocks.forEach(b => {
        if (player.x < b.x + b.w && player.x + player.w > b.x &&
            player.y < b.y + b.h && player.y + player.h > b.y) {
            
            // Simple snapping
            if (player.vy > 0) {
                player.y = b.y - player.h;
                player.vy = 0;
                player.onGround = true;
            }
        }
    });

    // Boundaries
    if (player.x < 0) player.x = 0;
    if (player.x > 770) player.x = 770;
}

function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 800, 400);
    
    // Draw Blocks
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513';
    blocks.forEach(b => ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h));
    
    // Draw Mario
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FF0000';
    ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h);
    
    // UI
    ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
    ctx.fillText("USE ARROW KEYS TO MOVE & JUMP", 20, 30);
}

function loop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
