<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
body{background:#000;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;height:100vh;overflow:hidden;touch-action:none}
canvas{display:block;image-rendering:pixelated;image-rendering:crisp-edges}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas=document.getElementById('c');
const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const SCALE=3;
const W=256,H=224;
canvas.width=W*SCALE;canvas.height=H*SCALE;
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;

// Audio
const audio=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;
let ac;
function initAudio(){if(!ac)ac=new audio()}
function snd(freq,type,dur,vol=0.3){
  if(!ac)return;
  const o=ac.createOscillator(),g=ac.createGain();
  o.type=type;o.frequency.value=freq;
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,ac.currentTime);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001,ac.currentTime+dur);
  o.connect(g);g.connect(ac.destination);
  o.start();o.stop(ac.currentTime+dur);
}
function sJump(){snd(300,'square',0.1);setTimeout(()=>snd(500,'square',0.1),50)}
function sCoin(){snd(800,'square',0.08);setTimeout(()=>snd(1200,'square',0.08),80)}
function sStomp(){snd(150,'sawtooth',0.15,0.4)}
function sBrick(){snd(400,'square',0.05);setTimeout(()=>snd(200,'square',0.08),30)}
function sWin(){[523,659,784,1047].forEach((f,i)=>setTimeout(()=>snd(f,'square',0.2,0.3),i*120))}
function sDie(){snd(400,'sawtooth',0.3,0.4);setTimeout(()=>snd(200,'sawtooth',0.4,0.4),150)}

// Input
const keys={};
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.code]=true;e.preventDefault()});
document.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.code]=false});
canvas.addEventListener('click',()=>{initAudio();if(gs==='menu'){gs='play';resetGame()}});
document.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{initAudio();if(gs==='menu'){gs='play';resetGame()}});

// Game state
let gs='menu';// menu, play, die, win
let score=0,coins=0,lives=3,time=400,frames=0;
let shakeX=0,shakeY=0;

// Player
let player;
function resetPlayer(){
  player={x:80,y:400,w:12,h:20,vx:0,vy:0,onGround:false,facing:1,
    state:'idle',jumpTimer:0,stompTimer:0,invincible:0,
    wing:0,coinCount:0,dead:false};
}

// Level data
const GROUND_Y=440;
const groundSegs=[
  [0,320],[380,200],[620,180],[840,250],[1140,200],[1400,160],[1620,120],[1800,400]
];
const plats=[
  [300,370,90],[520,340,80],[700,370,100],[950,320,90],[1200,350,80],[1500,300,100],[1700,340,80]
];
const blocks=[
  {x:120,y:412,t:'coin'},{x:200,y:412,t:'coin'},{x:500,y:412,t:'coin'},{x:560,y:382,t:'coin'},
  {x:680,y:412,t:'coin'},{x:930,y:412,t:'coin'},{x:1000,y:382,t:'coin'},{x:1250,y:412,t:'coin'},
  {x:1550,y:412,t:'coin'},{x:1750,y:412,t:'coin'}
];
const coins=[
  [350,340],[420,330],[580,310],[750,340],[800,310],[1000,290],[1100,320],[1600,270],[1750,310]
];
const enemies=[
  {x:250,y:420,w:16,h:16,vx:1,dir:1},
  {x:600,y:420,w:16,h:16,vx:1,dir:-1},
  {x:900,y:420,w:16,h:16,vx:1,dir:1},
  {x:1150,y:420,w:16,h:16,vx:1,dir:-1},
  {x:1700,y:420,w:16,h:16,vx:1,dir:1}
];
const pipes=[
  {x:430,y:440,h:64},{x:1050,y:440,h:64}
];
const flagX=2100;
const flagPoleH=120;

// Particles
let particles=[];
function spawnParticles(x,y,color,count=5){
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
    particles.push({x,y,vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*3,vy:(Math.random()-0.5)*3-1,
      life:30+Math.random()*15,maxLife:45,color,w:3,h:3});
  }
}

function resetGame(){
  score=0;coins=0;lives=3;time=400;frames=0;
  particles=[];
  resetPlayer();
  enemies.forEach(e=>{e.x=e._sx||e.x;e.vx=Math.abs(e.vx)*e.dir});
  blocks.forEach(b=>b.hit=false);
}

function resetLevel(){
  resetPlayer();
  blocks.forEach(b=>b.hit=false);
  enemies.forEach(e=>{e.x=e._sx||e.x;e.vx=Math.abs(e.vx)*e.dir});
  particles=[];
}

// Camera
let cam={x:0,y:0};
function updateCam(){
  const target=player.x-W/3;
  cam.x+=(target-cam.x)*0.1;
  cam.x=Math.max(0,Math.min(cam.x,3200-W));
}

// Collision helpers
function rectOverlap(a,b){
  return a.x<b.x+b.w&&a.x+a.w>b.x&&a.y<b.y+b.h&&a.y+a.h>b.y;
}
function pointInRect(px,py,r){
  return px>r.x&&px<r.x+r.w&&py>r.y&&py<r.y+r.h;
}

function isSolid(x,y){
  // Check ground segments
  for(const[sx,sw]of groundSegs){
    if(x>=sx&&x<sx+sw&&y>=GROUND_Y&&y<GROUND_Y+40)return true;
  }
  // Check platforms
  for(const[px,py,pw]of plats){
    if(x>=px&&x<px+pw&&y>=py&&y<py+20)return true;
  }
  // Check blocks
  for(const b of blocks){
    if(!b.hit&&x>=b.x&&x<b.x+16&&y>=b.y&&y<b.y+16)return true;
  }
  // Check pipes
  for(const p of pipes){
    if(x>=p.x-4&&x<p.x+20&&y>=p.y&&y<p.y+p.h)return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function getTileAt(px,py){
  for(const[sx,sw]of groundSegs){
    if(px>=sx&&px<sx+sw&&py>=GROUND_Y&&py<GROUND_Y+40)return'ground';
  }
  for(const[px2,py2,pw]of plats){
    if(px>=px2&&px<px2+pw&&py>=py2&&py<py2+20)return'platform';
  }
  for(const b of blocks){
    if(!b.hit&&px>=b.x&&px<b.x+16&&py>=b.y&&py<b.y+16)return'block';
  }
  for(const p of pipes){
    if(px>=p.x-4&&px<p.x+20&&py>=p.y&&py<p.y+p.h)return'pipe';
  }
  return null;
}

// Update player
function updatePlayer(){
  if(player.dead)return;
  
  const speed=3.5;
  const jumpForce=-9.5;
  const gravity=0.45;
  const maxFall=12;
  
  // Horizontal input
  let moveX=0;
  if(keys['ArrowLeft']||keys['KeyA'])moveX=-1;
  if(keys['ArrowRight']||keys['KeyD'])moveX=1;
  
  if(moveX!==0){
    player.vx=moveX*speed;
    player.facing=moveX;
    player.state='running';
    player.wing=(player.wing+0.3)%(Math.PI*2);
  }else{
    player.vx*=0.8;
    if(Math.abs(player.vx)<0.1)player.vx=0;
    player.state='idle';
  }
  
  // Jump
  if((keys['ArrowUp']||keys['KeyW']||keys['Space'])&&player.onGround&&player.jumpTimer<=0){
    player.vy=jumpForce;
    player.onGround=false;
    player.jumpTimer=10;
    sJump();
  }
  if(player.jumpTimer>0)player.jumpTimer--;
  
  // Gravity
  player.vy+=gravity;
  if(player.vy>maxFall)player.vy=maxFall;
  
  // Move X
  player.x+=player.vx;
  // X collision
  if(isSolid(player.x,player.y))player.x-=player.vx;
  if(isSolid(player.x+player.w,player.y))player.x-=player.vx;
  
  // Move Y
  player.y+=player.vy;
  player.onGround=false;
  
  // Y collision
  if(player.vy>0){
    if(isSolid(player.x,player.y+player.h)||isSolid(player.x+player.w,player.y+player.h)){
      player.y=Math.floor((player.y+player.h)/20)*20-player.h;
      player.vy=0;
      player.onGround=true;
      // Landing dust
      if(player.vy===0&&frames%2===0)spawnParticles(player.x+player.w/2,player.y+player.h,0x8B4513,1);
    }
  }
  if(player.vy<0){
    if(isSolid(player.x,player.y)||isSolid(player.x+player.w,player.y)){
      player.y=Math.ceil((player.y+player.h)/20)*20;
      player.vy=0;
    }
  }
  
  // Check blocks from above
  for(const b of blocks){
    if(!b.hit&&rectOverlap(player,{x:b.x,y:b.y,w:16,h:16})){
      if(player.vy<=0&&player.y+player.h<=b.y+4){
        b.hit=true;
        player.vy=-4;
        sBrick();
        if(b.t==='coin'){
          coins++;score+=100;sCoin();
          spawnParticles(b.x+8,b.y+8,0xFFD700,8);
          if(coins%100===0)lives++;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  // Check coins
  for(let i=coins.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const[cx,cy]=coins[i];
    const dx=player.x+player.w/2-cx;
    const dy=player.y+player.h/2-cy;
    if(Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)<14){
      coins.splice(i,1);
      score+=200;sCoin();
      spawnParticles(cx,cy,0xFFD700,6);
      coins++;
      if(coins%100===0)lives++;
    }
  }
  
  // Check enemies
  for(const e of enemies){
    if(e.dead)continue;
    const eRect={x:e.x,y:e.y,w:e.w,h:e.h};
    if(rectOverlap(player,eRect)){
      // Stomp
      if(player.vy>0&&player.y+player.h<e.y+e.h/2){
        e.dead=true;
        player.vy=-6;
        sStomp();
        score+=200;
        spawnParticles(e.x+e.w/2,e.y+e.h/2,0x8B4513,8);
        shakeX=(Math.random()-0.5)*4;
        shakeY=(Math.random()-0.5)*4;
      }else if(player.invincible<=0){
        playerHit();
      }
    }
  }
  
  // Check pipes (standing on top)
  for(const p of pipes){
    if(player.x+player.w>p.x-4&&player.x<p.x+20&&player.vy>=0){
      const py=p.y+p.h-4;
      if(player.y+player.h>=py&&player.y+player.h<=py+8){
        player.y=py-player.h;
        player.vy=0;
        player.onGround=true;
      }
    }
  }
  
  // Check flag
  if(player.x+player.w>flagX-8&&player.x<flagX+8&&player.y<GROUND_Y-flagPoleH+20){
    if(player.y<GROUND_Y-flagPoleH){
      winGame();
    }
  }
  
  // Invincibility
  if(player.invincible>0)player.invincible--;
  
  // Bounds check
  if(player.y>500){playerDie();}
  if(player.x<-50){playerDie();}
  
  // Wing animation
  if(player.state==='running')player.wing+=0.15;
}

function playerHit(){
  if(player.invincible>0)return;
  lives--;
  sDie();
  shakeX=8;shakeY=8;
  if(lives<=0){gameOver();return;}
  player.invincible=90;
  player.vy=-7;
  player.vx=0;
}

function playerDie(){
  player.dead=true;
  sDie();shakeX=10;shakeY=10;
  gs='die';
  setTimeout(()=>{if(gs==='die'){resetLevel();gs='play'}},1500);
}

function gameOver(){
  gs='gameover';
  setTimeout(()=>{resetGame();gs='menu'},3000);
}

function winGame(){
  gs='win';
  sWin();
  shakeX=6;shakeY=6;
  setTimeout(()=>{resetGame();score+=5000;gs='menu'},3000);
}

// Update enemies
function updateEnemies(){
  for(const e of enemies){
    if(e.dead){e.deadTimer=(e.deadTimer||0)+1;continue;}
    e.x+=e.vx*1.5;
    // Turn at edges
    const ahead=e.x+e.vx*16;
    if(isSolid(ahead,e.y)||isSolid(ahead,e.y+8)){
      e.vx*=-1;
      e.dir*=-1;
    }
    // Turn at walls
    if(isSolid(e.x+e.vx*16,e.y)){
      e.vx*=-1;
      e.dir*=-1;
    }
  }
}

// Update particles
function updateParticles(){
  for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=particles[i];
    p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.vy+=0.1;p.life--;
    if(p.life<=0)particles.splice(i,1);
  }
}

// Update game
function update(){
  if(gs!=='play')return;
  frames++;
  time=Math.max(0,time-Math.floor(frames/60));
  if(time<=0){lives--;if(lives<=0){gameOver();return;}resetLevel();}
  
  updatePlayer();
  updateEnemies();
  updateParticles();
  updateCam();
  
  // Screen shake decay
  shakeX*=0.85;shakeY*=0.85;
  if(Math.abs(shakeX)<0.5)shakeX=0;
  if(Math.abs(shakeY)<0.5)shakeY=0;
}

// Drawing functions
function drawSky(){
  const grad=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  grad.addColorStop(0,'#004488');
  grad.addColorStop(0.5,'#4488CC');
  grad.addColorStop(1,'#88BBEE');
  ctx.fillStyle=grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
}

function drawClouds(cx){
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFFFFF';
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const x=((i*250-cx*0.15)%700+700)%700-100;
    const y=30+i*25;
    drawCloud(x,y,40+i%3*10);
  }
}

function drawCloud(x,y,s){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x,y,s*0.5,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.arc(x+s*0.3,y-s*0.1,s*0.4,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.arc(x+s*0.6,y+s*0.1,s*0.35,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.arc(x+s*0.3,y+s*0.2,s*0.45,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawMountains(cx){
  ctx.fillStyle='#224422';
  // Far mountains
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0,H);
  for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=20){
    const wx=x+cx*0.1;
    const h=Math.sin(wx*0.005)*40+Math.sin(wx*0.012)*20+30;
    ctx.lineTo(x,H-h);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W,H);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  
  ctx.fillStyle='#335533';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0,H);
  for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=15){
    const wx=x+cx*0.2;
    const h=Math.sin(wx*0.008+1)*30+Math.sin(wx*0.02)*15+25;
    ctx.lineTo(x,H-h);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W,H);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
}

function drawGround(cx){
  // Ground base
  ctx.fillStyle='#006600';
  for(const[sx,sw]of groundSegs){
    const sx2=sx-cx;
    if(sx2+sw<-20||sx2>W+20)continue;
    ctx.fillRect(Math.max(0,sx2),GROUND_Y,Math.min(sw,W-Math.max(0,sx2)),40);
  }
  
  // Ground top
  ctx.fillStyle='#00AA00';
  for(const[sx,sw]of groundSegs){
    const sx2=sx-cx;
    if(sx2+sw<-20||sx2>W+20)continue;
    ctx.fillRect(Math.max(0,sx2),GROUND_Y,Math.min(sw,W-Math.max(0,sx2)),4);
  }
  
  // Ground detail lines
  ctx.fillStyle='#008800';
  for(const[sx,sw]of groundSegs){
    const sx2=sx-cx;
    if(sx2+sw<-20||sx2>W+20)continue;
    for(let gx=sx2;gx<sx2+sw;gx+=16){
      if(gx>=0&&gx<W&&gx%32<16){
        ctx.fillRect(gx,GROUND_Y+8,1,4);
        ctx.fillRect(gx+8,GROUND_Y+20,1,4);
      }
    }
  }
}

function drawPlatforms(cx){
  for(const[px,py,pw]of plats){
    const sx=px-cx;
    if(sx+pw<-20||sx>W+20)continue;
    // Platform top
    ctx.fillStyle='#AA8844';
    ctx.fillRect(sx,py,pw,4);
    // Platform body
    ctx.fillStyle='#886633';
    ctx.fillRect(sx,py+4,pw,py-GROUND_Y+40-py-4>0?py-GROUND_Y-py+4:0);
    // Platform detail
    ctx.fillStyle='#997744';
    for(let bx=0;bx<pw;bx+=16){
      ctx.fillRect(sx+bx,py+12,8,2);
      ctx.fillRect(sx+bx+4,py+20,8,2);
    }
  }
}

function drawBlocks(cx){
  for(const b of blocks){
    if(b.hit)continue;
    const sx=b.x-cx;
    if(sx<-20||sx>W+20)continue;
    // Brick
    ctx.fillStyle='#C47A20';
    ctx.fillRect(sx,b.y,16,16);
    // Highlight
    ctx.fillStyle='#D48A30';
    ctx.fillRect(sx,b.y,16,2);
    ctx.fillRect(sx,b.y,2,16);
    // Question mark
    ctx.fillStyle='#FFDD00';
    ctx.font='10px "Press Start 2P"';
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('?',sx+8,b.y+12);
  }
}

function drawCoins(cx){
  for(const[cx2,cy]of coins){
    const sx=cx2-cx;
    if(sx<-10||sx>W+10)continue;
    const bob=Math.sin(frames*0.05+cx2)*3;
    ctx.fillStyle='#FFD700';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx,cy+bob,6,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#FFEC80';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx-1,cy+bob-1,3,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawPipes(cx){
  for(const p of pipes){
    const sx=p.x-4-cx;
    if(sx+24<-20||sx>W+20)continue;
    // Pipe body
    ctx.fillStyle='#00AA00';
    ctx.fillRect(sx,p.y,20,p.h);
    // Pipe rim top
    ctx.fillStyle='#00CC00';
    ctx.fillRect(sx-2,p.y,24,6);
    // Pipe rim bottom
    ctx.fillRect(sx-2,p.y+p.h-6,24,6);
    // Pipe highlight
    ctx.fillStyle='#33DD33';
    ctx.fillRect(sx+2,p.y+6,3,p.h-12);
  }
}

function drawFlag(cx){
  const sx=flagX-cx;
  if(sx<-20||sx>W+20)return;
  // Pole
  ctx.fillStyle='#CCCCCC';
  ctx.fillRect(sx,GROUND_Y-flagPoleH,4,flagPoleH);
  // Flag
  ctx.fillStyle='#FF0000';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(sx+4,GROUND_Y-flagPoleH);
  ctx.lineTo(sx+28,GROUND_Y-flagPoleH+15);
  ctx.lineTo(sx+4,GROUND_Y-flagPoleH+30);
  ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  // Flag stripes
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFFFFF';
  ctx.fillRect(sx+10,GROUND_Y-flagPoleH+5,4,10);
  // Ball on top
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFD700';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx+2,GROUND_Y-flagPoleH-4,5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
}

function drawEnemy(e,cx){
  if(e.dead){
    const sx=e.x-cx;
    const alpha=Math.max(0,1-(e.deadTimer||0)/30);
    ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;
    // Dead enemy (sideways)
    ctx.fillStyle='#8B4513';
    ctx.fillRect(sx-4,e.y+4,24,8);
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;
    return;
  }
  const sx=e.x-cx;
  if(sx<-20||sx>W+20)return;
  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle='#8B4513';
  ctx.fillRect(sx,e.y,16,16);
  // Head bump
  ctx.fillStyle='#A0522D';
  ctx.fillRect(sx-1,e.y-3,18,5);
  // Eyes
  const dir=e.dir;
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFFFFF';
  ctx.fillRect(sx+(dir>0?10:2),e.y+4,4,4);
  ctx.fillStyle='#000';
  ctx.fillRect(sx+(dir>0?11:3),e.y+5,2,2);
  // Feet
  ctx.fillStyle='#8B4513';
  ctx.fillRect(sx+(dir>0?0:8),e.y+16,8,4);
  ctx.fillRect(sx+(dir>0?8:0),e.y+16,8,4);
}

function drawPlayer(p,cx){
  if(p.dead)return;
  const sx=p.x-cx;
  const sy=p.y;
  const flicker=p.invincible>0&&Math.floor(p.invincible/3)%2===0;
  if(flicker)return;
  
  const dir=p.facing;
  const walkOffset=Math.sin(frames*0.3)*2;
  
  ctx.save();
  if(dir<0)ctx.scale(-1,1);
  
  // Shoes
  ctx.fillStyle='#8B4513';
  ctx.fillRect(1,18,6,4);
  ctx.fillRect(7,18-walkOffset*0.5,6,4);
  // Legs
  ctx.fillStyle='#0055AA';
  ctx.fillRect(1,14,5,5);
  ctx.fillRect(7,14+walkOffset,5,5);
  // Body (overalls)
  ctx.fillStyle='#FF0000';
  ctx.fillRect(0,8,12,8);
  // Overall straps
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFFFFF';
  ctx.fillRect(1,8,2,4);
  ctx.fillRect(9,8,2,4);
  // Overalls body
  ctx.fillStyle='#0000AA';
  ctx.fillRect(1,12,10,4);
  // Arms
  ctx.fillStyle='#FF0000';
  ctx.fillRect(-3,9,3,4);
  ctx.fillRect(12,9+walkOffset,3,4);
  // Head
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFCC99';
  ctx.fillRect(1,2,10,7);
  // Cap
  ctx.fillStyle='#FF0000';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,12,4);
  ctx.fillRect(-1,2,14,2);
  // M on cap
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFFFFF';
  ctx.fillRect(4,1,4,2);
  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFFFFF';
  ctx.fillRect(6,3,3,2);
  ctx.fillStyle='#000';
  ctx.fillRect(7,4,1,1);
  // Mustache
  ctx.fillStyle='#8B4513';
  ctx.fillRect(5,6,6,1);
  // Nose
  ctx.fillStyle='#FF9966';
  ctx.fillRect(9,5,2,2);
  
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticlesLayer(){
  for(const p of particles){
    const alpha=p.life/p.maxLife;
    ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;
    ctx.fillStyle='#'+p.color.toString(16).padStart(6,'0');
    ctx.fillRect(p.x-cam.x,p.y,p.w,p.h);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}

// HUD
function drawHUD(){
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFFFFF';
  ctx.font='8px "Press Start 2P"';
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText('MARIO',8,12);
  ctx.fillText('×'+lives,8,24);
  
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE',W/2,12);
  ctx.fillText(score.toString().padStart(6,'0'),W/2,24);
  
  ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillText('COINS',W-8,12);
  ctx.fillText(coins.toString().padStart(2,'0'),W-8,24);
  ctx.fillText('TIME',W-8,36);
  ctx.fillText(time.toString().padStart(4,'0'),W-8,48);
  
  // Star icons
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFD700';
  ctx.font='8px serif';
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText('★',36,14);
  ctx.fillText('★',36,38);
}

// Menu screen
function drawMenu(){
  drawSky();
  drawClouds(0);
  drawMountains(0);
  
  // Title
  ctx.fillStyle='#FF0000';
  ctx.font='16px "Press Start 2P"';
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('SUPER',W/2,70);
  ctx.fillStyle('#FFCC00');
  ctx.fillText('MARIO',W/2,90);
  ctx.fillStyle='#0066FF';
  ctx.fillText('BROS.',W/2,110);
  
  // Ground
  ctx.fillStyle='#00AA00';
  ctx.fillRect(0,GROUND_Y,W,40);
  ctx.fillStyle='#008800';
  ctx.fillRect(0,GROUND_Y,W,4);
  
  // Instructions
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFFFFF';
  ctx.font='6px "Press Start 2P"';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE OR CLICK TO START',W/2,160);
  ctx.fillText('ARROWS / WASD TO MOVE',W/2,175);
  ctx.fillText('SPACE TO JUMP',W/2,190);
  ctx.fillText('STOMP ENEMIES FROM ABOVE!',W/2,205);
}

function drawGameOver(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.fillStyle='#FF0000';
  ctx.font='12px "Press Start 2P"';
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('GAME OVER',W/2,H/2-10);
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFFFFF';
  ctx.font='6px "Press Start 2P"';
  ctx.fillText('FINAL SCORE: '+score,W/2,H/2+15);
  ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO RETRY',W/2,H/2+40);
}

function drawWin(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFD700';
  ctx.font='12px "Press Start 2P"';
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('FLAG POLE!',W/2,H/2-10);
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFFFFF';
  ctx.font='6px "Press Start 2P"';
  ctx.fillText('YOU WIN! SCORE: '+score,W/2,H/2+15);
}

// Main render
function render(){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.scale(SCALE,SCALE);
  ctx.translate(shakeX,shakeY);
  
  if(gs==='menu'){
    drawMenu();
  }else{
    drawSky();
    drawClouds(cam.x);
    drawMountains(cam.x);
    drawGround(cam.x);
    drawPlatforms(cam.x);
    drawBlocks(cam.x);
    drawCoins(cam.x);
    drawPipes(cam.x);
    drawFlag(cam.x);
    
    // Sort enemies by y for depth
    const sortedEnemies=[...enemies].sort((a,b)=>a.y-b.y);
    for(const e of sortedEnemies)drawEnemy(e,cam.x);
    
    drawPlayer(player,cam.x);
    drawParticlesLayer();
    drawHUD();
    
    if(gs==='die')drawGameOver();
    if(gs==='win')drawWin();
  }
  
  ctx.restore();
}

// Game loop
let lastTime=0;
const step=1000/60;
let accumulator=0;

function gameLoop(timestamp){
  const dt=timestamp-lastTime;
  lastTime=timestamp;
  accumulator+=dt;
  
  while(accumulator>=step){
    update();
    accumulator-=step;
  }
  
  render();
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// Init
resetPlayer();
requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);

// Touch controls
let touchStartX=0;
let touchJumping=false;
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  initAudio();
  touchStartX=e.touches[0].clientX;
  if(gs==='menu'){gs='play';resetGame()}
},{passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove',e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  const dx=e.touches[0].clientX-touchStartX;
  keys['ArrowRight']=dx>20;
  keys['ArrowLeft']=dx<-20;
},{passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('touchend',e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  keys['ArrowRight']=false;keys['ArrowLeft']=false;
  if(!touchJumping){
    keys['Space']=true;
    setTimeout(()=>keys['Space']=false,50);
  }
  touchJumping=false;
},{passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('touchcancel',()=>{
  keys['ArrowRight']=false;keys['ArrowLeft']=false;keys['Space']=false;
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

question: mario-level-ui
prompt: Recreate a Super Mario Bros. level — make it interactive and fun, feel free to get creative and showcase your skills. Stick to the spirit of nintendo games. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Super Plumber World 1-1 style</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#111;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace}
  canvas{width:min(100vw,calc(100vh*1.6));image-rendering:pixelated;background:#5c94fc;box-shadow:0 0 40px #000}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="384" height="240"></canvas>
<script>
const cv=document.getElementById('c'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
const W=384,H=240,T=16,ROWS=15,COLS=215;
// ---------- audio ----------
let AC;
function beep(f,d=.1,type='square',slide=0,vol=.06){
  try{AC=AC||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
  const o=AC.createOscillator(),g=AC.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.value=f;
  if(slide)o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(30,f+slide),AC.currentTime+d);
  g.gain.value=vol;g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,AC.currentTime+d);
  o.connect(g);g.connect(AC.destination);o.start();o.stop(AC.currentTime+d);}catch(e){}
}
const sfx={
  jump:()=>beep(300,.25,'square',500),
  coin:()=>{beep(988,.08);setTimeout(()=>beep(1319,.3),70)},
  stomp:()=>beep(200,.12,'square',-100),
  bump:()=>beep(110,.08,'triangle'),
  brick:()=>beep(90,.2,'sawtooth',-40),
  power:()=>[0,1,2,3,4,5].forEach(i=>setTimeout(()=>beep(400+i*100,.08),i*50)),
  hurt:()=>beep(400,.4,'sawtooth',-300),
  die:()=>[500,420,350,260].forEach((f,i)=>setTimeout(()=>beep(f,.2,'triangle'),i*150)),
  flag:()=>beep(1000,.9,'triangle',-800),
  win:()=>[523,659,784,1047,784,1047].forEach((f,i)=>setTimeout(()=>beep(f,.18,'square'),i*140)),
  up:()=>[600,800,1000,1300].forEach((f,i)=>setTimeout(()=>beep(f,.1),i*60))
};
// ---------- level ----------
// tiles: 0 air,1 ground,2 brick,3 question,4 used,5 hard block,6/7 pipe top L/R,8/9 pipe body L/R
const map=[...Array(ROWS)].map(()=>Array(COLS).fill(0));
const content={}; // "x,y" -> 'coin' | 'mush' | 'multi'
const gaps=[[69,70],[86,88],[121,122],[152,153]];
for(let x=0;x<COLS;x++){
  if(gaps.some(g=>x>=g[0]&&x<=g[1]))continue;
  map[13][x]=1;map[14][x]=1;
}
function set(x,y,t,c){map[y][x]=t;if(c)content[x+','+y]=c}
function pipe(x,h){for(let i=0;i<h;i++){const y=13-h+i;const top=i==0;set(x,y,top?6:8);set(x+1,y,top?7:9)}}
function row(x,y,n,t=2){for(let i=0;i<n;i++)set(x+i,y,t)}
function stairs(x,n,dir){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const hh=i+1;for(let j=0;j<hh;j++)set(dir>0?x+i:x-i,12-j,5)}}
set(16,9,3,'coin');
set(20,9,2);set(21,9,3,'mush');set(22,9,2);set(23,9,3,'coin');set(24,9,2);
set(22,5,3,'coin');
pipe(28,2);pipe(38,3);pipe(46,4);pipe(57,4);
row(78,9,3);set(81,9,3,'coin');row(82,9,2);
row(90,9,5);row(93,5,4);set(95,5,3,'multi');
set(100,9,3,'coin');set(103,9,2);set(106,9,3,'mush');
row(110,9,2);row(113,6,3);
pipe(125,2);pipe(133,3);
row(140,9,4);set(144,9,3,'coin');
stairs(160,4,1);stairs(172,4,-1);
stairs(178,8,1);
// flag pole at 198, castle 204
const POLE=198*T+7;
// coins floating
let coins=[];
function arc(x,y,n){for(let i=0;i<n;i++)coins.push({x:(x+i)*T+8,y:y*T+8,got:0})}
arc(33,9,3);arc(49,6,4);arc(65,10,3);arc(87,7,1);arc(118,8,4);arc(145,6,4);arc(155,9,3);
// ---------- state ----------
let keys={},pressed={};
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!keys[e.code])pressed[e.code]=1;keys[e.code]=1;if(e.code.startsWith('Arrow')||e.code=='Space')e.preventDefault()});
addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.code]=0);
let P,enemies,items,parts,bumps,pops,cam,score=0,coinCount=0,lives=3,time=300,state='title',stTimer=0,tick=0,flagY=0,best=0;
const goombaX=[22,36,42,52,55,62,80,82,96,98,106,112,115,128,137,142,147,165,190];
function reset(full){
  if(full){score=0;coinCount=0;lives=3;}
  time=300;
  for(let y=0;y<ROWS;y++)for(let x=0;x<COLS;x++){}
  P={x:40,y:180,w:12,h:14,vx:0,vy:0,big:false,ground:false,face:1,inv:0,anim:0,dead:false,grow:0};
  enemies=goombaX.map(g=>({x:g*T+ (g%3),y:180,w:14,h:14,vx:-.35,vy:0,dead:0,flip:0,active:false,t:0}));
  items=[];parts=[];bumps=[];pops=[];cam=0;flagY=2*T+8;
  coins.forEach(c=>c.got=0);
  state='play';
}
// restore question blocks on full restart
const origMap=null;
function tileAt(x,y){if(x<0)return 5;if(y<0||y>=ROWS)return 0;if(x>=COLS)return 5;return map[y][x]}
const solid=t=>t>0;
// generic body move
function move(e,isP){
  e.x+=e.vx;
  let x0=Math.floor(e.x/T),x1=Math.floor((e.x+e.w-.01)/T),y0=Math.floor(e.y/T),y1=Math.floor((e.y+e.h-.01)/T);
  e.hitX=false;
  for(let ty=y0;ty<=y1;ty++)for(let tx=x0;tx<=x1;tx++)if(solid(tileAt(tx,ty))){
    if(e.vx>0)e.x=tx*T-e.w;else if(e.vx<0)e.x=(tx+1)*T;
    e.vx=isP?0:e.vx;e.hitX=true;
    x0=Math.floor(e.x/T);x1=Math.floor((e.x+e.w-.01)/T);
  }
  e.y+=e.vy;e.ground=false;
  x0=Math.floor(e.x/T);x1=Math.floor((e.x+e.w-.01)/T);y0=Math.floor(e.y/T);y1=Math.floor((e.y+e.h-.01)/T);
  for(let ty=y0;ty<=y1;ty++)for(let tx=x0;tx<=x1;tx++)if(solid(tileAt(tx,ty))){
    if(e.vy>0){e.y=ty*T-e.h;e.ground=true;e.vy=0}
    else if(e.vy<0){e.y=(ty+1)*T;e.vy=0;if(isP)bump(tx,ty)}
    y0=Math.floor(e.y/T);y1=Math.floor((e.y+e.h-.01)/T);
  }
}
function addPop(x,y,txt){pops.push({x,y,txt,t:40})}
function bump(tx,ty){
  const t=map[ty][tx],k=tx+','+ty;
  if(t==3){
    bumps.push({x:tx,y:ty,t:8});
    const c=content[k];
    if(c=='mush'){
      items.push({type:P.big?'flower':'mush',x:tx*T,y:ty*T,w:14,h:14,vx:.7,vy:0,rise:16,tx,ty});sfx.bump();
    }else{
      coinCount++;score+=200;sfx.coin();addPop(tx*T,ty*T-8,200);
      items.push({type:'coinpop',x:tx*T+4,y:ty*T-8,vy:-5,t:0,w:8,h:14});
      if(c=='multi'){content[k]='multi';content.count=(content.count||0)+1;if(content.count<6)return}
    }
    map[ty][tx]=4;
  }else if(t==2){
    if(P.big){map[ty][tx]=0;sfx.brick();score+=50;
      for(let i=0;i<4;i++)parts.push({x:tx*T+(i%2)*8,y:ty*T+(i>>1)*8,vx:(i%2?1.5:-1.5),vy:-4-(i>>1)*-1.5,c:'#c84c0c'});
    }else{bumps.push({x:tx,y:ty,t:8});sfx.bump()}
  }else sfx.bump();
  // kill enemies on top
  enemies.forEach(e=>{if(!e.dead&&Math.abs(e.x+7-(tx*T+8))<12&&Math.abs(e.y+e.h-ty*T)<3){e.dead=2;e.vy=-3;e.vx=0;score+=100;sfx.stomp()}});
}
function hurt(){
  if(P.inv>0||state!='play')return;
  if(P.big){P.big=false;P.y+=14;P.h=14;P.inv=120;sfx.hurt()}
  else die();
}
function die(){state='dead';stTimer=0;P.vy=-6;P.vx=0;sfx.die()}
// ---------- update ----------
function update(){
  tick++;
  if(state=='title'){if(pressed.Enter||pressed.Space){reset(true)}return}
  if(state=='gameover'||state=='win'){if(pressed.Enter){state='title'; resetMap();}return}
  if(state=='dead'){stTimer++;if(stTimer>20){P.vy+=.3;P.y+=P.vy}
    if(stTimer>160){lives--;if(lives<=0){state='gameover'}else reset(false)}return}
  if(state=='flag'){
    stTimer++;
    if(stTimer<70){ if(P.y+P.h<13*T){P.y+=2;} flagY=Math.min(flagY+2,12*T-4); P.x=POLE-10;}
    else if(stTimer<100){P.x=POLE+4;P.face=-1}
    else{ P.face=1;P.vy+=.4;P.vx=1;move(P,false);P.anim+=.3;
      if(P.x>204*T+8){state='win';sfx.win();score+=Math.floor(time)*10;best=Math.max(best,score)} }
    cam=Math.min(Math.max(P.x-W/2,0),COLS*T-W);return;
  }
  // timer
  time-=1/60*2.2;if(time<=0){time=0;die();return}
  // player control
  const L=keys.ArrowLeft||keys.KeyA,R=keys.ArrowRight||keys.KeyD;
  const run=keys.ShiftLeft||keys.ShiftRight||keys.KeyX||keys.KeyK;
  const jumpKey=keys.Space||keys.ArrowUp||keys.KeyW||keys.KeyZ||keys.KeyJ;
  const max=run?2.4:1.5,acc=run?.12:.08;
  if(L&&!R){P.vx-=P.vx>0?acc*2.5:acc;P.face=-1}
  else if(R&&!L){P.vx+=P.vx<0?acc*2.5:acc;P.face=1}
  else{P.vx*=.86;if(Math.abs(P.vx)<.05)P.vx=0}
  P.vx=Math.max(-max,Math.min(max,P.vx));
  if(jumpKey&&(pressed.Space||pressed.ArrowUp||pressed.KeyW||pressed.KeyZ||pressed.KeyJ)&&P.ground){P.vy=-5.2-Math.abs(P.vx)*.25;sfx.jump()}
  P.vy+=(jumpKey&&P.vy<0)?.2:.45;if(P.vy>6)P.vy=6;
  move(P,true);
  if(P.x<cam)P.x=cam; 
  if(P.ground&&Math.abs(P.vx)>.1)P.anim+=Math.abs(P.vx)*.12;else if(!P.ground)P.anim=1;
  if(P.inv>0)P.inv--;
  if(P.y>ROWS*T+20){die();return}
  // flag
  if(P.x+P.w>POLE-2&&P.x<POLE+4){state='flag';stTimer=0;sfx.flag();
    const h=Math.max(0,13*T-(P.y+P.h));score+=Math.round(100+h*4/10)*10; return}
  // coins
  coins.forEach(c=>{if(!c.got&&Math.abs(c.x-(P.x+P.w/2))<10&&Math.abs(c.y-(P.y+P.h/2))<(P.h/2+6)){c.got=1;coinCount++;score+=200;sfx.coin();if(coinCount%100==0){lives++;sfx.up()}}});
  // enemies
  enemies.forEach(e=>{
    if(!e.active&&e.x<cam+W+40)e.active=true;
    if(!e.active)return;
    if(e.dead==1){e.t++;return}
    if(e.dead==2){e.vy+=.4;e.y+=e.vy;return}
    e.vy+=.35;if(e.vy>5)e.vy=5;
    const ovx=e.vx;move(e,false);if(e.hitX)e.vx=-ovx;
    // turn around at cliffs? no, let them fall
    if(e.y>ROWS*T+20)e.dead=2;
    e.t++;
    if(Math.abs(e.x-P.x)<14&&Math.abs(e.y-P.y)<30&&P.x<e.x+e.w&&P.x+P.w>e.x&&P.y<e.y+e.h&&P.y+P.h>e.y){
      if(P.vy>0&&P.y+P.h-e.y<11){e.dead=1;e.t=0;P.vy=keys.Space||keys.ArrowUp||keys.KeyZ?-6:-3.5;score+=100;addPop(e.x,e.y-8,100);sfx.stomp()}
      else hurt();
    }
  });
  enemies=enemies.filter(e=>!(e.dead==1&&e.t>25));
  // items
  items.forEach(it=>{
    if(it.type=='coinpop'){it.vy+=.4;it.y+=it.vy;it.t++;if(it.t>22)it.gone=1;return}
    if(it.rise>0){it.y-=.6;it.rise-=.6;return}
    it.vy+=.35;const o=it.vx;move(it,false);if(it.hitX)it.vx=-o;
    if(it.y>300)it.gone=1;
    if(P.x<it.x+it.w&&P.x+P.w>it.x&&P.y<it.y+it.h&&P.y+P.h>it.y){
      it.gone=1;score+=1000;addPop(it.x,it.y-8,1000);
      if(!P.big){P.big=true;P.y-=14;P.h=28;P.inv=30;}
      sfx.power();
    }
  });
  items=items.filter(i=>!i.gone);
  parts.forEach(p=>{p.vy+=.35;p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy});parts=parts.filter(p=>p.y<300);
  bumps.forEach(b=>b.t--);bumps=bumps.filter(b=>b.t>0);
  pops.forEach(p=>{p.y-=.6;p.t--});pops=pops.filter(p=>p.t>0);
  cam=Math.max(cam,Math.min(P.x-W/2+20,COLS*T-W));
}
function resetMap(){ // rebuild questions/bricks
  for(const k in content){}
  for(let y=0;y<ROWS;y++)for(let x=0;x<COLS;x++){ if(map[y][x]==4)map[y][x]=3 }
  content.count=0;
  // bricks broken can't be recovered without a copy; reload page for full restore
  location.reload();
}
// ---------- drawing ----------
function R(c,x,y,w,h){ctx.fillStyle=c;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(x),Math.round(y),w,h)}
function drawBG(){
  ctx.fillStyle='#5c94fc';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  // clouds
  for(let i=0;i<14;i++){const cx=i*170+30-cam*.3,cy=24+(i*37%50);
    const x=((cx%(14*170))+14*170)%(14*170)-60;
    cloud(x,cy,1+(i%3)*.4)}
  // hills

  else if(Math.abs(P.vx)>.1){ if(wk){R('#8c4a10',dx+3,dy+12,5,2);R('#8c4a10',dx+9,dy+13,4,1)}else{R('#8c4a10',dx+5,dy+12,4,2);R('#8c4a10',dx+9,dy+12,5,2)} }

prompt: Recreate a Super Mario Bros. level — make it interactive and fun, feel free to get creative and showcase your skills. Stick to the spirit of nintendo games. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>Super Mario Bros. – Level 1-1</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        body {
            background: #000;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            height: 100vh;
            font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        canvas {
            border: 4px solid #333;
            image-rendering: pixelated;
            cursor: default;
            max-width: 100vw;
            max-height: 100vh;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <canvas id="gameCanvas" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        const CW = 800,
            CH = 600;

        // ====== CONSTANTS ======
        const GRAVITY = 0.45;
        const MOVE_SPEED = 3.2;
        const JUMP_FORCE = -11.5;
        const MAX_FALL = 13;
        const PLAYER_W = 26;
        const PLAYER_H = 32;
        const LEVEL_W = 3400;

        // ====== AUDIO ======
        let audioCtx = null;

        function initAudio() { if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new(window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(); }

        function playSound(freq, dur, type = 'square', vol = 0.15) {
            if (!audioCtx) return;
            try {
                const o = audioCtx.createOscillator();
                const g = audioCtx.createGain();
                o.connect(g);
                g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                o.type = type;
                o.frequency.value = freq;
                g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, audioCtx.currentTime);
                g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
                o.start(audioCtx.currentTime);
                o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        // ====== GAME STATE ======
        let player = { x: 80, y: 400, vx: 0, vy: 0, onGround: false, facing: 1, dead: false, deadTimer: 0 };
        let camera = { x: 0, y: 0 };
        let score = 0;
        let coinCount = 0;
        let gameState = 'playing'; // playing, dead, win
        let stateTimer = 0;
        let keys = {};
        let lastTime = 0;

        // ====== LEVEL DATA ======
        let solids = [];
        let enemies = [];
        let particles = [];
        let floatingCoins = [];
        let flag = { x: 3100, y: 320, baseY: 480, height: 160, poleWidth: 8 };

        // ====== LEVEL INIT ======
        function initLevel() {
            solids = [];
            enemies = [];
            particles = [];
            floatingCoins = [];
            score = 0;
            coinCount = 0;
            gameState = 'playing';
            stateTimer = 0;
            player = { x: 80, y: 400, vx: 0, vy: 0, onGround: false, facing: 1, dead: false, deadTimer: 0 };
            camera = { x: 0, y: 0 };

            // Ground segments
            solids.push({ x: 0, y: 480, w: 640, h: 32, type: 'ground' });
            solids.push({ x: 720, y: 480, w: 560, h: 32, type: 'ground' });
            solids.push({ x: 1360, y: 480, w: 560, h: 32, type: 'ground' });
            solids.push({ x: 2000, y: 480, w: 1400, h: 32, type: 'ground' });

            // Question blocks
            solids.push({ x: 256, y: 288, w: 32, h: 32, type: 'question', used: false });
            solids.push({ x: 320, y: 288, w: 32, h: 32, type: 'question', used: false });
            solids.push({ x: 640, y: 288, w: 32, h: 32, type: 'question', used: false });
            solids.push({ x: 960, y: 288, w: 32, h: 32, type: 'question', used: false });
            solids.push({ x: 1400, y: 288, w: 32, h: 32, type: 'question', used: false });

            // Brick blocks
            solids.push({ x: 288, y: 288, w: 32, h: 32, type: 'brick', broken: false });
            solids.push({ x: 352, y: 288, w: 32, h: 32, type: 'brick', broken: false });
            solids.push({ x: 880, y: 288, w: 32, h: 32, type: 'brick', broken: false });
            solids.push({ x: 912, y: 288, w: 32, h: 32, type: 'brick', broken: false });

            // Floating platform blocks
            solids.push({ x: 1080, y: 384, w: 64, h: 32, type: 'ground' });
            solids.push({ x: 1200, y: 320, w: 64, h: 32, type: 'ground' });
            solids.push({ x: 1700, y: 384, w: 96, h: 32, type: 'ground' });

            // Pipes
            solids.push({ x: 480, y: 448, w: 64, h: 32, type: 'pipe' });
            solids.push({ x: 800, y: 416, w: 64, h: 64, type: 'pipe' });
            solids.push({ x: 1600, y: 448, w: 64, h: 32, type: 'pipe' });

            // Stairs near flag
            solids.push({ x: 2800, y: 448, w: 32, h: 32, type: 'ground' });
            solids.push({ x: 2832, y: 448, w: 32, h: 32, type: 'ground' });
            solids.push({ x: 2864, y: 448, w: 32, h: 32, type: 'ground' });
            solids.push({ x: 2832, y: 416, w: 32, h: 32, type: 'ground' });
            solids.push({ x: 2864, y: 416, w: 32, h: 32, type: 'ground' });
            solids.push({ x: 2864, y: 384, w: 32, h: 32, type: 'ground' });

            // Goombas
            enemies.push({ x: 350, y: 448, w: 32, h: 32, vx: -1, dead: false, squishTimer: 0 });
            enemies.push({ x: 600, y: 448, w: 32, h: 32, vx: -1, dead: false, squishTimer: 0 });
            enemies.push({ x: 900, y: 416, w: 32, h: 32, vx: 1, dead: false, squishTimer: 0 });
            enemies.push({ x: 1500, y: 448, w: 32, h: 32, vx: -1, dead: false, squishTimer: 0 });
            enemies.push({ x: 1800, y: 448, w: 32, h: 32, vx: -1, dead: false, squishTimer: 0 });
            enemies.push({ x: 2200, y: 448, w: 32, h: 32, vx: 1, dead: false, squishTimer: 0 });

            // Flag
            flag = { x: 3100, y: 320, baseY: 480, height: 160, poleWidth: 8 };
        }

        // ====== COLLISION ======
        function checkCollision(a, b) {
            return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
        }

        // ====== INPUT ======
        document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
            keys[e.code] = true;
            if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') e.preventDefault();
            initAudio();
        });
        document.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });

        // ====== UPDATE ======
        function update(dt) {
            if (gameState === 'dead') {
                stateTimer += dt;
                player.vy += GRAVITY * dt * 60;
                player.y += player.vy * dt * 60;
                if (stateTimer > 2) {
                    initLevel();
                }
                return;
            }
            if (gameState === 'win') {
                stateTimer += dt;
                if (stateTimer > 2.5) initLevel();
                return;
            }

            // Player movement
            let moveLeft = keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA'];
            let moveRight = keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD'];
            let jumpPressed = keys['Space'] || keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW'];

            // Horizontal
            if (moveLeft) { player.vx = -MOVE_SPEED;
                player.facing = -1; } else if (moveRight) { player.vx = MOVE_SPEED;
                player.facing = 1; } else { player.vx *= 0.7; }

            // Jump
            if (jumpPressed && player.onGround) {
                player.vy = JUMP_FORCE;
                player.onGround = false;
                playSound(200, 0.15, 'square', 0.1);
            }
            // Variable jump height
            if (!jumpPressed && player.vy < -3) {
                player.vy = -3;
            }

            // Gravity
            player.vy += GRAVITY * dt * 60;
            if (player.vy > MAX_FALL) player.vy = MAX_FALL;

            // Move horizontally
            player.x += player.vx * dt * 60;
            let p = { x: player.x, y: player.y, w: PLAYER_W, h: PLAYER_H };
            for (let s of solids) {
                if (s.type === 'brick' && s.broken) continue;
                if (checkCollision(p, s)) {
                    if (player.vx > 0) player.x = s.x - PLAYER_W;
                    else if (player.vx < 0) player.x = s.x + s.w;
                    player.vx = 0;
                    p.x = player.x;
                }
            }

            // Move vertically
            player.y += player.vy * dt * 60;
            p = { x: player.x, y: player.y, w: PLAYER_W, h: PLAYER_H };
            player.onGround = false;
            for (let i = 0; i < solids.length; i++) {
                let s = solids[i];
                if (s.type === 'brick' && s.broken) continue;
                if (checkCollision(p, s)) {
                    if (player.vy > 0) {
                        player.y = s.y - PLAYER_H;
                        player.onGround = true;
                        player.vy = 0;
                    } else if (player.vy < 0) {
                        player.y = s.y + s.h;
                        player.vy = 0;
                        // Hit block from below
                        if (s.type === 'question' && !s.used) {
                            s.used = true;
                            score += 100;
                            coinCount++;
                            playSound(800, 0.1, 'square', 0.12);
                            // Spawn coin particle
                            particles.push({
                                x: s.x + 16,
                                y: s.y - 8,
                                vy: -6,
                                life: 0.4,
                                type: 'coin'
                            });
                        } else if (s.type === 'brick' && !s.broken) {
                            s.broken = true;
                            score += 50;
                            playSound(150, 0.15, 'sawtooth', 0.1);
                            // Brick particles
                            for (let j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                                particles.push({
                                    x: s.x + 8 + Math.random() * 16,
                                    y: s.y + 8 + Math.random() * 16,
                                    vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
                                    vy: -4 - Math.random() * 4,
                                    life: 0.5,
                                    type: 'brick'
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    p.y = player.y;
                }
            }

            // Fall into pit
            if (player.y > CH + 50) {
                player.dead = true;
                gameState = 'dead';
                stateTimer = 0;
                playSound(300, 0.5, 'sawtooth', 0.15);
            }

            // Enemy update
            for (let e of enemies) {
                if (e.dead) {
                    e.squishTimer += dt;
                    continue;
                }
                e.x += e.vx * dt * 60;
                // Simple edge detection
                let onGround = false;
                for (let s of solids) {
                    if (s.type === 'brick' && s.broken) continue;
                    let ep = { x: e.x, y: e.y + 1, w: e.w, h: e.h };
                    if (checkCollision(ep, s)) { onGround = true; break; }
                }
                if (!onGround) e.vx = -e.vx;
                // Turn around at edges of ground segments
                for (let s of solids) {
                    if (s.type !== 'ground') continue;
                    if (e.x < s.x) { e.vx = Math.abs(e.vx); }
                    if (e.x + e.w > s.x + s.w) { e.vx = -Math.abs(e.vx); }
                }
            }

            // Player-enemy collision
            for (let e of enemies) {
                if (e.dead) continue;
                let ep = { x: e.x, y: e.y, w: e.w, h: e.h };
                p = { x: player.x, y: player.y, w: PLAYER_W, h: PLAYER_H };
                if (checkCollision(p, ep)) {
                    if (player.vy > 0 && player.y + PLAYER_H - e.y < 24) {
                        e.dead = true;
                        e.squishTimer = 0;
                        player.vy = -8;
                        score += 100;
                        playSound(120, 0.12, 'square', 0.15);
                        // Squish particles
                        particles.push({
                            x: e.x + 16,
                            y: e.y + 16,
                            vx: 0,
                            vy: -2,
                            life: 0.3,
                            type: 'poof'
                        });
                    } else if (!player.dead) {
                        player.dead = true;
                        gameState = 'dead';
                        stateTimer = 0;
                        player.vy = -8;
                        playSound(300, 0.4, 'sawtooth', 0.15);
                    }
                }
            }

            // Flag collision
            let flagRect = { x: flag.x - 8, y: flag.y, w: 16, h: flag.height };
            p = { x: player.x, y: player.y, w: PLAYER_W, h: PLAYER_H };
            if (checkCollision(p, flagRect) && gameState === 'playing') {
                gameState = 'win';
                stateTimer = 0;
                score += 1000;
                playSound(600, 0.3, 'square', 0.15);
                setTimeout(() => playSound(800, 0.3, 'square', 0.12), 150);
                setTimeout(() => playSound(1000, 0.5, 'square', 0.12), 300);
            }

            // Particles update
            for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                let pt = particles[i];
                pt.x += (pt.vx || 0) * dt * 60;
                pt.y += (pt.vy || 0) * dt * 60;
                if (pt.type === 'coin') pt.vy += 0.3 * dt * 60;
                if (pt.type === 'brick') pt.vy += 0.4 * dt * 60;
                pt.life -= dt;
                if (pt.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
            }

            // Camera
            camera.x = player.x - CW * 0.35;
            camera.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(camera.x, LEVEL_W - CW));
            camera.y = 0;
        }

        // ====== RENDER ======
        function render() {
            // Sky
            ctx.fillStyle = '#5c94fc';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CW, CH);

            // Background clouds (parallax)
            drawCloud(100 - camera.x * 0.2, 80, 1.2);
            drawCloud(400 - camera.x * 0.15, 120, 0.8);
            drawCloud(900 - camera.x * 0.1, 60, 1.0);
            drawCloud(1500 - camera.x * 0.08, 100, 0.9);
            drawCloud(2200 - camera.x * 0.05, 70, 1.1);
            drawCloud(2800 - camera.x * 0.03, 110, 0.7);

            // Background hills
            drawHill(200 - camera.x * 0.3, 480, 120);
            drawHill(700 - camera.x * 0.25, 480, 80);
            drawHill(1300 - camera.x * 0.2, 480, 100);
            drawHill(2000 - camera.x * 0.15, 480, 90);
            drawHill(2600 - camera.x * 0.1, 480, 110);

            // Bushes
            drawBush(300 - camera.x * 0.3, 460, 1);
            drawBush(800 - camera.x * 0.2, 460, 0.7);
            drawBush(1600 - camera.x * 0.15, 460, 0.8);
            drawBush(2400 - camera.x * 0.08, 460, 1);

            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(-camera.x, -camera.y);

            // Draw solids
            for (let s of solids) {
                if (s.type === 'brick' && s.broken) continue;
                drawSolid(s);
            }

            // Draw flag
            drawFlag();

            // Draw enemies
            for (let e of enemies) {
                if (e.dead) {
                    // Draw squished goomba
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#c84c0c';
                    ctx.fillRect(e.x, e.y + 16, e.w, e.h - 16);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#fcf8d8';
                    ctx.fillRect(e.x + 4, e.y + 18, e.w - 8, 4);
                    continue;
                }
                drawGoomba(e.x, e.y);
            }

            // Draw particles
            for (let pt of particles) {
                if (pt.type === 'coin') {
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#fcf800';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.ellipse(pt.x, pt.y, 6, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#c8a000';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                    ctx.stroke();
                } else if (pt.type === 'brick') {
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#c84c0c';
                    ctx.fillRect(pt.x - 2, pt.y - 2, 4, 4);
                } else if (pt.type === 'poof') {
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, 12 * pt.life * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
            }

            // Draw player
            if (!player.dead) {
                drawMario(player.x, player.y, player.facing);
            } else {
                // Dead Mario - rotated
                ctx.save();
                ctx.translate(player.x + PLAYER_W / 2, player.y + PLAYER_H / 2);
                ctx.rotate(player.facing * Math.PI);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#e40010';
                ctx.fillRect(-10, -14, 20, 12);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#0088f8';
                ctx.fillRect(-10, -2, 20, 10);
                ctx.restore();
            }

            ctx.restore();

            // UI
            drawUI();

            // Game state overlays
            if (gameState === 'win') {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CW, CH);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
                ctx.font = 'bold 48px "Courier New", monospace';
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.fillText('LEVEL CLEAR!', CW / 2, CH / 2 - 20);
                ctx.font = '20px "Courier New", monospace';
                ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, CW / 2, CH / 2 + 30);
            }

            if (gameState === 'dead' && stateTimer > 0.5) {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CW, CH);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
                ctx.font = 'bold 40px "Courier New", monospace';
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', CW / 2, CH / 2);
            }
        }

        // ====== DRAW FUNCTIONS ======
        function drawCloud(x, y, scale) {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(x, y, 20 * scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.arc(x + 22 * scale, y - 8 * scale, 25 * scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.arc(x + 45 * scale, y, 20 * scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.arc(x + 22 * scale, y + 5 * scale, 18 * scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }

        function drawHill(x, y, size) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#00a800';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.ellipse(x, y, size, size * 0.6, 0, Math.PI, 0);
            ctx.fill();
        }

        function drawBush(x, y, scale) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#00c800';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(x, y, 12 * scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.arc(x + 14 * scale, y, 10 * scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.arc(x + 7 * scale, y - 5 * scale, 10 * scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }

        function drawSolid(s) {
            if (s.type === 'ground') {
                ctx.fillStyle = '#9c4a1c';
                ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.w, s.h);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#c84c0c';
                ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.w, 6);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#6a3404';
                for (let i = 0; i < s.w; i += 32) {
                    ctx.fillRect(s.x + i, s.y + 12, 16, 2);
                    ctx.fillRect(s.x + i + 16, s.y + 20, 16, 2);
                }
            } else if (s.type === 'question') {
                if (s.used) {
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#8a6a3a';
                    ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.w, s.h);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#6a4a2a';
                    ctx.fillRect(s.x + 2, s.y + 2, s.w - 4, s.h - 4);
                } else {
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#fcb800';
                    ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.w, s.h);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#fcf800';
                    ctx.fillRect(s.x + 2, s.y + 2, s.w - 4, s.h - 4);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#c8a000';
                    ctx.font = 'bold 16px "Courier New", monospace';
                    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                    ctx.fillText('?', s.x + s.w / 2, s.y + s.h / 2 + 6);
                    // Border
                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#8a6a2a';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                    ctx.strokeRect(s.x + 1, s.y + 1, s.w - 2, s.h - 2);
                }
            } else if (s.type === 'brick') {
                if (s.broken) return;
                ctx.fillStyle = '#c84c0c';
                ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.w, s.h);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#9c4a1c';
                ctx.fillRect(s.x + 1, s.y + 1, s.w - 2, s.h - 2);
                // Brick pattern
                ctx.fillStyle = '#6a3404';
                ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y + s.h / 2 - 1, s.w, 2);
                ctx.fillRect(s.x + s.w / 2 - 1, s.y, 2, s.h / 2);
                ctx.fillRect(s.x + s.w / 4 - 1, s.y + s.h / 2, 2, s.h / 2);
                ctx.fillRect(s.x + 3 * s.w / 4 - 1, s.y + s.h / 2, 2, s.h / 2);
            } else if (s.type === 'pipe') {
                // Pipe body
                ctx.fillStyle = '#00a800';
                ctx.fillRect(s.x + 4, s.y, s.w - 8, s.h);
                // Pipe lip
                ctx.fillStyle = '#00c800';
                ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.w, 20);
                // Highlight
                ctx.fillStyle = '#00fc00';
                ctx.fillRect(s.x + 6, s.y + 2, 8, s.h - 4);
                // Shadow
                ctx.fillStyle = '#006800';
                ctx.fillRect(s.x + s.w - 12, s.y + 2, 6, s.h - 4);
            }
        }

        function drawGoomba(x, y) {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(x + 16, y + 16);
            // Body
            ctx.fillStyle = '#c84c0c';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.ellipse(0, 2, 14, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            // Face
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fcf8d8';
            ctx.fillRect(-8, -2, 16, 6);
            // Eyes
            ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
            ctx.fillRect(-5, -2, 3, 4);
            ctx.fillRect(2, -2, 3, 4);
            // Eyebrows
            ctx.fillRect(-6, -4, 5, 2);
            ctx.fillRect(1, -4, 5, 2);
            // Feet
            ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
            ctx.fillRect(-10, 10, 8, 4);
            ctx.fillRect(2, 10, 8, 4);
            ctx.restore();
        }

        function drawMario(x, y, facing) {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(x + PLAYER_W / 2, y + PLAYER_H / 2);
            ctx.scale(facing, 1);

            // Cap
            ctx.fillStyle = '#e40010';
            ctx.fillRect(-9, -14, 18, 7);
            // Cap brim
            ctx.fillRect(-14, -10, 28, 4);
            // "M" on cap
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = 'bold 8px "Courier New", monospace';
            ctx.fillText('M', -3, -5);

            // Face
            ctx.fillStyle = '#f8a058';
            ctx.fillRect(-7, -6, 14, 8);

            // Eye
            ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
            ctx.fillRect(3, -4, 3, 3);

            // Mustache
            ctx.fillStyle = '#6a3404';
            ctx.fillRect(-1, 0, 12, 2);

            // Body (red shirt)
            ctx.fillStyle = '#e40010';
            ctx.fillRect(-8, 2, 16, 5);

            // Overalls (blue)
            ctx.fillStyle = '#0088f8';
            ctx.fillRect(-8, 6, 16, 7);

            // Buttons
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fcf800';
            ctx.fillRect(-4, 8, 2, 2);
            ctx.fillRect(2, 8, 2, 2);

            // Shoes
            ctx.fillStyle = '#6a3404';
            ctx.fillRect(-9, 13, 10, 4);
            ctx.fillRect(-1, 13, 10, 4);

            ctx.restore();
        }

        function drawFlag() {
            // Pole
            ctx.fillStyle = '#00a800';
            ctx.fillRect(flag.x - 4, flag.y, flag.poleWidth, flag.height);
            // Ball on top
            ctx.fillStyle = '#00fc00';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(flag.x, flag.y - 4, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            // Flag
            ctx.fillStyle = '#e40010';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(flag.x + 4, flag.y + 4);
            ctx.lineTo(flag.x + 60, flag.y + 20);
            ctx.lineTo(flag.x + 4, flag.y + 36);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
            // Star on flag
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = '14px "Courier New", monospace';
            ctx.fillText('★', flag.x + 22, flag.y + 26);
            // Base
            ctx.fillStyle = '#c84c0c';
            ctx.fillRect(flag.x - 12, flag.baseY - 8, 28, 8);
        }

        function drawUI() {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CW, 40);

            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = 'bold 16px "Courier New", monospace';
            ctx.textAlign = 'left';
            ctx.fillText('SCORE', 20, 16);
            ctx.fillText(String(score).padStart(6, '0'), 20, 34);

            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('WORLD 1-1', CW / 2, 25);

            ctx.textAlign = 'right';
            ctx.fillText('COINS', CW - 80, 16);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fcf800';
            ctx.fillText('🪙 × ' + coinCount, CW - 80, 34);
        }

        // ====== GAME LOOP ======
        let lastTimestamp = 0;

        function gameLoop(timestamp) {
            let dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTimestamp) / 16.667, 3);
            lastTimestamp = timestamp;

            update(dt);
            render();

            requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
        }

        // ====== START ======
        initLevel();
        requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
    </script>
</body>
</html>

function fit(){

/* ============================================================

function audioInit(){
  if(!actx){
    try{ actx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(); }catch(e){}
  }
  if(actx && actx.state === 'suspended') actx.resume();
}
function tone(freq, dur, type, vol, slideTo){
  if(!actx) return;
  const t0 = actx.currentTime;
  const o = actx.createOscillator();
  const g = actx.createGain();
  o.type = type || 'square';
  o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
  if(slideTo) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(slideTo, t0 + dur);
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol || 0.05, t0);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0008, t0 + dur);
  o.connect(g); g.connect(actx.destination);
  o.start(t0); o.stop(t0 + dur + 0.02);
}

/* ============================================================

function drawTileTo(g, c, x, y){
  switch(c){

      g.fillRect(x,y+5,16,1); g.fillRect(x,y+10,16,1);
      g.fillRect(x+7,y+1,1,4);
      g.fillRect(x+3,y+6,1,4); g.fillRect(x+11,y+6,1,4);
      g.fillRect(x+7,y+11,1,4);
      g.fillStyle = '#e89858';
      g.fillRect(x+1,y+1,14,1);
      break;
    }
    case '?': {
      g.fillStyle = '#e8a020'; g.fillRect(x,y,16,16);
      g.fillStyle = '#000';
      g.fillRect(x,y,16,1); g.fillRect(x,y+15,16,1);
      g.fillRect(x,y,1,16); g.fillRect(x+15,y,1,16);
      g.fillRect(x+2,y+2,2,2); g.fillRect(x+12,y+2,2,2);
      g.fillRect(x+2,y+12,2,2); g.fillRect(x+12,y+12,2,2);
      g.fillStyle = '#fff';
      g.font = 'bold 11px monospace';
      g.textAlign = 'center'; g.textBaseline = 'middle';
      g.fillText('?', x+8, y+9);
      break;
    }
    case 'U': {
      g.fillStyle = '#a05820'; g.fillRect(x,y,16,16);
      g.fillStyle = '#c87838'; g.fillRect(x+2,y+2,12,12);
      g.fillStyle = '#000';
      g.fillRect(x,y,16,1); g.fillRect(x,y+15,16,1);
      g.fillRect(x,y,1,16); g.fillRect(x+15,y,1,16);
      g.fillRect(x+2,y+2,2,2); g.fillRect(x+12,y+2,2,2);
      g.fillRect(x+2,y+12,2,2); g.fillRect(x+12,y+12,2,2);
      break;
    }
    case 'P': case 'Q': case 'p': case 'q': {
      const isTop  = (c==='P' || c==='Q');
      const isLeft = (c==='P' || c==='p');
      g.fillStyle = '#00a800'; g.fillRect(x,y,16,16);
      g.fillStyle = '#58e858';
      if(isLeft) g.fillRect(x+3,y,4,16);
      else       g.fillRect(x+9,y,4,16);
      g.fillStyle = '#006000';
      if(isLeft) g.fillRect(x,y,2,16);
      else       g.fillRect(x+14,y,2,16);
      if(isTop){
        g.fillStyle = '#58e858';
        g.fillRect(x + (isLeft?3:0), y+1, isLeft?4:13, 3);
        g.fillStyle = '#000';
        g.fillRect(x,y,16,1);
      }
      g.fillStyle = '#000';
      if(isLeft) g.fillRect(x,y,1,16);
      else       g.fillRect(x+15,y,1,16);
      break;
    }
  }
}

let grid, coinSpawns, enemySpawns, powerBlocks;

function buildLevel(){
  grid = Array.from({length:MAPH}, ()=> new Array(MAPW).fill(' '));
  const set   = (x,y,c)=>{ if(x>=0&&x<MAPW&&y>=0&&y<MAPH) grid[y][x]=c; };
  const fillR = (x0,x1,y0,y1,c)=>{ for(let y=y0;y<=y1;y++) for(let x=x0;x<=x1;x++) set(x,y,c); };
  const pipe  = (x,h)=>{
    const top = 13 - h;
    set(x,top,'P'); set(x+1,top,'Q');
    for(let y=top+1;y<=12;y++){ set(x,y,'p'); set(x+1,y,'q'); }
  };

  /* ---- ground (with two pits) ---- */
  fillR(0,   68, 13, 14, 'X');
  fillR(72, 152, 13, 14, 'X');

  set(20,9,'B'); set(21,9,'?'); set(22,9,'B'); set(23,9,'?'); set(24,9,'B');
  set(22,5,'?');
  pipe(28,2);
  pipe(38,3);
  pipe(48,4);

  set(80,9,'B'); set(81,9,'B');

  set(115,9,'?'); set(116,9,'B'); set(117,9,'?');

    [30,8],[31,8],[32,8],
    [40,7],[41,7],[42,7],
    [50,6],[51,6],[52,6],
    [60,7],[61,7],[62,7],
    [69,8],[70,8],[71,8],
    [82,7],[83,7],[84,7],
    [104,7],[105,7],[106,7],
    [120,4],[121,4],[122,4],[123,4],
    [134,8],[135,8],[136,8],
    [156,8],[157,8],[158,8],
    [168,7],[169,7],[170,7],
    [175,8],[176,8],[177,8]
  ];

  /* ---- goombas ---- */
  enemySpawns = [
    [26,12],[34,12],[44,12],[52,12],[63,12],
