/* ============================================================
   PHYSICS HELPERS
   ============================================================ */
const GRAV       = 0.70;
const GRAV_HOLD  = 0.40;
const JUMP_V     = -8.2;
const MAXFALL    = 12;
const ACC        = 0.45;
const RUNACC     = 0.60;
const FRIC       = 0.40;
const MAXWALK    = 2.4;
const MAXRUN     = 3.9;

function clamp(v,a,b){ return v<a?a:(v>b?b:v); }

function tileAt(tx,ty){
  if(ty < 0 || ty >= MAPH) return ' ';
  if(tx < 0 || tx >= MAPW) return 'X';
  return grid[ty][tx];
}
function isSolid(tx,ty){
  const c = tileAt(tx,ty);
  return c==='X'||c==='#'||c==='B'||c==='?'||c==='U'||c==='P'||c==='Q'||c==='p'||c==='q';
}

function collideX(e){
  const y0 = Math.floor(e.y / TH);
  const y1 = Math.floor((e.y + e.h - 1) / TH);
  if(e.vx > 0){
    const tx = Math.floor((e.x + e.w - 1) / TW);
    for(let ty=y0; ty<=y1; ty++){
      if(isSolid(tx,ty)){ e.x = tx*TW - e.w; e.vx = 0; return true; }
    }
  } else if(e.vx < 0){
    const tx = Math.floor(e.x / TW);
    for(let ty=y0; ty<=y1; ty++){
      if(isSolid(tx,ty)){ e.x = (tx+1)*TW; e.vx = 0; return true; }
    }
  }
  return false;
}

function collideY(e, isPlayer){
  const x0 = Math.floor(e.x / TW);
  const x1 = Math.floor((e.x + e.w - 1) / TW);
  e.onGround = false;
  if(e.vy > 0){
    const ty = Math.floor((e.y + e.h - 1) / TH);
    for(let tx=x0; tx<=x1; tx++){
      if(isSolid(tx,ty)){
        e.y = ty*TH - e.h; e.vy = 0; e.onGround = true; return;
      }
    }
  } else if(e.vy < 0){
    const ty = Math.floor(e.y / TH);
    let best = -1, bestD = 1e9;
    for(let tx=x0; tx<=x1; tx++){
      if(isSolid(tx,ty)){
        const d = Math.abs((tx*TW + 8) - (e.x + e.w/2));
        if(d < bestD){ bestD = d; best = tx; }
      }
    }
    if(best >= 0){
      e.y = (ty+1)*TH; e.vy = 0;
      if(isPlayer) hitBlock(best, ty);
    }
  }
}

function overlap(a,b){
  return a.x < b.x+b.w && a.x+a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y+b.h && a.y+a.h > b.y;
}

/* ============================================================
   BLOCK INTERACTION
   ============================================================ */
function bumpBlock(tx,ty){ bumps.set(tx+','+ty, 0); }

function hitBlock(tx,ty){
  const c = grid[ty][tx];
  if(c === '?'){
    grid[ty][tx] = 'U';
    bumpBlock(tx,ty);
    const key = tx+','+ty;
    if(powerBlocks.has(key)){
      if(player.big || player.fire) spawnItem(tx, ty-1, 'flower');
      else                          spawnItem(tx, ty-1, 'mushroom');
      sfx.power();
    } else {
      spawnCoinPop(tx, ty-1);
      addCoin();
      score += 200;
      sfx.coin();
    }
  } else if(c === 'B'){
    if(player.big || player.fire){
      grid[ty][tx] = ' ';
      spawnBrickParticles(tx,ty);
      score += 50;
      sfx.brick();
    } else {
      bumpBlock(tx,ty);
      sfx.bump();
    }
  } else if(c === 'U' || c === 'X' || c === '#'){
    bumpBlock(tx,ty);
    sfx.bump();
  }
}

function addCoin(){
  coinCount++;
  if(coinCount >= 100){ coinCount -= 100; lives++; sfx.oneup(); }
}

/* ============================================================
   SPAWNERS
   ============================================================ */
function spawnItem(tx, ty, type){
  items.push({
    x: tx*TW + 2, y: ty*TH, w: 12, h: 14,
    vx: type === 'mushroom' ? 1.1 : 0,
    vy: -1.2, type, emerge: 16, onGround: false
  });
}

function spawnCoinPop(tx, ty){
  particles.push({
    x: tx*TW + 4, y: ty*TH + 4, vx: 0, vy: -6.2,
    life: 34, maxLife: 34, type: 'coin'
  });
}

function spawnBrickParticles(tx, ty){
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    particles.push({
      x: tx*TW + (i%2)*8 + 2,
      y: ty*TH + Math.floor(i/2)*8 + 2,
      vx: (i%2 ? 1.6 : -1.6) + (Math.random()-0.5)*0.6,
      vy: (i<2 ? -5 : -3) + Math.random(),
      life: 70, maxLife: 70, type: 'brick'
    });
  }
}

function spawnScorePop(x,y,val){
  particles.push({ x, y, vx:0, vy:-0.7, life: 50, maxLife: 50, type:'score', val });
}

/* ============================================================
   UPDATE — PLAYER
   ============================================================ */
function updatePlayer(){
  const p = player;

  if(p.dead) return;

  const maxSpd = keys.run ? MAXRUN : MAXWALK;
  const accel  = keys.run ? RUNACC : ACC;

  if(keys.left && !keys.right){
    p.vx -= accel; p.facing = -1;
  } else if(keys.right && !keys.left){
    p.vx += accel; p.facing = 1;
  } else if(p.onGround){
    if(Math.abs(p.vx) < FRIC) p.vx = 0;
    else p.vx -= Math.sign(p.vx) * FRIC;
  } else {
    p.vx *= 0.995;
  }

  if(p.vx >  maxSpd) p.vx = Math.max(maxSpd, p.vx - 0.15);
  if(p.vx < -maxSpd) p.vx = Math.min(-maxSpd, p.vx + 0.15);

  /* jump */
  if(jumpBuffer > 0 && (p.onGround || coyote > 0)){
    p.vy = JUMP_V;
    p.onGround = false;
    p.jumping = true;
    coyote = 0;
    jumpBuffer = 0;
    sfx.jump();
  }
  if(!keys.jump) p.jumping = false;

  const g = (p.jumping && p.vy < 0) ? GRAV_HOLD : GRAV;
  p.vy += g;
  if(p.vy > MAXFALL) p.vy = MAXFALL;

  /* horizontal move */
  p.x += p.vx;
  collideX(p);

  /* vertical move */
  p.y += p.vy;
  collideY(p, true);

  if(p.onGround) coyote = 6;
  else if(coyote > 0) coyote--;

  if(p.invuln > 0) p.invuln--;

  /* fireball */
  if(firePressed && p.fire && fireballs.length < 2 && !p.dead){
    fireballs.push({
      x: p.x + (p.facing > 0 ? p.w : -8),
      y: p.y + (p.big ? 10 : 6),
      w: 8, h: 8, vx: 5 * p.facing, vy: 1, life: 180
    });
    sfx.fire();
  }
  firePressed = false;

  /* pit death */
  if(p.y > MAPH*TH + 40) killPlayer(true);

  /* flagpole */
  if(state === 'play' && p.x + p.w > FLAG_X && p.x < FLAG_X + 16){
    startWin();
  }
}

function killPlayer(instant){
  if(player.dead) return;
  player.dead = true;
  player.vy = -8.5;
  player.vx = 0;
  state = 'dead';
  stateTimer = 0;
  sfx.die();
}

function damagePlayer(){
  const p = player;
  if(p.invuln > 0 || p.dead) return;
  if(p.fire){
    p.fire = false;
    p.invuln = 120;
    sfx.bump();
  } else if(p.big){
    p.big = false;
    p.h = 16;
    p.y += 8;
    p.invuln = 120;
    sfx.bump();
  } else {
    killPlayer();
  }
}

function growPlayer(){
  const p = player;
  if(!p.big){
    p.big = true;
    p.h = 24;
    p.y -= 8;
  }
  p.invuln = Math.max(p.invuln, 40);
  score += 1000;
  sfx.power();
}

function makeFire(){
  const p = player;
  if(!p.big){
    p.big = true;
    p.h = 24;
    p.y -= 8;
  }
  p.fire = true;
  p.invuln = Math.max(p.invuln, 40);
  score += 1000;
  sfx.power();
}

/* ============================================================
   UPDATE — ENEMIES
   ============================================================ */
function updateEnemies(){
  const p = player;
  for(let i=enemies.length-1; i>=0; i--){
    const e = enemies[i];

    if(e.dead){
      e.squash--;
      if(e.flip){
        e.vy += 0.5;
        e.y += e.vy;
        e.x += e.vx;
      }
      if(e.squash <= 0 || e.y > MAPH*TH + 60) enemies.splice(i,1);
      continue;
    }

    if(Math.abs(e.x - p.x) > VW * 1.2 && e.x > p.x) continue; // sleep far-right enemies

    e.vy += GRAV;
    if(e.vy > MAXFALL) e.vy = MAXFALL;

    const oldvx = e.vx;
    e.x += e.vx;
    collideX(e);
    if(e.vx === 0 && oldvx !== 0) e.vx = -oldvx;

    e.y += e.vy;
    collideY(e, false);

    if(e.y > MAPH*TH + 40){ enemies.splice(i,1); continue; }

    /* player collision */
    if(!p.dead && overlap(p, e)){
      const stomping = p.vy > 0 && (p.y + p.h) - e.y < 12;
      if(stomping){
        e.dead = true;
        e.squash = 30;
        e.flip = 0;
        p.vy = keys.jump ? -8.5 : -6.5;
        score += 100;
        spawnScorePop(e.x, e.y - 6, 100);
        sfx.stomp();
      } else {
        damagePlayer();
      }
    }
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   UPDATE — ITEMS
   ============================================================ */
function updateItems(){
  const p = player;
  for(let i=items.length-1; i>=0; i--){
    const it = items[i];

    if(it.emerge > 0){
      it.emerge--;
      it.y -= 1;
      continue;
    }

    if(it.type === 'mushroom'){
      it.vy += GRAV;
      if(it.vy > MAXFALL) it.vy = MAXFALL;
      const oldvx = it.vx;
      it.x += it.vx;
      collideX(it);
      if(it.vx === 0 && oldvx !== 0) it.vx = -oldvx;
      it.y += it.vy;
      collideY(it, false);
    } else {
      it.vy += GRAV;
      if(it.vy > MAXFALL) it.vy = MAXFALL;
      it.y += it.vy;
      collideY(it, false);
    }

    if(it.y > MAPH*TH + 40){ items.splice(i,1); continue; }

    if(!p.dead && overlap(p, it)){
      if(it.type === 'mushroom') growPlayer();
      else makeFire();
      items.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   UPDATE — FIREBALLS
   ============================================================ */
function updateFireballs(){
  for(let i=fireballs.length-1; i>=0; i--){
    const f = fireballs[i];
    f.life--;
    f.vy += 0.35;
    if(f.vy > 6) f.vy = 6;

    f.x += f.vx;
    if(collideX(f)){ fireballs.splice(i,1); continue; }

    f.y += f.vy;
    const x0 = Math.floor(f.x/TW), x1 = Math.floor((f.x+f.w-1)/TW);
    const ty = Math.floor((f.y + f.h - 1)/TH);
    let hitGround = false;
    for(let tx=x0; tx<=x1; tx++){
      if(isSolid(tx,ty)){ hitGround = true; break; }
    }
    if(hitGround){ f.y = ty*TH - f.h; f.vy = -4.2; }

    if(f.life <= 0 || f.y > MAPH*TH + 40){ fireballs.splice(i,1); continue; }

    /* hit enemies */
    for(const e of enemies){
      if(e.dead) continue;
      if(overlap(f, e)){
        e.dead = true;
        e.squash = 60;
        e.flip = 1;
        e.vy = -5;
        e.vx = f.vx > 0 ? 1.5 : -1.5;
        score += 200;
        spawnScorePop(e.x, e.y - 6, 200);
        sfx.stomp();
        fireballs.splice(i,1);
        break;
      }
    }
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   UPDATE — PARTICLES / BUMPS
   ============================================================ */
function updateParticles(){
  for(let i=particles.length-1; i>=0; i--){
    const q = particles[i];
    q.life--;
    q.x += q.vx;
    q.y += q.vy;
    if(q.type === 'brick') q.vy += 0.45;
    if(q.type === 'coin')  q.vy += 0.42;
    if(q.life <= 0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }
}

function updateBumps(){
  for(const [k,v] of bumps){
    const nv = v + 0.14;
    if(nv >= 1) bumps.delete(k);
    else bumps.set(k, nv);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   UPDATE — CAMERA / TIMER
   ============================================================ */
function updateCamera(){
  const target = player.x + player.w/2 - VW*0.42;
  cam.x += (target - cam.x) * 0.14;
  cam.x = clamp(cam.x, 0, MAPW*TW - VW);
}

/* ============================================================
   WIN SEQUENCE
   ============================================================ */
function startWin(){
  state = 'win';
  stateTimer = 0;
  player.vx = 0;
  player.vy = 0;
  player.x = FLAG_X - 12;
  player.facing = 1;
  sfx.win();
}

function updateWin(){
  stateTimer++;
  const p = player;

  if(p.y + p.h < 13*TH){
    p.y += 2.2;
    flagY = Math.min(176, flagY + 2.2);
  } else {
    p.x += 1.6;
    if(p.x > CASTLE_X + 30 && !showClear){
      showClear = true;
      score += Math.floor(timeLeft) * 50;
    }
  }
  if(stateTimer > 420 && !showClear){
    showClear = true;
    score += Math.floor(timeLeft) * 50;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   STEP
   ============================================================ */
function step(){
  if(jumpBuffer > 0) jumpBuffer--;
  coinPhase += 0.14;
  gameTime++;

  if(state === 'play'){
    updatePlayer();
    updateEnemies();
    updateItems();
    updateFireballs();

    if(timeLeft > 0){
      timeLeft -= 1/24;
      if(timeLeft <= 0){ timeLeft = 0; killPlayer(); }
    }
  } else if(state === 'dead'){
    stateTimer++;
    player.vy += 0.55;
    player.y += player.vy;
    if(stateTimer > 150){
      lives--;
      if(lives < 0){
        state = 'gameover';
        stateTimer = 0;
      } else {
        resetLevel(false);
      }
    }
  } else if(state === 'win'){
    updateWin();
    updateEnemies();
  }

  updateParticles();
  updateBumps();
  updateCamera();
}

/* ============================================================
   RENDER — BACKGROUND
   ============================================================ */
const clouds = [];
for(let i=0;i<40;i++){
  clouds.push({
    x: i*170 + (i*67 % 90),
    y: 14 + (i*53 % 62),
    s: 0.75 + (i % 3) * 0.35
  });
}
const hills = [];
for(let i=0;i<26;i++){
  hills.push({ x: i*230 + (i*91 % 60), s: 0.8 + (i % 2) * 0.55 });
}
const bushes = [];
for(let i=0;i<34;i++){
  bushes.push({ x: i*150 + (i*47 % 70), s: 0.8 + (i % 3) * 0.3 });
}

function drawCloud(x, y, s){
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x,          y,          11*s, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.arc(x + 13*s,   y - 7*s,    15*s, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.arc(x + 30*s,   y,          11*s, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.rect(x, y, 30*s, 11*s);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#d8ecff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + 13*s, y - 7*s, 15*s, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + 13*s, y - 8*s, 13*s, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawHill(x, baseY, r){
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2f9e2f';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, baseY, r, Math.PI, 0);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4ec44e';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x - r*0.25, baseY, r*0.7, Math.PI, 0);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2f9e2f';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + r*0.35, baseY, r*0.45, Math.PI, 0);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawBush(x, baseY, s){
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3aa03a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x,          baseY - 4*s, 9*s, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.arc(x + 13*s,   baseY - 8*s, 11*s, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.arc(x + 27*s,   baseY - 4*s, 9*s, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.rect(x - 9*s, baseY - 4*s, 45*s, 6*s);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4fc44f';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + 13*s, baseY - 10*s, 8*s, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawBackground(){
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, VH);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#5c94fc');
  g.addColorStop(0.7, '#8ec4ff');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#c8e4ff');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH);

  /* clouds — parallax 0.35 */
  const cx = cam.x * 0.35;
  for(const c of clouds){
    const sx = c.x - cx;
    if(sx < -120 || sx > VW + 120) continue;
    drawCloud(sx, c.y, c.s);
  }

  /* hills — parallax 0.55 */
  const hx = cam.x * 0.55;
  for(const h of hills){
    const sx = h.x - hx;
    if(sx < -160 || sx > VW + 160) continue;
    drawHill(sx, 208, 34 * h.s);
  }

  /* bushes — parallax 0.85 */
  const bx = cam.x * 0.85;
  for(const b of bushes){
    const sx = b.x - bx;
    if(sx < -80 || sx > VW + 80) continue;
    drawBush(sx, 208, b.s);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   RENDER — TILES
   ============================================================ */
function drawTiles(){
  const camX = Math.round(cam.x);
  const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(camX / TW) - 1);
  const x1 = Math.min(MAPW - 1, Math.ceil((camX + VW) / TW) + 1);

  for(let ty=0; ty<MAPH; ty++){
    for(let tx=x0; tx<=x1; tx++){
      const c = grid[ty][tx];
      if(c === ' ') continue;

      let oy = 0;
      const b = bumps.get(tx+','+ty);
      if(b !== undefined) oy = -Math.sin(b * Math.PI) * 7;

      ctx.drawImage(TILE_CACHE[c], Math.round(tx*TW - camX), Math.round(ty*TH + oy));
    }
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   RENDER — FLAG & CASTLE
   ============================================================ */
function drawFlagAndCastle(){
  const camX = Math.round(cam.x);

  /* --- flagpole --- */
  const px = Math.round(FLAG_X - camX);
  if(px > -60 && px < VW + 60){
    ctx.fillStyle = '#b8b8b8';
    ctx.fillRect(px, 48, 3, 160);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8e8e8';
    ctx.fillRect(px, 48, 1, 160);

    /* ball */
    ctx.fillStyle = '#00c000';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px + 1.5, 45, 5, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#60ff60';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px + 0.5, 44, 2, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    /* flag */
    const fy = Math.round(flagY);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e52521';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(px, fy);
    ctx.lineTo(px - 20, fy + 9);
    ctx.lineTo(px, fy + 18);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px - 8, fy + 9, 3, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  /* --- castle --- */
  const cxp = Math.round(CASTLE_X - camX);
  if(cxp > -160 && cxp < VW + 160){
    const baseY = 13*TH;
    const W = 96, H = 80;
    const x = cxp, y = baseY - H;

    /* main body */
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c85818';
    ctx.fillRect(x, y + 24, W, H - 24);

    /* brick pattern */
    ctx.fillStyle = '#a04000';
    for(let by = y + 24; by < baseY; by += 8){
      ctx.fillRect(x, by, W, 1);
      for(let bx = x + ((by/8) % 2 ? 0 : 8); bx < x + W; bx += 16){
        ctx.fillRect(bx, by, 1, 8);
      }
    }

    /* battlements */
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c85818';
    for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
      ctx.fillRect(x + i*16, y + 12, 10, 12);
    }
    ctx.fillRect(x, y + 24, W, 4);

    /* towers */
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c85818';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 12, y + 40, 16, H - 40);
    ctx.fillRect(x + W - 4, y + 40, 16, H - 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#a04000';
    for(let by = y + 40; by < baseY; by += 8){
      ctx.fillRect(x - 12, by, 16, 1);
      ctx.fillRect(x + W - 4, by, 16, 1);
    }

    /* tower tops */
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c85818';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 14, y + 32, 20, 10);
    ctx.fillRect(x + W - 6, y + 32, 20, 10);

    /* door */
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + 36, baseY);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 36, baseY - 22);
    ctx.arc(x + 48, baseY - 22, 12, Math.PI, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 60, baseY);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    /* windows */
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.fillRect(x + 16, y + 44, 10, 12);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 70, y + 44, 10, 12);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 44, y + 40, 10, 12);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   RENDER — COINS
   ============================================================ */
function drawCoin(x, y, phase){
  const w = Math.abs(Math.cos(phase)) * 5 + 1.5;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fcd800';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x + 8, y + 8, w, 7, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff8a0';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x + 8, y + 8, w * 0.45, 3.2, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawCoins(){
  const camX = Math.round(cam.x);
  for(const c of coins){
    if(c.taken) continue;
    const sx = c.x - camX - 2;
    if(sx < -20 || sx > VW + 20) continue;
    drawCoin(sx, c.y - 2, coinPhase);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   RENDER — ITEMS
   ============================================================ */
function drawItems(){
  const camX = Math.round(cam.x);
  for(const it of items){
    const sx = Math.round(it.x - camX) - 2;
    if(sx < -24 || sx > VW + 24) continue;
    const sy = Math.round(it.y) - 1;
    if(it.type === 'mushroom') ctx.drawImage(SPR.mushroom, sx, sy);
    else                       ctx.drawImage(SPR.flower, sx, sy);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   RENDER — ENEMIES
   ============================================================ */
function drawEnemies(){
  const camX = Math.round(cam.x);
  for(const e of enemies){
    const sx = Math.round(e.x - camX) - 1;
    if(sx < -24 || sx > VW + 24) continue;
    const sy = Math.round(e.y) - 1;

    if(e.dead && !e.flip){
      /* squashed */
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(sx, sy + 16);
      ctx.scale(1, 0.35);
      ctx.drawImage(SPR.goomba, 0, -16);
      ctx.restore();
    } else if(e.dead && e.flip){
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(sx + 8, sy + 8);
      ctx.scale(1, -1);
      ctx.drawImage(SPR.goomba, -8, -8);
      ctx.restore();
    } else {
      ctx.drawImage(SPR.goomba, sx, sy);
    }
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   RENDER — FIREBALLS
   ============================================================ */
function drawFireballs(){
  const camX = Math.round(cam.x);
  for(const f of fireballs){
    const sx = Math.round(f.x - camX);
    const sy = Math.round(f.y);
    const r = 4 + Math.sin(gameTime * 0.5) * 0.8;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8000';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx + 4, sy + 4, r, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe000';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx + 4, sy + 4, r * 0.5, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   RENDER — PARTICLES
   ============================================================ */
function drawParticles(){
  const camX = Math.round(cam.x);
  for(const q of particles){
    const sx = Math.round(q.x - camX);
    const sy = Math.round(q.y);
    const a = q.life / q.maxLife;

    if(q.type === 'brick'){
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, a * 1.6);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#c85818';
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 6, 6);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e89858';
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 1, sy + 1, 3, 3);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    } else if(q.type === 'coin'){
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, a * 1.6);
      drawCoin(sx, sy, coinPhase * 2);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    } else if(q.type === 'score'){
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, a * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.font = 'bold 8px monospace';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillText(q.val, sx, sy);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   RENDER — PLAYER
   ============================================================ */
function drawPlayer(){
  const p = player;
  if(p.invuln > 0 && Math.floor(gameTime / 4) % 2 === 0) return;

  const camX = Math.round(cam.x);
  const spr = p.big ? SPR.big : SPR.small;
  const sx = Math.round(p.x - camX);
  const sy = Math.round(p.y + p.h - spr.height);

  ctx.save();
  if(p.facing < 0){
    ctx.translate(sx + spr.width, sy);
    ctx.scale(-1, 1);
    ctx.drawImage(spr, 0, 0);
  } else {
    ctx.drawImage(spr, sx, sy);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ============================================================
   RENDER — HUD
   ============================================================ */
function drawHUD(){
  ctx.font = 'bold 9px monospace';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';

  const pad = (n, len) => String(n).padStart(len, '0');

  /* shadow helper */
  function txt(s, x, y){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
    ctx.fillText(s, x + 1, y + 1);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillText(s, x, y);
  }

  txt('MARIO', 16, 8);
  txt(pad(score, 6), 16, 20);

  /* coin icon */
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fcd800';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(120, 24, 4, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff8a0';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(120, 24, 1.6, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  txt('×' + pad(coinCount, 2), 128, 20);

  txt('WORLD', 220, 8);
  txt('1-1', 228, 20);

  txt('TIME', 320, 8);
  txt(pad(Math.max(0, Math.floor(timeLeft)), 3), 324, 20);

  txt('×' + lives, 372, 20);
  /* tiny mario head for lives */
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e52521';
  ctx.fillRect(358, 21, 8, 4);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f8b888';
  ctx.fillRect(359, 25, 6, 4);
}

/* ============================================================
   RENDER — TITLE / GAME OVER / CLEAR
   ============================================================ */
function drawTitle(){
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH);

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  /* title */
  ctx.font = 'bold 30px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.fillText('SUPER MARIO', VW/2 + 2, 72 + 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e52521';
  ctx.fillText('SUPER MARIO', VW/2, 72);

  ctx.font = 'bold 20px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.fillText('BROS.', VW/2 + 2, 102 + 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillText('BROS.', VW/2, 102);

  ctx.font = 'bold 10px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fcd800';
  ctx.fillText('— 1-1 REMIX —', VW/2, 130);

  /* blinking prompt */
  if(Math.floor(gameTime / 30) % 2 === 0){
    ctx.font = 'bold 11px monospace';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS  SPACE  TO  START', VW/2, 175);
  }

  ctx.font = 'bold 8px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#c8e4ff';
  ctx.fillText('← →  MOVE     SPACE  JUMP     SHIFT  RUN / FIRE', VW/2, 210);

  /* mario on the title */
  const bob = Math.sin(gameTime * 0.06) * 3;
  ctx.drawImage(SPR.big, VW/2 - 6, 138 + bob);
}

function drawGameOver(){
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', VW/2, VH/2 - 10);
  ctx.font = 'bold 10px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fcd800';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO PLAY AGAIN', VW/2, VH/2 + 24);
}

function drawClear(){
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.fillText('COURSE CLEAR!', VW/2 + 2, VH/2 - 8 + 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fcd800';
  ctx.fillText('COURSE CLEAR!', VW/2, VH/2 - 8);

  ctx.font = 'bold 10px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE  ' + String(score).padStart(6,'0'), VW/2, VH/2 + 22);
  ctx.fillText('COINS  ×' + String(coinCount).padStart(2,'0'), VW/2, VH/2 + 38);
}

/* ============================================================
   RENDER
   ============================================================ */
function render(){
  drawBackground();
  drawTiles();
  drawFlagAndCastle();
  drawCoins();
  drawItems();
  drawEnemies();
  drawFireballs();
  drawParticles();
  if(state !== 'title') drawPlayer();
  drawHUD();

  if(state === 'title')    drawTitle();
  if(state === 'gameover') drawGameOver();
  if(state === 'win' && showClear) drawClear();
}

/* ============================================================
   MAIN LOOP
   ============================================================ */
let lastT = 0, acc = 0;
const STEP = 1/60;

function loop(t){
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  if(!lastT) lastT = t;
  let dt = (t - lastT) / 1000;
  lastT = t;
  if(dt > 0.25) dt = 0.25;
  acc += dt;
  let guard = 0;
  while(acc >= STEP && guard++ < 5){
    step();
    acc -= STEP;
  }
  render();
}

/* ============================================================
   BOOT
   ============================================================ */
coinPhase = 0;
gameTime = 0;
newGame();
state = 'title';
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

prompt: Recreate a Super Mario Bros. level — make it interactive and fun, feel free to get creative and showcase your skills. Stick to the spirit of nintendo games. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Super Mario Bros. Level</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; }
        canvas { display: block; background: lightblue; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas" width="600" height="400"></canvas>
<script>
    var canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

    var gravity = 0.5;
    var friction = 0.8;
    var acceleration = 0.3;
    var jumpPower = -10;

    var keys = {
        left: false,
        right: false,
        up: false
    };

    var score = 0;

    var mario = {
        x: 50,
        y: 310,
        width: 30,
        height: 40,
        vx: 0,
        vy: 0,
        onGround: false
    };

    var level = {
        platforms: [
            {x:0, y:350, width:600, height:50, color: 'brown'}, // Ground
            {x:200, y:250, width:200, height:20, color: 'gray'}, // Middle platform
            {x:400, y:200, width:100, height:20, color: 'gray'}, // Upper platform
        ],
        bricks: [
            {x:250, y:250, width:30, height:30}, // Brick on middle platform
        ],
        coins: [
            {x:250, y:200, radius:10},
            {x:300, y:200, radius:10},
            {x:400, y:170, radius:10},
        ],
        enemies: [
            {x:300, y:310, width:20, height:20, direction: -1, speed: 2}, // Goomba
        ],
        pipes: [
            {x:450, y:200, width:50, height:150}, // Pipe
        ]
    };

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        switch(e.keyCode) {
            case 37: keys.left = true; break;
            case 39: keys.right = true; break;
            case 38: keys.up = true; break;
        }
    });

    document.addEventListener('keyup', function(e) {
        switch(e.keyCode) {
            case 37: keys.left = false; break;
            case 39: keys.right = false; break;
            case 38: keys.up = false; break;
        }
    });

    function rectCollision(rect1, rect2) {
        return rect1.x < rect2.x + rect2.width &&
               rect1.x + rect1.width > rect2.x &&
               rect1.y < rect2.y + rect2.height &&
               rect1.y + rect1.height > rect2.y;
    }

    function rectCircleCollision(rect, circle) {
        let distX = Math.abs(rect.x + rect.width/2 - circle.x);
        let distY = Math.abs(rect.y + rect.height/2 - circle.y);
        if (distX > (rect.width/2 + circle.radius)) return false;
        if (distY > (rect.height/2 + circle.radius)) return false;
        if (distX <= rect.width/2) return true;
        if (distY <= rect.height/2) return true;
        let cornerDist = Math.sqrt( (distX - rect.width/2)**2 + (distY - rect.height/2)**2 );
        return cornerDist <= circle.radius;
    }

    function update() {
        // Mario movement
        if (keys.left) mario.vx -= acceleration;
        if (keys.right) mario.vx += acceleration;
        if (!keys.left && !keys.right) mario.vx *= friction;

        // Apply gravity
        mario.vy += gravity;

        // Update position
        mario.x += mario.vx;
        mario.y += mario.vy;

        // Ground collision
        if (mario.y + mario.height > level.platforms[0].y) {
            mario.y = level.platforms[0].y - mario.height;
            mario.vy = 0;
            mario.onGround = true;
        } else {
            mario.onGround = false;
        }

        // Jump
        if (keys.up && mario.onGround) {
            mario.vy = jumpPower;
            mario.onGround = false;
        }

        // Update enemies
        for (let enemy of level.enemies) {
            enemy.x += enemy.direction * enemy.speed;
            if (enemy.x < 0 || enemy.x + enemy.width > canvas.width) {
                enemy.direction *= -1;
            }
        }

        // Platform collisions
        for (let platform of level.platforms) {
            if (rectCollision(mario, platform)) {
                if (mario.vy > 0) {
                    mario.y = platform.y - mario.height;
                    mario.vy = 0;
                    mario.onGround = true;
                } else if (mario.vy < 0) {
                    mario.y = platform.y + platform.height;
                    mario.vy = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        // Brick collisions
        for (let i = level.bricks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            let brick = level.bricks[i];
            if (rectCollision(mario, brick)) {
                if (mario.vy > 0 && mario.y + mario.height > brick.y) {
                    let coin = {x: brick.x + brick.width/2, y: brick.y, radius: 10};
                    level.coins.push(coin);
                    level.bricks.splice(i, 1);
                    mario.y = brick.y - mario.height;
                    mario.vy = 0;
                    mario.onGround = true;
                }
            }
        }

        // Enemy collisions
        for (let enemy of level.enemies) {
            if (rectCollision(mario, enemy)) {
                if (mario.vy < 0) {
                    level.enemies = level.enemies.filter(e => e !== enemy);
                    mario.vy = jumpPower;
                    score += 100;
                } else {
                    mario.x = 50;
                    mario.y = 310;
                    mario.vy = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        // Coin collection
        for (let i = level.coins.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            let coin = level.coins[i];
            if (rectCircleCollision(mario, coin)) {
                score += 10;
                level.coins.splice(i, 1);
            }
        }
    }

    function draw() {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        // Sky
        ctx.fillStyle = 'lightblue';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, 350);

        // Ground
        ctx.fillStyle = 'brown';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 350, canvas.width, 50);

        // Platforms
        for (let platform of level.platforms) {
            ctx.fillStyle = platform.color;
            ctx.fillRect(platform.x, platform.y, platform.width, platform.height);
        }

        // Bricks
        for (let brick of level.bricks) {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'brown';
            ctx.fillRect(brick.x, brick.y, brick.width, brick.height);
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'darkbrown';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(brick.x, brick.y);
            ctx.lineTo(brick.x + brick.width, brick.y + brick.height);
            ctx.stroke();
        }

        // Coins
        ctx.fillStyle = 'yellow';
        for (let coin of level.coins) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(coin.x, coin.y, coin.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }

        // Enemies
        for (let enemy of level.enemies) {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'brown';
            ctx.fillRect(enemy.x, enemy.y, enemy.width, enemy.height);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(enemy.x + 5, enemy.y + 5, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.arc(enemy.x + 15, enemy.y + 5, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }

        // Pipes
        ctx.fillStyle = 'green';
        for (let pipe of level.pipes) {
            ctx.fillRect(pipe.x, pipe.y, pipe.width, pipe.height);
        }

        // Mario
        ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
        ctx.fillRect(mario.x, mario.y - 10, mario.width, 10);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'blue';
        ctx.fillRect(mario.x, mario.y, mario.width, mario.height - 10);

        // Score
        ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
        ctx.font = '20px Arial';
        ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 30);
    }

    function gameLoop() {
        update();
        draw();
        requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
    }

    gameLoop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

question: mario-level-ui
prompt: Recreate a Super Mario Bros. level — make it interactive and fun, feel free to get creative and showcase your skills. Stick to the spirit of nintendo games. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Super Mario Bros. Level</title>
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
body{background:#000;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;height:100vh;overflow:hidden;font-family:'Courier New',monospace}
canvas{image-rendering:pixelated;image-rendering:crisp-edges;border:3px solid #5a3a1a}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
// ============================================
// SUPER MARIO BROS. LEVEL - Complete Game
// ============================================

const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const GW = 800, GH = 480;
canvas.width = GW; canvas.height = GH;

function resize() {
  const s = Math.min(window.innerWidth / GW, window.innerHeight / GH) * 0.95;
  canvas.style.width = (GW * s) + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = (GH * s) + 'px';
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize); resize();

// Constants
const T = 32, MW = 220, MH = 15;
const GRAV = 0.55, MAXFALL = 11, PSPD = 3.8, JUMP = -10.2;
const COYOTE = 7, JBUF = 8;

// Tile types
const E=0, G=1, B=2, Q=3, C=4, PL=5, PR=6, F=7, S=8;

// Tile solid check
function isSolid(t) { return t===G||t===B||t===PL||t===PR||t===S; }
function isBumpable(t) { return t===Q||t===C; }

// Level map
let map = [];
let usedBlocks = [];
let goombas = [];
let coinList = [];
let particles = [];
let popups = [];
let clouds = [];
let hills = [];
let flagX = 0;

// Player
let P = {};
let cam = {x:0, y:0, shake:0};
let keys = {};
let state = 'menu'; // menu, play, die, win
let score = 0, coinCount = 0, lives = 3, timeLeft = 400;
let frameCount = 0, deathTimer = 0, winTimer = 0;
let gameTime = 0;
let audioCtx = null;

// ============================================
// AUDIO SYSTEM
// ============================================
function initAudio() {
  if (audioCtx) return;
  audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
}

function sfx(type) {
  if (!audioCtx) return;
  const t = audioCtx.currentTime;
  const o = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  const g = audioCtx.createGain();
  o.connect(g); g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
  switch(type) {
    case 'jump':
      o.type='square'; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(280,t);
      o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(560,t+0.08);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1,t); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+0.1);
      o.start(t); o.stop(t+0.1); break;
    case 'coin':
      o.type='square'; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(988,t);
      o.frequency.setValueAtTime(1319,t+0.06);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1,t); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+0.12);
      o.start(t); o.stop(t+0.12); break;
    case 'stomp':
      o.type='square'; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(200,t);
      o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(80,t+0.08);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15,t); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+0.12);
      o.start(t); o.stop(t+0.12); break;
    case 'bump':
      o.type='square'; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(150,t);
      o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(100,t+0.05);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.08,t); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+0.06);
      o.start(t); o.stop(t+0.06); break;
    case 'powerup':
      o.type='square'; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(440,t);
      o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(880,t+0.1);
      o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(1320,t+0.2);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12,t); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+0.3);
      o.start(t); o.stop(t+0.3); break;
    case 'die':
      o.type='square'; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(440,t);
      o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(110,t+0.5);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15,t); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+0.6);
      o.start(t); o.stop(t+0.6); break;
    case 'win':
      [523,659,784,1047].forEach((f,i)=>{
        const oo=audioCtx.createOscillator(), gg=audioCtx.createGain();
        oo.connect(gg); gg.connect(audioCtx.destination);
        oo.type='square'; oo.frequency.setValueAtTime(f,t+i*0.15);
        gg.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1,t+i*0.15); gg.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+i*0.15+0.2);
        oo.start(t+i*0.15); oo.stop(t+i*0.15+0.2);
      }); return;
    case '1up':
      o.type='square'; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(660,t);
      o.frequency.setValueAtTime(880,t+0.08); o.frequency.setValueAtTime(1100,t+0.16);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1,t); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+0.25);
      o.start(t); o.stop(t+0.25); break;
  }
}

// ============================================
// LEVEL BUILDING
// ============================================
function initLevel() {
  map = []; usedBlocks = [];
  for (let y=0; y<MH; y++) { map[y]=[]; usedBlocks[y]=[]; for(let x=0;x<MW;x++){map[y][x]=E;usedBlocks[y][x]=false;} }
  
  // Ground
  for(let x=0;x<MW;x++){map[13][x]=G;map[14][x]=G;}
  
  // Pits
  function pit(a,b){for(let i=a;i<=b;i++){map[13][i]=E;map[14][i]=E;}}
  pit(17,22); pit(42,47); pit(68,73); pit(103,108); pit(135,140); pit(162,167);
  
  // Question blocks
  function qb(x,y,t){map[y][x]=t;}
  qb(5,12,Q); qb(11,12,C); qb(29,12,Q); qb(49,11,Q); qb(53,11,C);
  qb(61,9,Q); qb(62,9,C); qb(86,8,Q); qb(116,10,Q); qb(117,10,C);
  qb(150,8,Q); qb(151,8,C); qb(180,10,Q);
  
  // Brick blocks
  function brickRow(x,y,n){for(let i=0;i<n;i++)map[y][x+i]=B;}
  function brickCol(x,y,n){for(let i=0;i<n;i++)map[y+i][x]=B;}
  function brick(x,y){map[y][x]=B;}
  brickRow(21,12,3); brickRow(31,11,2); brickCol(36,12,2);
  brickRow(56,12,2); brickCol(57,11,2); brick(58,10);
  brickRow(82,12,4); brickRow(92,11,2); brick(93,10); brick(94,10);
  brickRow(110,12,3); brick(111,11); brick(112,11);
  brickRow(143,12,3); brick(144,11); brick(145,11);
  brickRow(165,12,2); brick(166,11);
  
  // Pipes
  function pipe(x,y,h){for(let i=0;i<h;i++){map[y-i][x]=PL;map[y-i][x+1]=PR;}map[y+1][x]=G;map[y+1][x+1]=G;}
  pipe(37,12,2); pipe(54,11,3); pipe(79,12,2); pipe(109,12,3);
  pipe(149,12,2); pipe(179,12,3); pipe(195,12,2);
  
  // Floating platforms
  function plat(x,y,w){for(let i=0;i<w;i++)map[y][x+i]=B;}
  plat(60,9,3); plat(86,8,2); plat(115,10,4); plat(153,8,2); plat(186,9,3);
  
  // Stairs
  for(let i=0;i<10;i++)for(let j=0;j<=i;j++)map[12-j][152+i]=S;
  
  // Flagpole
  flagX = 175;
  for(let y=0;y<13;y++)map[y][flagX]=F;
  map[13][flagX]=F; map[13][flagX+1]=F;
  
  // Goombas
  spawnGoomba(19); spawnGoomba(44); spawnGoomba(70);
  spawnGoomba(105); spawnGoomba(140); spawnGoomba(165); spawnGoomba(185);
  
  // Floating coins
  addFCoin(6,10); addFCoin(12,10); addFCoin(30,9); addFCoin(50,8);
  addFCoin(54,8); addFCoin(62,7); addFCoin(87,6); addFCoin(117,8);
  addFCoin(151,6); addFCoin(181,8); addFCoin(186,7); addFCoin(187,7);
  
  // Clouds and hills for background
  for(let i=0;i<12;i++)clouds.push({x:Math.random()*MW*T, y:20+Math.random()*80, w:40+Math.random()*60});
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++)hills.push({x:i*300-100, w:200+Math.random()*200});
}

function spawnGoomba(wx){
  goombas.push({x:wx*T+8, y:12*T-24, alive:true, dir:1, frame:0, animTimer:0});
}
function addFCoin(gx,gy){
  coinList.push({x:gx*T+12, y:gy*T, vy:-2, frame:0, alive:true, fromBlock:false});
}

// ============================================
// PLAYER
// ============================================
function resetPlayer(){
  P = {x:64, y:0, vx:0, vy:0, w:20, h:28, onGround:false, facing:1,
       frame:0, frameTimer:0, squash:1, stretch:1,
       coyote:0, jumpBuf:0, dead:false, deadTimer:0,
       invincible:0, win:false, winTimer:0, climbY:0};
}

// ============================================
// INPUT
// ============================================
document.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{
  keys[e.code]=true;
  if(e.code==='Space'||e.code==='ArrowUp'||e.code==='KeyW') e.preventDefault();
  if(state==='menu'&&e.code==='Space'){initAudio();startGame();}
  if(state==='gameover'&&e.code==='Space'){initAudio();startGame();}
  if(state==='win'&&e.code==='Space'){initAudio();startGame();}
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', e=>keys[e.code]=false);

// Touch controls
let touchL=false, touchR=false, touchJ=false;
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{
  e.preventDefault(); initAudio();
  const t=e.touches[0];
  if(t.clientX<window.innerWidth*0.33)touchL=true;
  else if(t.clientX>window.innerWidth*0.66)touchJ=true;
  else touchR=true;
  if(state==='menu'||state==='gameover'||state==='win')startGame();
},{passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('touchend',e=>{touchL=false;touchR=false;touchJ=false;});
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove',e=>e.preventDefault(),{passive:false});

// ============================================
// GAME LOGIC
// ============================================
function startGame(){
  initLevel(); resetPlayer(); score=0; coinCount=0; timeLeft=400;
  goombas=[]; coinList=[]; particles=[]; popups=[];
  // Re-spawn enemies and coins
  spawnGoomba(19); spawnGoomba(44); spawnGoomba(70);
  spawnGoomba(105); spawnGoomba(140); spawnGoomba(165); spawnGoomba(185);
  addFCoin(6,10); addFCoin(12,10); addFCoin(30,9); addFCoin(50,8);
  addFCoin(54,8); addFCoin(62,7); addFCoin(87,6); addFCoin(117,8);
  addFCoin(151,6); addFCoin(181,8); addFCoin(186,7); addFCoin(187,7);
  state='play'; frameCount=0; gameTime=0; deathTimer=0; winTimer=0;
}

function getTile(px,py){
  const tx=Math.floor(px/T), ty=Math.floor(py/T);
  if(tx<0||tx>=MW||ty<0||ty>=MH)return E;
  return map[ty][tx];
}

function rectsOverlap(a,b){
  return a.x<b.x+b.w && a.x+a.w>b.x && a.y<b.y+b.h && a.y+a.h>b.y;
}

function updatePlayer(){
  if(P.dead||P.win)return;
  
  // Horizontal input
  if(keys['ArrowLeft']||keys['KeyA']||touchL){P.vx=-PSPD;P.facing=-1;}
  else if(keys['ArrowRight']||keys['KeyD']||touchR){P.vx=PSPD;P.facing=1;}
  else{P.vx*=0.85;}
  
  // Jump buffer
  if(keys['ArrowUp']||keys['KeyW']||keys['Space']||touchJ){
    if(P.jumpBuf<=0)P.jumpBuf=JBUF;
  }
  
  // Coyote time
  if(P.onGround)P.coyote=COYOTE;
  else P.coyote=Math.max(0,P.coyote-1);
  
  // Jump
  if(P.jumpBuf>0){
    if(P.coyote>0||P.onGround){
      P.vy=JUMP; P.onGround=false; P.coyote=0; P.jumpBuf=0;
      P.stretch=1.2; P.squash=0.8;
      sfx('jump');
      // Jump particles
      for(let i=0;i<3;i++)addParticle(P.x+P.w/2,P.y+P.h,Math.random()*2-1,-1-Math.random()*2,'#fff',0.5+Math.random()*0.3);
    }
  }
  
  // Variable jump height
  if(!keys['ArrowUp']&&!keys['KeyW']&&!keys['Space']&&!touchJ){
    if(P.vy<-3)P.vy=-3;
  }
  
  // Gravity
  P.vy+=GRAV;
  if(P.vy>MAXFALL)P.vy=MAXFALL;
  
  // Move X
  P.x+=P.vx;
  resolveX();
  
  // Move Y
  P.y+=P.vy;
  P.onGround=false;
  resolveY();
  
  // Squash/stretch recovery
  P.squash+=(1-P.squash)*0.2;
  P.stretch+=(1-P.stretch)*0.2;
  
  // Animation
  P.frameTimer++;
  if(Math.abs(P.vx)>0.5&&P.onGround){
    if(P.frameTimer>4){P.frame=(P.frame+1)%4;P.frameTimer=0;}
  }else if(!P.onGround){
    P.frame=4; // Jump frame
  }else{
    P.frame=0; P.frameTimer=0;
  }
  
  // Invincibility
  if(P.invincible>0)P.invincible--;
  
  // Fall off map
  if(P.y>MH*T+100){playerDie();}
  
  // Check goomba collisions
  for(let g of goombas){
    if(!g.alive)continue;
    let gb={x:g.x-4,y:g.y-4,w:28,h:28};
    let pb={x:P.x+2,y:P.y+2,w:P.w-4,h:P.h-4};
    if(rectsOverlap(pb,gb)){
      if(P.vy>0&&P.y+P.h-8<g.y+8){
        // Stomp!
        g.alive=false;
        P.vy=-7;
        score+=100;
        sfx('stomp');
        cam.shake=6;
        for(let i=0;i<6;i++)addParticle(g.x+12,g.y+12,Math.random()*4-2,-Math.random()*4-2,'#8B4513',0.8);
        for(let i=0;i<4;i++)addParticle(g.x+12,g.y+12,Math.random()*3-1.5,-Math.random()*3-1,'#DEB887',0.6);
      }else{
        playerDie();
      }
    }
  }
  
  // Check coin block collisions (from side)
  // Check if player is touching a coin block from the side
  // (handled in block hit logic below)
  
  // Flagpole
  if(P.x+P.w>flagX&&P.x<flagX+4&&P.y+P.h>13*T&&P.y<13*T){
    P.win=true; P.winTimer=0;
  }
  
  // Climb flagpole
  if(P.win){
    P.vx=0;P.vy=0;
    P.winTimer++;
    if(P.winTimer<60){
      P.y-=2;
      if(P.winTimer===30){score+=1000;sfx('1up');}
      if(P.winTimer===60){state='win';sfx('win');}
    }
  }
  
  // Coin collection
  for(let c of coinList){
    if(!c.alive)continue;
    let cb={x:c.x-6,y:c.y-6,w:12,h:12};
    let pb={x:P.x+2,y:P.y+2,w:P.w-4,h:P.h-4};
    if(rectsOverlap(pb,cb)){
      c.alive=false;
      coinCount++; score+=200;
      sfx('coin');
      popups.push({x:c.x,y:c.y-10,text:'+200',life:40,color:'#FFD700'});
      for(let i=0;i<4;i++)addParticle(c.x,c.y,Math.random()*3-1.5,-Math.random()*3-1,'#FFD700',0.5);
    }
  }
}

function resolveX(){
  const left=Math.floor(P.x/T), right=Math.floor((P.x+P.w-1)/T);
  const top=Math.floor(P.y/T), bottom=Math.floor((P.y+P.h-1)/T);
  for(let ty=top;ty<=bottom;ty++){
    for(let tx=left;tx<=right;tx++){
      if(tx<0||tx>=MW||ty<0||ty>=MH)continue;
      if(isSolid(map[ty][tx])){
        if(P.vx>0){P.x=tx*T-P.w;P.vx=0;}
        else if(P.vx<0){P.x=(tx+1)*T;P.vx=0;}
      }
    }
  }
}

function resolveY(){
  const left=Math.floor(P.x/T), right=Math.floor((P.x+P.w-1)/T);
  const top=Math.floor(P.y/T), bottom=Math.floor((P.y+P.h-1)/T);
  for(let ty=top;ty<=bottom;ty++){
    for(let tx=left;tx<=right;tx++){
      if(tx<0||tx>=MW||ty<0||ty>=MH)continue;
      const tile=map[ty][tx];
      if(isSolid(tile)||isBumpable(tile)){
        if(P.vy>0){
          P.y=ty*T-P.h; P.vy=0; P.onGround=true;
          // Check if we landed on a bumpable block - don't trigger
        }else if(P.vy<0){
          P.y=(ty+1)*T; P.vy=0;
          if(isBumpable(tile))hitBlock(tx,ty);
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

function hitBlock(tx,ty){
  if(usedBlocks[ty][tx])return;
  usedBlocks[ty][tx]=true;
  sfx('bump');
  cam.shake=3;
  
  const tile=map[ty][tx];
  if(tile===Q){
    // Question block gives coin
    map[ty][tx]=Q; // stays as question but used
    score+=100;
    sfx('coin');
    popups.push({x:tx*T+T/2,y:ty*T-10,text:'+100',life:40,color:'#FFD700'});
    // Spawn coin that floats up
    coinList.push({x:tx*T+T/2,y:ty*T,vy:-3,frame:0,alive:true,fromBlock:true});
    // Block bump animation
    usedBlocks[ty][tx]=true;
    // Change to used block visually
    // We'll keep Q but mark as used
  }else if(tile===C){
    // Coin block gives coin
    score+=100; coinCount++;
    sfx('coin');
    popups.push({x:tx*T+T/2,y:ty*T-10,text:'+100',life:40,color:'#FFD700'});
    coinList.push({x:tx*T+T/2,y:ty*T,vy:-3,frame:0,alive:true,fromBlock:true});
  }
}

function playerDie(){
  if(P.dead)return;
  P.dead=true; P.deadTimer=0; P.vy=-8; P.vx=2;
  sfx('die');
  state='die'; deathTimer=0;
}

function addParticle(x,y,vx,vy,color,life){
  particles.push({x,y,vx,vy,color,life,maxLife:life,size:2+Math.random()*3});
}

// ============================================
// ENEMY UPDATE
// ============================================
function updateGoombas(){
  for(let g of goombas){
    if(!g.alive)continue;
    g.x+=g.dir*1.2;
    g.animTimer++;
    g.frame=Math.floor(g.animTimer/8)%2;
    
    // Edge detection
    const frontX=g.x+(g.dir>0?20:-4);
    const belowTile=getTile(frontX,g.y+28);
    const frontTile=getTile(frontX,g.y+14);
    if(belowTile===E||frontTile===PL||frontTile===PR){
      g.dir*=-1;
    }
    
    // Check if goomba fell in pit
    if(getTile(g.x+12,g.y+29)===E&&getTile(g.x+16,g.y+29)===E){
      g.alive=false;
    }
  }
}

// ============================================
// UPDATE
// ============================================
function update(){
  frameCount++;
  gameTime++;
  
  // Timer
  if(frameCount%60===0&&state==='play')timeLeft--;
  if(timeLeft<=0&&state==='play'){playerDie();}
  
  if(state==='play'){
    updatePlayer();
    updateGoombas();
    
    // Update coin animations
    for(let c of coinList){
      if(!c.alive)continue;
      if(c.fromBlock){
        c.vy+=0.3;
        c.y+=c.vy;
        c.frame+=0.1;
        if(c.y>c._startY+40)c.alive=false;
      }else{
        c.frame+=0.05;
      }
    }
    
    // Update particles
    for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      let p=particles[i];
      p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.vy+=0.1;p.life--;
      if(p.life<=0)particles.splice(i,1);
    }
    
    // Update popups
    for(let i=popups.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      popups[i].y-=0.5;popups[i].life--;
      if(popups[i].life<=0)popups.splice(i,1);
    }
    
    // Camera
    const targetCam=P.x-GW/3;
    cam.x+=(targetCam-cam.x)*0.1;
    cam.x=Math.max(0,Math.min(cam.x,MW*T-GW));
    
    // Camera shake
    if(cam.shake>0)cam.shake*=0.85;
    if(cam.shake<0.1)cam.shake=0;
  }
  
  if(state==='die'){
    deathTimer++;
    P.vy+=GRAV;P.y+=P.vy;P.x+=P.vx;
    P.squash=1+Math.sin(deathTimer*0.3)*0.3;
    if(deathTimer>60){
      lives--;
      if(lives>0){resetPlayer();state='play';}
      else{state='gameover';}
    }
  }
  
  if(state==='win'){
    winTimer++;
  }
}

// ============================================
// RENDERING
// ============================================
function drawBackground(){
  // Sky gradient
  const grad=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,GH);
  grad.addColorStop(0,'#5c94fc');
  grad.addColorStop(0.7,'#5c94fc');
  grad.addColorStop(1,'#00a800');
  ctx.fillStyle=grad;ctx.fillRect(0,0,GW,GH);
  
  // Clouds (parallax)
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
  for(let c of clouds){
    const sx=c.x-cam.x*0.3;
    const wrapped=((sx%((MW+2)*T))+((MW+2)*T))%((MW+2)*T);
    if(wrapped>-60&&wrapped<GW+60){
      drawCloud(wrapped,c.y,c.w);
    }
  }
  
  // Hills (parallax)
  ctx.fillStyle='#00a800';
  for(let h of hills){
    const sx=h.x-cam.x*0.6;
    const wrapped=((sx%((MW+1)*T))+((MW+1)*T))%((MW+1)*T);
    if(wrapped>-200&&wrapped<GW+200){
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(wrapped+100,GH-40,h.w/2,50,0,Math.PI,0);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
}

function drawCloud(x,y,w){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x,y,w/2,12,0,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.ellipse(x-w/4,y+4,w/3,10,0,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.ellipse(x+w/4,y+4,w/3,10,0,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawTile(tx,ty){
  const t=map[ty][tx];
  if(t===E)return;
  const sx=tx*T-cam.x, sy=ty*T;
  if(sx<-T||sx>GW||sy<-T||sy>GH)return;
  
  switch(t){
    case G: // Ground
      ctx.fillStyle='#c84c0c';
      ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,T,T);
      ctx.fillStyle='#a03808';
      ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,T,4);
      ctx.fillStyle='#e8a040';
      for(let i=0;i<4;i++)ctx.fillRect(sx+4+i*8,sy+4,4,4);
      ctx.fillStyle='#8b6914';
      ctx.fillRect(sx,sy+T-4,T,4);
      break;
    case B: // Brick
      ctx.fillStyle='#c84c0c';
      ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,T,T);
      ctx.fillStyle='#a03808';
      ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,T,2);
      ctx.fillRect(sx,sy+T-2,T,2);
      ctx.fillStyle='#e8a040';
      ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,2,T);
      ctx.fillRect(sx+T-2,sy,2,T);
      ctx.strokeStyle='#8b3a0a';ctx.lineWidth=1;
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(sx+T/2,sy);ctx.lineTo(sx+T/2,sy+T);ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(sx,sy+T/2);ctx.lineTo(sx+T,sy+T/2);ctx.stroke();
      break;
    case Q: // Question block
      if(usedBlocks[ty][tx]){
        // Used block
        ctx.fillStyle='#e8a040';
        ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,T,T);
        ctx.fillStyle='#c88020';
        ctx.fillRect(sx+2,sy+2,T-4,T-4);
      }else{
        ctx.fillStyle='#e8a040';
        ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,T,T);
        ctx.fillStyle='#c88020';
        ctx.fillRect(sx+2,sy+2,T-4,T-4);
        // Question mark
        ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
        ctx.font='bold 18px "Courier New"';
        ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
        ctx.fillText('?',sx+T/2,sy+T/2+1);
      }
      break;
    case C: // Coin block
      if(usedBlocks[ty][tx]){
        ctx.fillStyle='#e8a040';
        ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,T,T);
        ctx.fillStyle='#c88020';
        ctx.fillRect(sx+2,sy+2,T-4,T-4);
      }else{
        ctx.fillStyle='#e8a040';
        ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,T,T);
        ctx.fillStyle='#c88020';
        ctx.fillRect(sx+2,sy+2,T-4,T-4);
        // Coin icon
        ctx.fillStyle='#FFD700';
        ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx+T/2,sy+T/2,6,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle='#DAA520';
        ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx+T/2,sy+T/2,4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
      }
      break;
    case PL: // Pipe left
      ctx.fillStyle='#00a800';
      ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,T,T);
      ctx.fillStyle='#00c800';
      ctx.fillRect(sx+2,sy+2,T-4,T-4);
      ctx.fillStyle='#008000';
      ctx.fillRect(sx+T-6,sy,6,T);
      ctx.fillStyle='#00e000';
      ctx.fillRect(sx+T-4,sy+2,4,T-4);
      break;
    case PR: // Pipe right
      ctx.fillStyle='#00a800';
      ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,T,T);
      ctx.fillStyle='#00c800';
      ctx.fillRect(sx+2,sy+2,T-4,T-4);
      ctx.fillStyle='#008000';
      ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,6,T);
      ctx.fillStyle='#00e000';
      ctx.fillRect(sx+2,sy+2,4,T-4);
      break;
    case F: // Flagpole
      ctx.fillStyle='#888';
      ctx.fillRect(sx+T/2-2,sy,4,T);
      // Flag
      ctx.fillStyle='#ff0000';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx+T/2+2,sy+4);
      ctx.lineTo(sx+T/2+20,sy+8);
      ctx.lineTo(sx+T/2+2,sy+16);
      ctx.fill();
      break;
    case S: // Stair
      ctx.fillStyle='#c84c0c';
      ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,T,T);
      ctx.fillStyle='#a03808';
      ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,T,2);
      ctx.fillStyle='#e8a040';
      ctx.fillRect(sx,sy+T-2,T,2);
      break;
  }
}

function drawPlayer(){
  if(P.dead&&deathTimer>10)return;
  const sx=P.x-cam.x, sy=P.y-cam.y;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(sx+P.w/2,sy+P.h);
  ctx.scale(P.facing*P.squash,P.stretch);
  
  const f=P.frame;
  // Hat
  ctx.fillStyle='#c80000';
  ctx.fillRect(-8,-28,16,6);
  ctx.fillRect(-6,-24,12,4);
  // Face
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffb366';
  ctx.fillRect(-7,-18,14,8);
  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle='#000';
  ctx.fillRect(-4,-16,3,3);
  ctx.fillRect(2,-16,3,3);
  // Mustache
  ctx.fillStyle='#5a2800';
  ctx.fillRect(-5,-10,10,2);
  // Body (shirt)
  ctx.fillStyle='#c80000';
  ctx.fillRect(-7,-10,14,6);
  // Overalls
  ctx.fillStyle='#0000cc';
  ctx.fillRect(-6,-4,12,5);
  // Overalls strap
  ctx.fillStyle='#0000cc';
  ctx.fillRect(-4,-10,2,6);
  // Arms
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffb366';
  if(f===1||f===3){
    ctx.fillRect(-10,-6,3,5);
    ctx.fillRect(7,-6,3,5);
  }else{
    ctx.fillRect(-9,-4,3,4);
    ctx.fillRect(6,-4,3,4);
  }
  // Shoes
  ctx.fillStyle='#8b4513';
  ctx.fillRect(-8,2,5,3);
  ctx.fillRect(3,2,5,3);
  
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawGoomba(g){
  if(!g.alive)return;
  const sx=g.x-cam.x, sy=g.y-cam.y;
  const w=24, h=24;
  
  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle='#8B4513';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(sx+12,sy+14,12,10,0,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Head
  ctx.fillStyle='#a0522d';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(sx+12,sy+6,10,8,0,Math.PI,0);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx+7,sy+4,4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx+17,sy+4,4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#000';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx+8,sy+4,2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx+18,sy+4,2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  
  // Eyebrows
  ctx.fillStyle='#5a2800';
  ctx.fillRect(sx+4,sy+1,6,2);
  ctx.fillRect(sx+14,sy+1,6,2);
  
  // Feet
  ctx.fillStyle='#5a2800';
  if(g.frame===0){
    ctx.fillRect(sx+2,sy+20,8,4);
    ctx.fillRect(sx+14,sy+20,8,4);
  }else{
    ctx.fillRect(sx+0,sy+20,8,4);
    ctx.fillRect(sx+16,sy+20,8,4);
  }
}

function drawCoin(c){
  if(!c.alive)return;
  const sx=c.x-cam.x, sy=c.y-cam.y;
  const bounce=Math.abs(Math.sin(c.frame*3))*4;
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFD700';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx,sy-bounce,8,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#DAA520';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx,sy-bounce,5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFE44D';
  ctx.font='bold 8px "Courier New"';
  ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillText('$',sx,sy-bounce);
}

function drawParticles(){
  for(let p of particles){
    const alpha=p.life/p.maxLife;
    ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;
    ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x-cam.x,p.y-cam.y,p.size,p.size);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}

function drawPopups(){
  for(let p of popups){
    const alpha=Math.min(1,p.life/20);
    ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;
    ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
    ctx.font='bold 12px "Courier New"';
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText(p.text,p.x-cam.x,p.y-cam.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}

function drawHUD(){
  // Background
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,GW,32);
  
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.font='bold 14px "Courier New"';
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+String(score).padStart(6,'0'),8,22);
  
  // Coins
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFD700';
  ctx.fillRect(GW/2-50,8,16,16);
  ctx.fillStyle='#DAA520';
  ctx.fillRect(GW/2-48,10,12,12);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.font='bold 12px "Courier New"';
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('x '+coinCount,GW/2+10,22);
  
  // Time
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.font='bold 14px "Courier New"';
  ctx.textAlign='right';
  const secs=Math.ceil(timeLeft/60);
  ctx.fillStyle=secs<100?'#fff':'#ff4444';
  ctx.fillText('TIME '+String(Math.max(0,secs)).padStart(3,'0'),GW-8,22);
  
  // Lives
  ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.font='bold 12px "Courier New"';
  ctx.fillText('x'+lives,GW-80,22);
}

function drawMenu(){
  // Background
  const grad=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,GH);
  grad.addColorStop(0,'#5c94fc');
  grad.addColorStop(1,'#00a800');
  ctx.fillStyle=grad;ctx.fillRect(0,0,GW,GH);
  
  // Title
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(GW/2,GH/2-80);
  
  // Shadow
  ctx.fillStyle='#000';
  ctx.font='bold 36px "Courier New"';
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('SUPER MARIO',2,2);
  ctx.fillStyle='#c80000';
  ctx.fillText('SUPER MARIO',0,0);
  
  ctx.font='bold 24px "Courier New"';
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.fillText('BROS.',0,36);
  
  ctx.restore();
  
  // Press Start
  const blink=Math.sin(frameCount*0.1)>0;
  if(blink){
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
    ctx.font='bold 16px "Courier New"';
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO START',GW/2,GH/2+20);
  }
  
  ctx.fillStyle='#aaa';
  ctx.font='12px "Courier New"';
  ctx.fillText('Arrow Keys / WASD to move  |  Space to jump',GW/2,GH/2+50);
}

function drawGameOver(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,GW,GH);
  
  ctx.fillStyle='#ff0000';
  ctx.font='bold 36px "Courier New"';
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('GAME OVER',GW/2,GH/2-20);
  
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.font='bold 16px "Courier New"';
  ctx.fillText('Score: '+score,GW/2,GH/2+20);
  ctx.fillText('Press SPACE to retry',GW/2,GH/2+50);
}

function drawWin(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,GW,GH);
  
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFD700';
  ctx.font='bold 32px "Courier New"';
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('YOU WIN!',GW/2,GH/2-40);
  
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.font='bold 16px "Courier New"';
  ctx.fillText('Score: '+score,GW/2,GH/2+10);
  ctx.fillText('Coins: '+coinCount,GW/2,GH/2+35);
  ctx.fillText('Press SPACE to play again',GW/2,GH/2+65);
}

function render(){
  ctx.save();
  
  // Camera shake
  if(cam.shake>0){
    ctx.translate(Math.random()*cam.shake*2-cam.shake,Math.random()*cam.shake*2-cam.shake);
  }
  
  // Background
  drawBackground();
  
  if(state==='menu'){
    drawMenu();
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }
  
  // Tiles (only visible ones)
  const startTx=Math.max(0,Math.floor(cam.x/T)-1);
  const endTx=Math.min(MW-1,Math.ceil((cam.x+GW)/T)+1);
  for(let ty=0;ty<MH;ty++){
    for(let tx=startTx;tx<=endTx;tx++){
      drawTile(tx,ty);
    }
  }
  
  // Coins
  for(let c of coinList)drawCoin(c);
  
  // Goombas
  for(let g of goombas)drawGoomba(g);
  
  // Player
  drawPlayer();
  
  // Particles
  drawParticles();
  
  // Popups
  drawPopups();
  
  // HUD
  if(state!=='die'&&state!=='win')drawHUD();
  
  // Game over overlay
  if(state==='gameover')drawGameOver();
  
  // Win overlay
  if(state==='win')drawWin();
  
  // Death message
  if(state==='die'){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,GW,GH);
  }
  
  ctx.restore();
}

// ============================================
// MAIN LOOP
// ============================================
function loop(){
  update();
  render();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// ============================================
// INIT
// ============================================
initLevel();
resetPlayer();
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
