<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Super Mario Mini</title>
<style>
    body{margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:#87CEEB;font-family:sans-serif;}
    canvas{display:block;background:#87CEEB;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>

<script>
// ---------- Game Setup ----------
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

function resize(){ canvas.width = window.innerWidth; canvas.height = window.innerHeight; }
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

// ---------- Constants ----------
const GRAVITY = 0.5;
const JUMP_SPEED = -10;
const PLAYER_SPEED = 5;

// ---------- Game State ----------
let keys = {};
let score = 0;
let gameOver = false;

// ---------- Mario ----------
let mario = {
    x: 100, y: 300, w: 30, h: 40,
    vy: 0, onGround: false, speed: PLAYER_SPEED
};

// ---------- Platforms ----------
let platforms = [
    {x:0, y:canvas.height-20, w:canvas.width, h:20}, // ground
    {x:300, y:500, w:200, h:20},
    {x:600, y:400, w:150, h:20},
    {x:800, y:300, w:120, h:20}
];

// ---------- Goomba (enemy) ----------
let goomba = {
    x: 750, y: 330, w: 30, h: 20,
    vx: 2, onGround: false, range: 150   // patrol distance
};

// ---------- Coin ----------
let coin = {
    x: 820, y: 310, w: 16, h: 16,
    collected: false
};

// ---------- Question Block ----------
let block = {
    x: 750, y: 280, w: 20, h: 20,
    hit: false
};

// ---------- Flag ----------
let flag = {
    x: 950, y: 300, w: 20, h: 40,
    collected: false
};

// ---------- Input ----------
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.key] = true);
window.addEventListener('keyup',   e => keys[e.key] = false);

// ---------- Camera ----------
let cameraX = 0;

// ---------- Main Loop ----------
function loop(){ if(gameOver){ drawGameOver(); return; } update(); draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

// ---------- Update ----------
function update(){
    // ----- Mario -----
    mario.onGround = false;
    if(keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a'])  mario.x -= mario.speed;
    if(keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) mario.x += mario.speed;
    if(keys[' '] || keys['w'] || keys['ArrowUp']){
        if(mario.onGround){ mario.vy = JUMP_SPEED; mario.onGround = false; }
    }

    // gravity
    mario.vy += GRAVITY;
    mario.y += mario.vy;

    // platform collision
    mario.onGround = false;
    for(let p of platforms){
        // land on top
        if(mario.x < p.x + p.w &&
           mario.x + mario.w > p.x &&
           mario.y + mario.h <= p.y + p.h &&
           mario.y + mario.h + GRAVITY >= p.y){
            mario.y = p.y - mario.h;
            mario.vy = 0;
            mario.onGround = true;
        }
        // side collision (prevent clipping)
        if(mario.x < p.x + p.w &&
           mario.x + mario.w > p.x &&
           mario.y < p.y + p.h &&
           mario.y + mario.h > p.y){
            if(mario.vx > 0)  mario.x = p.x - mario.w;   // hitting from left
            else if(mario.vx < 0) mario.x = p.x + p.w; // hitting from right
        }
    }

    // keep camera centered roughly on Mario
    if(mario.x < cameraX + 100){
        cameraX = mario.x - 100;
    }else if(mario.x > cameraX + canvas.width - 100){
        cameraX = mario.x - (canvas.width - 100);
    }
    cameraX = Math.max(0, Math.min(cameraX, canvas.width - mario.w));

    // ----- Goomba -----
    goomba.x += goomba.vx;
    // patrol limits
    if(goomba.x + goomba.w > goomba.x + goomba.range) goomba.vx = -2;
    if(goomba.x < goomba.range)                        goomba.vx =  2;

    // ground check for Goomba
    goomba.onGround = false;
    for(let p of platforms){
        if(goomba.x < p.x + p.w &&
           goomba.x + goomba.w > p.x &&
           goomba.y + goomba.h <= p.y + p.h &&
           goomba.y + goomba.h + GRAVITY >= p.y){
            goomba.y = p.y - goomba.h;
            goomba.onGround = true;
        }
    }

    // ----- Collisions -----
    // Enemy touch -> restart
    if(checkAABB(mario, goomba)) resetGame();

    // Coin collection
    if(!coin.collected && checkAABB(mario, coin)){
        coin.collected = true;
        score++;
    }

    // Block hit (spawns a coin)
    if(!block.hit && checkAABB(mario, block)){
        coin.x = block.x + block.w/2 - coin.w/2;
        coin.y = block.y - coin.h - 2;
        block.hit = true;
    }

    // Flag reach
    if(!flag.collected && checkAABB(mario, flag)){
        gameOver = true;
        alert('You win! Score: ' + score);
    }
}

// ---------- Simple AABB ----------
function checkAABB(a,b){
    return a.x < b.x + b.w &&
           a.x + a.w > b.x &&
           a.y < b.y + b.h &&
           a.y + a.h > b.y;
}

// ---------- Reset Game ----------
function resetGame(){
    mario = {x:100, y:300, w:30, h:40, vy:0, onGround:false, speed:PLAYER_SPEED};
    goomba = {x:750, y:330, w:30, h:20, vx:2, onGround:false, range:150};
    coin = {x:820, y:310, w:16, h:16, collected:false};
    block = {x:750, y:280, w:20, h:20, hit:false};
    flag = {x:950, y:300, w:20, h:40, collected:false};
    score = 0;
    gameOver = false;
}

// ---------- Draw ----------
function draw(){
    // sky
    ctx.fillStyle = '#87CEEB';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);

    // platforms
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513';
    for(let p of platforms){
        ctx.fillRect(p.x - cameraX, p.y, p.w, p.h);
    }

    // Goomba
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7B3F00';
    ctx.fillRect(goomba.x - cameraX, goomba.y, goomba.w, goomba.h);

    // Coin
    if(!coin.collected){
        ctx.fillStyle = 'yellow';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(coin.x - cameraX, coin.y, coin.w/2, 0, Math.PI*2);
        ctx.fill();
    }

    // Question block
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0000CD';
    ctx.fillRect(block.x - cameraX, block.y, block.w, block.h);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
    ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('?', block.x + 2 - cameraX, block.y + 12);

    // Flag
    ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
    ctx.fillRect(flag.x - cameraX, flag.y, flag.w, flag.h);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
    ctx.fillRect(flag.x + 2 - cameraX, flag.y + 5, 10, 20); // pole
    ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
    ctx.fillText('Flag', flag.x + flag.w - 12 - cameraX, flag.y + 20);

    // Mario
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FF0000';
    ctx.fillRect(mario.x - cameraX, mario.y, mario.w, mario.h);

    // Score
    ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
    ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
}

// ---------- Game Over Screen ----------
function drawGameOver(){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
    ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2);
    ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Refresh to restart', canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 + 40);
}
</script>
</body>
</html>

question: mario-level-ui
prompt: Recreate a Super Mario Bros. level — make it interactive and fun, feel free to get creative and showcase your skills. Stick to the spirit of nintendo games. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Super Mario Bros.</title>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
body {
background: #000;
display: flex;
justify-content: center;
align-items: center;
height: 100vh;
overflow: hidden;
font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
}
canvas {
border: 2px solid #333;
image-rendering: pixelated;
image-rendering: crisp-edges;
}
#ui {
position: absolute;
top: 10px;
left: 50%;
transform: translateX(-50%);
color: white;
font-size: 14px;
text-align: center;
pointer-events: none;
z-index: 10;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

// Responsive sizing
const GAME_W = 512;
const GAME_H = 480;
canvas.width = GAME_W;
canvas.height = GAME_H;

function resizeCanvas() {
const scale = Math.min(window.innerWidth / GAME_W, window.innerHeight / GAME_H) * 0.95;
canvas.style.width = (GAME_W * scale) + 'px';
canvas.style.height = (GAME_H * scale) + 'px';
}
resizeCanvas();
window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

// Audio context
let audioCtx;
function initAudio() {
if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
}

function playSound(freq, duration, type = 'square', volume = 0.15, slide = 0) {
if (!audioCtx) return;
const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
osc.type = type;
osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
if (slide) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(slide, 20), audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume, audioCtx.currentTime);
gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
osc.connect(gain);
gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
osc.start();
osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
}

function playJump() { playSound(260, 0.15, 'square', 0.1, 600); }
function playCoin() { playSound(988, 0.08, 'square', 0.1); setTimeout(() => playSound(1319, 0.15, 'square', 0.1), 80); }
function playStomp() { playSound(200, 0.1, 'square', 0.12, 80); }
function playBump() { playSound(150, 0.08, 'triangle', 0.1, 80); }
function playBreak() { playSound(100, 0.15, 'sawtooth', 0.1, 40); }
function playPowerup() { [0,100,200,300].forEach((d,i) => setTimeout(() => playSound(400+i*100, 0.1, 'square', 0.08), d)); }
function playDie() { [0,150,300,450].forEach((d,i) => setTimeout(() => playSound(400-i*80, 0.2, 'square', 0.1), d)); }
function playFlagpole() { [0,100,200,300,400,500,600,700].forEach((d,i) => setTimeout(() => playSound(523+i*50, 0.15, 'square', 0.08), d)); }
function playGameOver() { [0,300,600].forEach((d,i) => setTimeout(() => playSound(300-i*60, 0.4, 'triangle', 0.12), d)); }
function play1up() { [0,80,160].forEach((d,i) => setTimeout(() => playSound(600+i*100, 0.1, 'square', 0.08), d)); }

// Input
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
keys[e.code] = true;
if (['Space','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight'].includes(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
initAudio();
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });

// Touch controls
let touchLeft = false, touchRight = false, touchJump = false;
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
e.preventDefault(); initAudio();
for (let t of e.touches) {
const x = t.clientX / window.innerWidth;
const y = t.clientY / window.innerHeight;
if (y > 0.6) { if (x < 0.35) touchLeft = true; else if (x > 0.65) touchRight = true; }
else touchJump = true;
}
}, { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
e.preventDefault();
touchLeft = false; touchRight = false; touchJump = false;
}, { passive: false });

// Constants
const TILE = 32;
const GRAVITY = 0.55;
const FRICTION = 0.85;
const MAX_SPEED = 4.5;
const ACCEL = 0.35;
const JUMP_FORCE = -10.5;
const COYOTE_TIME = 8;
const JUMP_BUFFER = 8;

// Colors
const COLORS = {
sky: '#6b8cff',
ground: '#c84c0c',
groundDark: '#a03000',
brick: '#c84c0c',
brickLine: '#a03000',
question: '#e8a800',
questionDark: '#c08000',
pipe: '#30b020',
pipeDark: '#188010',
pipeLight: '#50d040',
coin: '#ffd000',
marioRed: '#e02020',
marioSkin: '#fca044',
marioBrown: '#a04000',
goomba: '#c07030',
goombaDark: '#804010',
koopaGreen: '#30b020',
koopaShell: '#30b020',
cloud: '#ffffff',
cloudShadow: '#d0d8ff',
hill: '#50a020',
hillDark: '#388018',
bush: '#40c020',
flagPole: '#888888',
castle: '#a0a0a0',
castleDark: '#808080',
};

// Level data
// Legend: 0=empty, 1=ground, 2=brick, 3=question(coin), 4=question(mushroom), 5=pipe_tl, 6=pipe_tr, 7=pipe_bl, 8=pipe_br, 9=used_question, 10=invisible
const LEVEL_WIDTH = 220;
const LEVEL_HEIGHT = 15;

function buildLevel() {
const tiles = [];
for (let y = 0; y < LEVEL_HEIGHT; y++) {
tiles[y] = [];
for (let x = 0; x < LEVEL_WIDTH; x++) {
tiles[y][x] = 0;
}
}

// Ground
for (let x = 0; x < LEVEL_WIDTH; x++) {
// Gaps
if ((x >= 38 && x <= 40) || (x >= 78 && x <= 80) || (x >= 145 && x <= 148)) continue;
tiles[13][x] = 1;
tiles[14][x] = 1;
}

// Question blocks with coins
const questions = [
{ x: 16, y: 9 }, { x: 21, y: 9 }, { x: 22, y: 5 }, { x: 23, y: 9 }, { x: 24, y: 9 },
{ x: 77, y: 9 }, { x: 94, y: 9 }, { x: 106, y: 5 }, { x: 109, y: 5 },
{ x: 112, y: 9 }, { x: 129, y: 9 }, { x: 130, y: 9 },
];
questions.forEach(q => { tiles[q.y][q.x] = 3; });

// Mushroom block
tiles[9][16] = 4;

// Brick blocks
const bricks = [
{ x: 20, y: 9 }, { x: 25, y: 9 },
{ x: 77, y: 5 }, { x: 78, y: 5 }, { x: 79, y: 5 }, { x: 80, y: 5 }, { x: 81, y: 5 }, { x: 82, y: 5 }, { x: 83, y: 5 }, { x: 84, y: 5 },
{ x: 91, y: 9 }, { x: 92, y: 9 }, { x: 93, y: 9 },
{ x: 100, y: 9 }, { x: 101, y: 9 },
{ x: 107, y: 9 }, { x: 108, y: 9 }, { x: 110, y: 9 }, { x: 111, y: 9 },
{ x: 118, y: 9 }, { x: 119, y: 9 }, { x: 120, y: 9 }, { x: 121, y: 9 },
{ x: 128, y: 9 }, { x: 131, y: 9 },
{ x: 168, y: 9 }, { x: 169, y: 9 }, { x: 170, y: 9 },
];
bricks.forEach(b => { tiles[b.y][b.x] = 2; });

// Pipes
const pipes = [
{ x: 28, h: 2 }, { x: 38, h: 3 }, { x: 45, h: 2 }, { x: 55, h: 4 },
{ x: 60, h: 2 }, { x: 86, h: 2 }, { x: 96, h: 3 }, { x: 134, h: 2 },
{ x: 160, h: 2 }, { x: 175, h: 3 },
];
pipes.forEach(p => {
for (let py = 13 - p.h; py < 13; py++) {
if (py === 13 - p.h) {
tiles[py][p.x] = 5;
tiles[py][p.x + 1] = 6;
} else {
tiles[py][p.x] = 7;
tiles[py][p.x + 1] = 8;
}
}
});

// Staircase sections
function addStaircase(startX, height, direction = 1) {
for (let step = 0; step < height; step++) {
for (let h = 0; h <= step; h++) {
const x = startX + step * direction;
tiles[12 - h][x] = 1;
}
}
}
addStaircase(138, 4, 1);
addStaircase(143, 4, -1);
addStaircase(155, 4, 1);
addStaircase(160, 4, -1);

return tiles;
}

// Entities
let mario, enemies, coins, particles, mushrooms, fireballs, camera;
let score, coinCount, lives, gameTime, state, deathTimer, winTimer;
let levelTiles, hitBlocks, blockAnimations;

function initGame() {
levelTiles = buildLevel();
hitBlocks = {};
blockAnimations = {};
coins = [];
particles = [];
mushrooms = [];
fireballs = [];

// Spawn coins in some question blocks area
for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
coins.push({ x: 100 + i * 40, y: 200, collected: false, animY: 0 });
}

resetLevel();
}

function resetLevel() {
mario = {
x: 3 * TILE, y: 11 * TILE, w: 24, h: 30,
vx: 0, vy: 0,
onGround: false, facing: 1,
big: false, dead: false, invincible: 0,
runFrame: 0, frameTimer: 0,
jumpHeld: false, canJump: true,
coyoteTimer: 0, jumpBufferTimer: 0,
ducking: false,
star: false, starTimer: 0,
};
enemies = [];
score = 0;
coinCount = 0;
lives = 3;
gameTime = 400;

// Spawn enemies
const enemyPositions = [
{ x: 18 * TILE, type: 'goomba' },
{ x: 24 * TILE, type: 'goomba' },
{ x: 35 * TILE, type: 'goomba' },
{ x: 42 * TILE, type: 'goomba' },
{ x: 50 * TILE, type: 'goomba' },
{ x: 52 * TILE, type: 'koopa' },
{ x: 65 * TILE, type: 'goomba' },
{ x: 70 * TILE, type: 'goomba' },
{ x: 85 * TILE, type: 'goomba' },
{ x: 90 * TILE, type: 'koopa' },
{ x: 95 * TILE, type: 'goomba' },
{ x: 105 * TILE, type: 'goomba' },
{ x: 115 * TILE, type: 'goomba' },
{ x: 120 * TILE, type: 'goomba' },
{ x: 125 * TILE, type: 'koopa' },
{ x: 135 * TILE, type: 'goomba' },
{ x: 150 * TILE, type: 'goomba' },
{ x: 155 * TILE, type: 'goomba' },
{ x: 165 * TILE, type: 'goomba' },
{ x: 170 * TILE, type: 'goomba' },
{ x: 180 * TILE, type: 'goomba' },
{ x: 185 * TILE, type: 'goomba' },
];

enemyPositions.forEach(e => {
enemies.push({
x: e.x, y: 11 * TILE, w: 28, h: 28,
vx: -0.8, vy: 0,
type: e.type, alive: true, squished: false, squishTimer: 0,
frame: 0, frameTimer: 0, shell: false, shellSpeed: 0,
onGround: false, patrolStart: e.x - 60, patrolEnd: e.x + 60,
});
});

camera = { x: 0 };
state = 'playing';
deathTimer = 0;
winTimer = 0;
}

function getTile(x, y) {
const tx = Math.floor(x / TILE);
const ty = Math.floor(y / TILE);
if (tx < 0 || tx >= LEVEL_WIDTH || ty < 0 || ty >= LEVEL_HEIGHT) return 0;
return levelTiles[ty][tx];
}

function isSolid(tileType) {
return tileType === 1 || tileType === 2 || tileType === 3 || tileType === 4 ||
tileType === 5 || tileType === 6 || tileType === 7 || tileType === 8 ||
tileType === 9;
}

function setTile(x, y, val) {
const tx = Math.floor(x / TILE);
const ty = Math.floor(y / TILE);
if (tx >= 0 && tx < LEVEL_WIDTH && ty >= 0 && ty < LEVEL_HEIGHT) {
levelTiles[ty][tx] = val;
}
}

function hitBlock(tx, ty) {
const key = tx + ',' + ty;
const tile = levelTiles[ty][tx];

if (tile === 3 || tile === 4) {
levelTiles[ty][tx] = 9;
hitBlocks[key] = { y: 0, timer: 0 };

if (tile === 3) {
score += 200;
coinCount++;
playCoin();
spawnCoinParticle(tx * TILE + 8, ty * TILE - 16);
} else if (tile === 4) {
mushrooms.push({
x: tx * TILE, y: (ty - 1) * TILE,
w: 28, h: 28, vx: 2, vy: 0,
emerging: true, emergeY: ty * TILE, active: true,
});
playPowerup();
}
} else if (tile === 2) {
if (mario.big) {
levelTiles[ty][tx] = 0;
playBreak();
score += 50;
for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
particles.push({
x: tx * TILE + (i % 2) * 16, y: ty * TILE + Math.floor(i / 2) * 16,
vx: (i % 2 === 0 ? -2 : 2) + Math.random() * 2, vy: -4 - Math.random() * 3,
life: 40, type: 'brick', color: COLORS.brick, size: 8,
});
}
} else {
playBump();
hitBlocks[key] = { y: -8, timer: 8 };
}
} else {
playBump();
}
}

function spawnCoinParticle(x, y) {
particles.push({
x, y, vx: 0, vy: -6, life: 30, type: 'coin', scored: true
});
}

function updateMario(dt) {
if (mario.dead) return;

const left = keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA'] || touchLeft;
const right = keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD'] || touchRight;
const jump = keys['Space'] || keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW'] || touchJump;
const run = keys['ShiftLeft'] || keys['ShiftRight'];

// Horizontal movement
let accel = run ? ACCEL * 1.5 : ACCEL;
let maxSpd = run ? MAX_SPEED * 1.4 : MAX_SPEED;

if (right) {
mario.vx += accel * mario.facing;
if (mario.facing === -1) mario.vx += accel * 0.5;
mario.facing = 1;
} else if (left) {
mario.vx -= accel * mario.facing;
if (mario.facing === 1) mario.vx -= accel * 0.5;
mario.facing = -1;
} else {
mario.vx *= FRICTION;
if (Math.abs(mario.vx) < 0.1) mario.vx = 0;
}

mario.vx = Math.max(-maxSpd, Math.min(maxSpd, mario.vx));

// Jump buffer
if (jump && !mario.jumpHeld) {
mario.jumpBufferTimer = JUMP_BUFFER;
}
mario.jumpHeld = jump;
if (mario.jumpBufferTimer > 0) mario.jumpBufferTimer--;

// Coyote time
if (mario.onGround) {
mario.coyoteTimer = COYOTE_TIME;
mario.canJump = true;
} else {
if (mario.coyoteTimer > 0) mario.coyoteTimer--;
}

// Jump
if (mario.jumpBufferTimer > 0 && mario.coyoteTimer > 0) {
mario.vy = JUMP_FORCE;
mario.onGround = false;
mario.coyoteTimer = 0;
mario.jumpBufferTimer = 0;
mario.canJump = false;
playJump();
}

// Variable jump height
if (!jump && mario.vy < -3) {
mario.vy *= 0.85;
}

// Gravity
mario.vy += GRAVITY;
if (mario.vy > 12) mario.vy = 12;

// Invincibility timer
if (mario.invincible > 0) mario.invincible--;
if (mario.star) {
mario.starTimer--;
if (mario.starTimer <= 0) mario.star = false;
}

// Move X
mario.x += mario.vx;
resolveCollisionX(mario);

// Move Y
mario.y += mario.vy;
mario.onGround = false;
resolveCollisionY(mario);

// Animation
if (Math.abs(mario.vx) > 0.5 && mario.onGround) {
mario.frameTimer++;
if (mario.frameTimer > (Math.abs(mario.vx) > 3 ? 3 : 5)) {
mario.frameTimer = 0;
mario.runFrame = (mario.runFrame + 1) % 3;
}
} else if (!mario.onGround) {
mario.runFrame = 1;
} else {
mario.runFrame = 0;
mario.frameTimer = 0;
}

// Fall death
if (mario.y > LEVEL_HEIGHT * TILE + 64) {
killMario();
}

// Left boundary
if (mario.x < camera.x) {
mario.x = camera.x;
mario.vx = 0;
}

// Right boundary
if (mario.x > (LEVEL_WIDTH - 2) * TILE) {
mario.x = (LEVEL_WIDTH - 2) * TILE;
}

// Flag pole check
const flagX = 195 * TILE;
if (mario.x + mario.w > flagX && mario.x < flagX + 32 && !mario.dead) {
if (state === 'playing') {
state = 'win';
winTimer = 180;
playFlagpole();
score += Math.max(0, Math.floor((13 * TILE - mario.y) / TILE) * 100);
}
}

// Timer
if (state === 'playing') {
gameTime -= 1/60;
if (gameTime <= 0) killMario();
}
}

function resolveCollisionX(entity) {
const left = entity.x;
const right = entity.x + entity.w;
const top = entity.y + 2;
const bottom = entity.y + entity.h - 2;

const leftTile = Math.floor(left / TILE);
const rightTile = Math.floor(right / TILE);
const topTile = Math.floor(top / TILE);
const bottomTile = Math.floor(bottom / TILE);

for (let ty = topTile; ty <= bottomTile; ty++) {
for (let tx = leftTile; tx <= rightTile; tx++) {
if (isSolid(getTile(tx * TILE, ty * TILE))) {
if (entity.vx > 0) {
entity.x = tx * TILE - entity.w;
entity.vx = 0;
} else if (entity.vx < 0) {
entity.x = (tx + 1) * TILE;
entity.vx = 0;
}
return;
}
}
}
}

function resolveCollisionY(entity) {
const left = entity.x + 2;
const right = entity.x + entity.w - 2;
const top = entity.y;
const bottom = entity.y + entity.h;

const leftTile = Math.floor(left / TILE);
const rightTile = Math.floor(right / TILE);
const topTile = Math.floor(top / TILE);
const bottomTile = Math.floor((bottom - 1) / TILE);

for (let ty = topTile; ty <= bottomTile; ty++) {
for (let tx = leftTile; tx <= rightTile; tx++) {
if (isSolid(getTile(tx * TILE, ty * TILE))) {
if (entity.vy > 0) {
entity.y = ty * TILE - entity.h;
entity.vy = 0;
entity.onGround = true;
} else if (entity.vy < 0) {
entity.y = (ty + 1) * TILE;
entity.vy = 0;
hitBlock(tx, ty);
}
return;
}
}
}
}

function killMario() {
if (mario.dead) return;
mario.dead = true;
mario.vy = -10;
playDie();
lives--;
deathTimer = 90;
}

function updateEnemies() {
enemies.forEach(e => {
if (!e.alive) return;

if (e.squished) {
e.squishTimer--;
if (e.squishTimer <= 0) e.alive = false;
return;
}

// Only update if near camera
if (Math.abs(e.x - camera.x) > GAME_W + 100) return;

e.vy += GRAVITY;
if (e.vy > 10) e.vy = 10;

// Shell movement
if (e.shell && e.shellSpeed !== 0) {
e.vx = e.shellSpeed;
}

e.x += e.vx;
e.y += e.vy;
e.onGround = false;

// Tile collision
const left = e.x;
const right = e.x + e.w;
const top = e.y;
const bottom = e.y + e.h;

// Check ground
const bottomTile = Math.floor((bottom - 1) / TILE);
const leftTile = Math.floor(left / TILE);
const rightTile = Math.floor(right / TILE);

for (let tx = leftTile; tx <= rightTile; tx++) {
if (isSolid(getTile(tx * TILE, bottomTile * TILE))) {
e.y = bottomTile * TILE - e.h;
e.vy = 0;
e.onGround = true;
}
}

// Wall collision
const topT = Math.floor(top / TILE);
const botT = Math.floor(bottom / TILE);
for (let ty = topT; ty <= botT; ty++) {
if (e.vx > 0 && isSolid(getTile(rightTile * TILE, ty * TILE))) {
e.x = (ty + 1) * TILE - e.w;
e.vx = -Math.abs(e.vx);
}
if (e.vx < 0 && isSolid(getTile(leftTile * TILE, ty * TILE))) {
e.x = (ty + 1) * TILE;
e.vx = Math.abs(e.vx);
}
}

// Edge detection - turn around at edges
if (e.onGround) {
const aheadX = e.vx > 0 ? rightTile + 1 : leftTile - 1;
if (!isSolid(getTile(aheadX * TILE, (bottomTile + 1) * TILE))) {
e.vx = -e.vx;
}
}

// Animation
e.frameTimer++;
if (e.frameTimer > 10) {
e.frameTimer = 0;
e.frame = (e.frame + 1) % 2;
}

// Mario collision
if (!mario.dead && mario.invincible <= 0 && !mario.star) {
if (rectsOverlap(mario, e)) {
if (mario.vy > 0 && mario.y + mario.h - e.y < 16) {
// Stomp!
if (e.type === 'koopa' && !e.shell) {
e.shell = true;
e.h = 20;
e.vx = 0;
e.shellSpeed = 0;
score += 100;
playStomp();
} else if (e.shell && e.shellSpeed === 0) {
e.shellSpeed = mario.x + mario.w / 2 < e.x + e.w / 2 ? 6 : -6;
score += 100;
playStomp();
} else {
e.squished = true;
e.squishTimer = 20;
e.h = 10;
score += 100;
playStomp();
}
mario.vy = -7;
} else if (e.shell && e.shellSpeed !== 0) {
// Hit shell
e.shellSpeed = 0;
playStomp();
} else if (e.shell && e.shellSpeed === 0) {
// Pick up shell? For now just hurt
hurtMario();
} else {
hurtMario();
}
}
}

// Kill enemies off screen
if (e.y > LEVEL_HEIGHT * TILE + 64) e.alive = false;
});
}

function hurtMario() {
if (mario.dead || mario.invincible > 0) return;
if (mario.star) {
// Star power kills enemies
const nearby = enemies.find(e => e.alive && !e.squished && rectsOverlap(mario, e));
if (nearby) {
nearby.alive = false;
score += 200;
playStomp();
}
return;
}
if (mario.big) {
mario.big = false;
mario.h = 30;
mario.invincible = 90;
playBump();
} else {
killMario();
}
}

function rectsOverlap(a, b) {
return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
}

function updateMushrooms() {
mushrooms.forEach(m => {
if (!m.active) return;
if (m.emerging) {
m.y -= 1;
if (m.y <= m.emergeY - TILE) {
m.emerging = false;
}
return;
}

m.vy += GRAVITY;
m.x += m.vx;
m.y += m.vy;

// Tile collision
const left = m.x;
const right = m.x + m.w;
const top = m.y;
const bottom = m.y + m.h;

const bottomTile = Math.floor((bottom - 1) / TILE);
const leftTile = Math.floor(left / TILE);
const rightTile = Math.floor(right / TILE);

for (let tx = leftTile; tx <= rightTile; tx++) {
if (isSolid(getTile(tx * TILE, bottomTile * TILE))) {
m.y = bottomTile * TILE - m.h;
m.vy = 0;
}
}

// Walls
for (let ty = Math.floor(top / TILE); ty <= Math.floor(bottom / TILE); ty++) {
if (m.vx > 0 && isSolid(getTile(rightTile * TILE, ty * TILE))) {
m.vx = -m.vx;
}
if (m.vx < 0 && isSolid(getTile(leftTile * TILE, ty * TILE))) {
m.vx = -m.vx;
}
}

// Mario pickup
if (!mario.dead && rectsOverlap(mario, m)) {
m.active = false;
if (!mario.big) {
mario.big = true;
mario.h = 48;
mario.y -= 18;
}
score += 1000;
playPowerup();
}

if (m.y > LEVEL_HEIGHT * TILE + 64) m.active = false;
});
}

function updateParticles() {
particles.forEach(p => {
p.x += p.vx;
p.y += p.vy;
if (p.type === 'brick') {
p.vy += 0.4;
p.life--;
} else if (p.scored) {
p.vy += 0.3;
p.life--;
if (p.life > 20) {
p.y += p.vy;
} else {
p.y -= 2;
p.vx = 0;
}
}
});
particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);
}

function updateCamera() {
const targetX = mario.x - GAME_W / 3;
camera.x = Math.max(camera.x, targetX);
camera.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(camera.x, LEVEL_WIDTH * TILE - GAME_W));
}

function update() {
if (state === 'dead') {
deathTimer--;
mario.vy += GRAVITY;
mario.y += mario.vy;
if (deathTimer <= 0) {
if (lives <= 0) {
state = 'gameover';
playGameOver();
setTimeout(() => { state = 'title'; }, 2000);
} else {
resetLevel();
}
}
return;
}

if (state === 'gameover' || state === 'title') return;

updateMario();
updateEnemies();
updateMushrooms();
updateParticles();
updateCamera();

// Block animations
Object.keys(hitBlocks).forEach(key => {
const b = hitBlocks[key];
b.timer--;
if (b.y < 0) b.y++;
if (b.timer <= 0) delete hitBlocks[key];
});
}

const dy = Math.floor(mario.y);

drawMarioSprite(0, 0, mario.facing, mario.runFrame, false, mario.big, mario.ducking);

}

function drawMarioSprite(x, y, dir, frame, dead, big, ducking) {

const py = big ? 24 : 15;

if (dead) {

ctx.fillRect(2*s, 0, 8*s, 4*s); // hat

ctx.fillRect(2*s, 4*s, 8*s, 4*s); // face
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioRed;
ctx.fillRect(2*s, 8*s, 8*s, 8*s); // body
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioBrown;
ctx.fillRect(2*s, 16*s, 4*s, 4*s); // left leg
ctx.fillRect(6*s, 16*s, 4*s, 4*s); // right leg
} else {
const bh = big ? 24 : 15;
const by = big ? 0 : 0;

// Hat
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioRed;
ctx.fillRect(2*s, by, 6*s, 3*s);
ctx.fillRect(1*s, by + 1*s, 8*s, 2*s);

// Face
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioSkin;
ctx.fillRect(1*s, by + 3*s, 7*s, 3*s);

// Eyes
ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
ctx.fillRect(5*s, by + 3*s, 1*s, 1*s);

// Mustache
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioBrown;
ctx.fillRect(3*s, by + 5*s, 4*s, 1*s);

// Body
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioRed;
if (big) {
ctx.fillRect(1*s, by + 6*s, 8*s, 8*s);
// Belt

ctx.fillRect(1*s, by + 12*s, 8*s, 2*s);
} else {

// Overalls

// Legs

function drawTile(type, tx, ty) {
const dx = Math.floor(tx * TILE - camera.x);
const dy = Math.floor(ty * TILE);

if (dx > GAME_W + TILE || dx < -TILE * 2) return;

const bounce = hitBlocks[tx + ',' + ty];
const offsetY = bounce ? bounce.y : 0;

switch (type) {
case 1: // Ground
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.ground;
ctx.fillRect(dx, dy + offsetY, TILE, TILE);
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.groundDark;
ctx.fillRect(dx, dy + offsetY, TILE, 2);
// Pattern
ctx.fillStyle = '#e09060';
ctx.fillRect(dx + 4, dy + offsetY + 8, 12, 2);
ctx.fillRect(dx + 20, dy + offsetY + 20, 12, 2);
break;

case 2: // Brick
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.brick;
ctx.fillRect(dx, dy + offsetY, TILE, TILE);
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.brickLine;
ctx.fillRect(dx, dy + offsetY, TILE, 2);
ctx.fillRect(dx, dy + offsetY + 14, TILE, 2);
ctx.fillRect(dx, dy + offsetY + 30, TILE, 2);
ctx.fillRect(dx + 15, dy + offsetY, 2, 14);
ctx.fillRect(dx + 7, dy + offsetY + 16, 2, 14);
ctx.fillRect(dx + 23, dy + offsetY + 16, 2, 14);
ctx.fillRect(dx + 15, dy + offsetY + 32, 2, 0);
ctx.strokeStyle = '#000';
ctx.lineWidth = 1;
ctx.strokeRect(dx + 0.5, dy + offsetY + 0.5, TILE - 1, TILE - 1);
break;

case 3: // Question block
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.question;
ctx.fillRect(dx, dy + offsetY, TILE, TILE);
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.questionDark;
ctx.fillRect(dx + 2, dy + offsetY + 2, TILE - 4, TILE - 4);
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.question;
ctx.fillRect(dx + 4, dy + offsetY + 4, TILE - 8, TILE - 8);
// Question mark
ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
ctx.font = 'bold 18px Courier New';
ctx.textAlign = 'center';
ctx.fillText('?', dx + TILE/2, dy + offsetY + TILE/2 + 6);
break;

case 4: // Question block (mushroom)
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.question;
ctx.fillRect(dx, dy + offsetY, TILE, TILE);
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.questionDark;
ctx.fillRect(dx + 2, dy + offsetY + 2, TILE - 4, TILE - 4);
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.question;
ctx.fillRect(dx + 4, dy + offsetY + 4, TILE - 8, TILE - 8);
ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
ctx.font = 'bold 18px Courier New';
ctx.textAlign = 'center';
ctx.fillText('?', dx + TILE/2, dy + offsetY + TILE/2 + 6);
break;

case 9: // Used question
ctx.fillStyle = '#886644';
ctx.fillRect(dx, dy + offsetY, TILE, TILE);
ctx.fillStyle = '#664422';
ctx.fillRect(dx + 2, dy + offsetY + 2, TILE - 4, TILE - 4);
ctx.fillStyle = '#886644';
ctx.fillRect(dx + 4, dy + offsetY + 4, TILE - 8, TILE - 8);
break;

case 5: // Pipe top-left
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipe;
ctx.fillRect(dx - 4, dy + offsetY, TILE + 4, TILE);
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipeLight;
ctx.fillRect(dx - 2, dy + offsetY, 8, TILE);
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipeDark;
ctx.fillRect(dx - 4, dy + offsetY, TILE + 4, 4);
ctx.fillRect(dx - 4, dy + offsetY, 2, TILE);
break;

case 6: // Pipe top-right
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipe;
ctx.fillRect(dx, dy + offsetY, TILE + 4, TILE);
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipeLight;
ctx.fillRect(dx + 2, dy + offsetY, 8, TILE);
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipeDark;
ctx.fillRect(dx, dy + offsetY, TILE + 4, 4);
ctx.fillRect(dx + TILE + 2, dy + offsetY, 2, TILE);
break;

case 7: // Pipe body-left
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipe;
ctx.fillRect(dx, dy + offsetY, TILE, TILE);

ctx.fillRect(dx + 2, dy + offsetY, 6, TILE);
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipeDark;
ctx.fillRect(dx, dy + offsetY, 2, TILE);

case 8: // Pipe body-right
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipe;
ctx.fillRect(dx, dy + offsetY, TILE, TILE);
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipeLight;
ctx.fillRect(dx + 2, dy + offsetY, 6, TILE);
ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipeDark;
ctx.fillRect(dx + TILE - 2, dy + offsetY, 2, TILE);
break;
}
}

// Coins
coins.forEach(c => {

});

// Enemies
enemies.forEach(e => {
if (!e.alive) return;

if (dx < -TILE * 2 || dx > GAME_W + TILE * 2) return;
if (e.type === 'goomba') drawGoomba(e);

// Particles
particles.forEach(p => {

if (p.type === 'brick') {
ctx.fillStyle = p.color;

ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.coin;

ctx.fill();
}
});

// Mario
drawMario();

// HUD

// State screens

drawTitleScreen();

drawGameOverScreen();
} else if (state === 'win') {
drawWinScreen();
}
}

function drawTitleScreen() {
ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';

ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
ctx.fillText('Press ENTER or SPACE to Start', GAME_W / 2, 300);

ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
ctx.font = '12px Courier New';
ctx.fillText('← → or A/D to Move', GAME_W / 2, 360);
ctx.fillText('SPACE or ↑ to Jump', GAME_W / 2, 380);
ctx.fillText('SHIFT to Run', GAME_W / 2, 400);
}

function drawGameOverScreen() {
ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)';
ctx.fillRect(0, 0, GAME_W, GAME_H);
ctx.fillStyle = '#e02020';
ctx.font = 'bold 32px Courier New';
ctx.textAlign = 'center';
ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', GAME_W / 2, GAME_H / 2);
}

function drawWinScreen() {
ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
ctx.fillRect(0, 0, GAME_W, GAME_H);
ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd000';
ctx.font = 'bold 32px Courier New';
ctx.textAlign = 'center';
ctx.fillText('COURSE CLEAR!', GAME_W / 2, GAME_H / 2 - 20);
ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, GAME_W / 2, GAME_H / 2 + 20);
}

// Game loop
let lastTime = 0;
let accumulator = 0;
const TICK = 1000 / 60;

function gameLoop(timestamp) {
if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
const delta = timestamp - lastTime;
lastTime = timestamp;
accumulator += delta;

while (accumulator >= TICK) {
// Title screen input
if (state === 'title') {
if (keys['Enter'] || keys['Space']) {
initAudio();
state = 'playing';
resetLevel();
keys['Enter'] = false;
keys['Space'] = false;
}
}

if (state === 'playing' || state === 'dead' || state === 'win') {
update();
}
accumulator -= TICK;
}

draw();
requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// Initialize
state = 'title';
initGame();
requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);

</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>

<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');

let scale = 1;
function resize() {
  const s = Math.min(window.innerWidth / VIEW_W, window.innerHeight / VIEW_H);
  scale = Math.floor(s * 4) / 4;
  if (scale < 1) scale = s;
  canvas.width = VIEW_W;
  canvas.height = VIEW_H;
  canvas.style.width = (VIEW_W * scale) + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = (VIEW_H * scale) + 'px';
}
resize();
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

// --- AUDIO ---
const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
function playTone(freq, dur, type = 'square', vol = 0.08, slide = 0) {
  const o = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  const g = audioCtx.createGain();
  o.type = type;
  o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
  if (slide) o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(freq + slide, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, audioCtx.currentTime);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
  o.connect(g);
  g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
  o.start();
  o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
}
function playNoise(dur, vol = 0.06) {
  const buf = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, audioCtx.sampleRate * dur, audioCtx.sampleRate);
  const data = buf.getChannelData(0);
  for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
  const src = audioCtx.createBufferSource();

  g.connect(audioCtx.destination);

}
const SFX = {
  jump() { playTone(350, 0.15, 'square', 0.07, 300); },

  powerup() { [523,659,784,1047].forEach((f,i) => setTimeout(() => playTone(f, 0.12, 'square', 0.06), i*70)); },

};

// --- INPUT ---
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  keys[e.code] = true;
  if (['Space','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight'].includes(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
  if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.code] = false);

// Touch controls
let touchLeft = false, touchRight = false, touchJump = false, touchRun = false;
function addTouchControls() {
  const isMobile = 'ontouchstart' in window;
  if (!isMobile) return;
  const style = document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent = `
    .tbtn { position:fixed; width:60px; height:60px; border-radius:50%; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;

      touch-action:none; }

  `;
  document.head.appendChild(style);
  const btns = [
    { id:'tl', x:20, y:'bottom:20px', label:'◀', set:v=>touchLeft=v },

}

function inputLeft() { return keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA'] || touchLeft; }
function inputRight() { return keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD'] || touchRight; }
function inputJump() { return keys['Space'] || keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW'] || touchJump; }
function inputRun() { return keys['ShiftLeft'] || keys['ShiftRight'] || keys['KeyX'] || touchRun; }

// --- LEVEL DATA ---
// Tile types: 0=air, 1=ground, 2=brick, 3=qblock(coin), 4=qblock(mushroom), 5=used_block,
// 6=pipe_tl, 7=pipe_tr, 8=pipe_bl, 9=pipe_br, 10=flag_pole, 11=flag_ball, 12=castle, 13=hard_block
const level = [];
for (let y = 0; y < LEVEL_H; y++) {

}

function setTile(x, y, v) { if (x >= 0 && x < LEVEL_W && y >= 0 && y < LEVEL_H) level[y][x] = v; }
function fillGround(x1, x2) { for (let x = x1; x <= x2; x++) { setTile(x, 13, 1); setTile(x, 14, 1); } }
function placePipe(x, h) {
  for (let i = 0; i < h; i++) {
    const y = 12 - i;
    if (i === h - 1) { setTile(x, y, 6); setTile(x+1, y, 7); }
    else { setTile(x, y, 8); setTile(x+1, y, 9); }

}
function placeStairs(x, h, dir) {
  for (let i = 0; i < h; i++) {
    const sx = dir === 1 ? x + i : x + h - 1 - i;
    for (let j = 0; j <= i; j++) setTile(sx, 12 - j, 13);
  }
}

// Build level
fillGround(0, 68);
fillGround(71, 85);
fillGround(88, 152);
fillGround(155, 223);

// Question blocks and bricks - section 1
setTile(16, 9, 3);

// Pipes

placePipe(38, 3);

// Section 2 - bricks and blocks
setTile(77, 9, 2);

// Section 3

// Section 4 - more bricks

// Mushroom block
setTile(12, 9, 4);

// Staircases
placeStairs(134, 4, 1);
placeStairs(140, 4, -1);
placeStairs(148, 4, 1);
placeStairs(152, 4, -1);

// Final staircase
placeStairs(181, 8, 1);

// Flag pole
setTile(198, 4, 11);
for (let y = 5; y <= 12; y++) setTile(198, y, 10);

// Castle
for (let cy = 8; cy <= 12; cy++)
  for (let cx = 202; cx <= 209; cx++)
    setTile(cx, cy, 12);
for (let cx = 204; cx <= 207; cx++) setTile(cx, 7, 12);
for (let cx = 205; cx <= 206; cx++) setTile(cx, 6, 12);
setTile(205, 12, 0); setTile(206, 12, 0);
setTile(205, 11, 0); setTile(206, 11, 0);

// --- ENTITIES ---
let player, goombas, coins, mushrooms, particles, floatingTexts, coinAnims;
let camera = { x: 0 };
let score = 0, coinCount = 0, lives = 3, time = 400, world = '1-1';
let gameState = 'title'; // title, playing, dying, gameover, win, flagSlide
let stateTimer = 0;
let flagSlideY = 0;

function resetLevel() {
  player = {
    x: 3 * TILE, y: 11 * TILE, vx: 0, vy: 0,
    w: 12, h: 14, big: false,
    onGround: false, facing: 1,
    jumpHeld: false, jumpTimer: 0, coyoteTimer: 0,
    animFrame: 0, animTimer: 0,

    star: false
  };
  goombas = [];
  coins = [];
  mushrooms = [];
  particles = [];
  floatingTexts = [];
  coinAnims = [];

  // Place goombas
  const goombaPositions = [22, 40, 51, 52, 80, 82, 97, 98, 107, 108, 114, 115, 124, 125, 128, 129, 174, 175];
  goombaPositions.forEach(x => {
    goombas.push({ x: x * TILE, y: 11 * TILE + 2, vx: -0.5, w: 14, h: 14, alive: true, squishTimer: 0, animTimer: 0, active: false });
  });

  // Place coins in the air
  const coinPositions = [[35,8],[36,8],[37,8],[63,8],[64,8],[65,8],[105,7],[106,7],[107,7],[143,8],[144,8],[145,8],[146,8]];
  coinPositions.forEach(([x,y]) => {
    coins.push({ x: x * TILE + 4, y: y * TILE + 2, w: 8, h: 12, collected: false, animTimer: Math.random() * 100 });
  });
}

function resetGame() {
  score = 0; coinCount = 0; lives = 3;
  resetLevel();
  gameState = 'playing';
}

// --- COLLISION ---
function getTile(px, py) {
  const tx = Math.floor(px / TILE);
  const ty = Math.floor(py / TILE);
  if (tx < 0 || tx >= LEVEL_W || ty < 0 || ty >= LEVEL_H) return 0;
  return level[ty][tx];
}

function isSolid(t) {
  return t === 1 || t === 2 || t === 3 || t === 4 || t === 5 || t === 6 || t === 7 || t === 8 || t === 9 || t === 12 || t === 13;
}

function rectOverlap(a, b) {
  return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
}

// --- BLOCK HIT ---
function hitBlock(tx, ty) {
  const t = level[ty][tx];
  if (t === 3 || t === 4) {
    // Question block
    if (t === 3) {
      SFX.coin();
      coinCount++;
      score += 200;
      coinAnims.push({ x: tx * TILE + 4, y: ty * TILE - 8, vy: -5, timer: 30 });
      addFloatingText(tx * TILE, ty * TILE - 16, '200');
    } else {
      SFX.mushroom();
      mushrooms.push({ x: tx * TILE + 1, y: ty * TILE - TILE, vx: 1.2, vy: 0, w: 14, h: 14, active: true });
    }
    level[ty][tx] = 5;
    // Bounce animation
    particles.push({ type: 'blockBounce', x: tx * TILE, y: ty * TILE, timer: 8, origY: ty * TILE });
  } else if (t === 2) {
    if (player.big) {
      SFX.brick();
      level[ty][tx] = 0;
      score += 50;
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        particles.push({
          type: 'brick', x: tx * TILE + (i % 2) * 8, y: ty * TILE + Math.floor(i / 2) * 8,
          vx: (i % 2 === 0 ? -1.5 : 1.5) + Math.random(), vy: -4 - Math.random() * 3,
          timer: 60
        });
      }
    } else {
      SFX.bump();
      particles.push({ type: 'blockBounce', x: tx * TILE, y: ty * TILE, timer: 8, origY: ty * TILE });
    }
  } else if (t === 5 || t === 12 || t === 13) {
    SFX.bump();
  }
}

function addFloatingText(x, y, text) {
  floatingTexts.push({ x, y, text, timer: 40 });
}

// --- UPDATE ---
let frameCount = 0;
let timeTimer = 0;

function update() {
  frameCount++;

  if (gameState === 'title') {
    if (inputJump() || inputRun()) {
      resetGame();
    }
    return;
  }

  if (gameState === 'gameover') {
    stateTimer++;
    if (stateTimer > 180 && (inputJump() || inputRun())) {
      gameState = 'title';
    }
    return;
  }

  if (gameState === 'win') {
    stateTimer++;
    if (stateTimer > 300 && (inputJump() || inputRun())) {
      gameState = 'title';
    }
    return;
  }

  if (gameState === 'dying') {
    player.deathTimer++;
    if (player.deathTimer > 20) {
      player.vy += GRAVITY;
      player.y += player.vy;
    }
    if (player.deathTimer > 150) {
      lives--;
      if (lives <= 0) {
        gameState = 'gameover';
        stateTimer = 0;
      } else {
        resetLevel();
        gameState = 'playing';
      }
    }
    return;
  }

  if (gameState === 'flagSlide') {
    flagSlideY += 2;
    player.y = Math.min(player.y + 2, 12 * TILE - player.h);
    if (player.y >= 12 * TILE - player.h) {
      gameState = 'win';
      stateTimer = 0;
      SFX.flag();
      score += Math.max(0, time) * 10;
    }
    return;
  }

  // Timer
  timeTimer++;
  if (timeTimer >= 24) {
    timeTimer = 0;
    time--;
    if (time <= 0) killPlayer();
  }

  const p = player;

  // Horizontal movement
  const maxSpeed = inputRun() ? RUN_SPEED : WALK_SPEED;
  if (inputLeft()) {
    p.vx -= ACCEL;
    p.facing = -1;
  } else if (inputRight()) {
    p.vx += ACCEL;
    p.facing = 1;
  } else {
    if (p.vx > 0) p.vx = Math.max(0, p.vx - DECEL);
    if (p.vx < 0) p.vx = Math.min(0, p.vx + DECEL);
  }
  p.vx = Math.max(-maxSpeed, Math.min(maxSpeed, p.vx));

  // Jumping
  if (p.onGround) p.coyoteTimer = COYOTE;
  else if (p.coyoteTimer > 0) p.coyoteTimer--;

  if (inputJump() && !p.jumpHeld && p.coyoteTimer > 0) {
    p.vy = JUMP_FORCE;
    p.onGround = false;
    p.coyoteTimer = 0;
    p.jumpHeld = true;
    p.jumpTimer = 0;
    SFX.jump();
  }

  if (inputJump() && p.jumpHeld && p.vy < 0 && p.jumpTimer < 12) {
    p.vy += JUMP_HOLD;
    p.jumpTimer++;
  }

  if (!inputJump()) {
    p.jumpHeld = false;
    if (p.vy < -2) p.vy = -2;
  }

  // Gravity
  p.vy += GRAVITY;
  if (p.vy > MAX_FALL) p.vy = MAX_FALL;

  // Horizontal collision
  p.x += p.vx;
  if (p.x < camera.x) { p.x = camera.x; p.vx = 0; }

  const ph = p.big ? 28 : 14;
  p.h = ph;

  // Check horizontal collisions
  if (p.vx > 0) {
    const rx = p.x + p.w;
    for (let cy = Math.floor(p.y / TILE); cy <= Math.floor((p.y + p.h - 1) / TILE); cy++) {
      if (isSolid(getTile(rx, cy * TILE + 1))) {
        p.x = Math.floor(rx / TILE) * TILE - p.w;
        p.vx = 0;
        break;
      }
    }
  } else if (p.vx < 0) {
    const lx = p.x;
    for (let cy = Math.floor(p.y / TILE); cy <= Math.floor((p.y + p.h - 1) / TILE); cy++) {
      if (isSolid(getTile(lx, cy * TILE + 1))) {
        p.x = (Math.floor(lx / TILE) + 1) * TILE;
        p.vx = 0;
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // Vertical collision
  p.y += p.vy;
  p.onGround = false;

  if (p.vy > 0) {
    const by = p.y + p.h;
    for (let cx = Math.floor((p.x + 2) / TILE); cx <= Math.floor((p.x + p.w - 3) / TILE); cx++) {
      if (isSolid(getTile(cx * TILE + 1, by))) {
        p.y = Math.floor(by / TILE) * TILE - p.h;
        p.vy = 0;
        p.onGround = true;
        break;
      }
    }
  } else if (p.vy < 0) {
    const ty = p.y;
    let hitSomething = false;
    for (let cx = Math.floor((p.x + 2) / TILE); cx <= Math.floor((p.x + p.w - 3) / TILE); cx++) {
      const tile = getTile(cx * TILE + 1, ty);
      if (isSolid(tile)) {
        p.y = (Math.floor(ty / TILE) + 1) * TILE;
        p.vy = 0;
        hitSomething = true;
        hitBlock(cx, Math.floor(ty / TILE));
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // Fall into pit
  if (p.y > LEVEL_H * TILE) {
    killPlayer();
    return;
  }

  // Animation
  if (!p.onGround) {
    p.animFrame = 5; // jump frame
  } else if (Math.abs(p.vx) > 0.3) {
    p.animTimer++;
    const speed = Math.abs(p.vx) > 2 ? 4 : 7;
    if (p.animTimer >= speed) {
      p.animTimer = 0;
      p.animFrame = (p.animFrame + 1) % 3;
    }
  } else {
    p.animFrame = 0;
    p.animTimer = 0;
  }

  if (p.invincible > 0) p.invincible--;

  // Flag pole check
  const flagTx = 198;
  if (Math.floor((p.x + p.w / 2) / TILE) >= flagTx && gameState === 'playing') {
    gameState = 'flagSlide';
    flagSlideY = 0;
    p.x = flagTx * TILE - 2;
    p.vx = 0;
    p.vy = 0;
    const heightBonus = Math.max(0, (12 - Math.floor(p.y / TILE)) * 100);
    score += heightBonus;
    addFloatingText(p.x, p.y - 20, heightBonus.toString());
    return;
  }

  // Update goombas
  goombas.forEach(g => {
    if (!g.alive) {
      if (g.squishTimer > 0) g.squishTimer--;
      return;
    }
    // Activate when near camera
    if (!g.active) {
      if (g.x < camera.x + VIEW_W + 32) g.active = true;
      else return;
    }

    g.x += g.vx;
    g.animTimer++;

    // Gravity for goombas
    g.vy = (g.vy || 0) + GRAVITY;
    if (g.vy > MAX_FALL) g.vy = MAX_FALL;
    g.y += g.vy;

    // Ground collision
    const gby = g.y + g.h;
    for (let cx = Math.floor((g.x + 2) / TILE); cx <= Math.floor((g.x + g.w - 3) / TILE); cx++) {
      if (isSolid(getTile(cx * TILE + 1, gby))) {
        g.y = Math.floor(gby / TILE) * TILE - g.h;
        g.vy = 0;
        break;
      }
    }

    // Wall collision
    if (g.vx < 0) {
      if (isSolid(getTile(g.x, g.y + g.h / 2))) { g.vx = 0.5; }
    } else {
      if (isSolid(getTile(g.x + g.w, g.y + g.h / 2))) { g.vx = -0.5; }
    }

    // Fall into pit
    if (g.y > LEVEL_H * TILE) g.alive = false;

    // Player collision
    if (p.invincible <= 0 && rectOverlap(p, g)) {
      if (p.vy > 0 && p.y + p.h - g.y < 12) {
        // Stomp!
        g.alive = false;
        g.squishTimer = 30;
        p.vy = -5;
        score += 100;
        SFX.stomp();
        addFloatingText(g.x, g.y - 10, '100');
      } else {
        if (p.big) {
          p.big = false;
          p.h = 14;
          p.invincible = 90;
          SFX.bump();
        } else {
          killPlayer();
        }
      }
    }
  });

  // Update coins
  coins.forEach(c => {
    if (c.collected) return;
    c.animTimer++;
    if (rectOverlap(p, c)) {
      c.collected = true;
      coinCount++;
      score += 200;
      SFX.coin();
      addFloatingText(c.x, c.y - 10, '200');
    }
  });

  // Update mushrooms
  mushrooms.forEach(m => {
    if (!m.active) return;
    m.x += m.vx;
    m.vy = (m.vy || 0) + GRAVITY;
    if (m.vy > MAX_FALL) m.vy = MAX_FALL;
    m.y += m.vy;

    // Ground
    const mby = m.y + m.h;
    for (let cx = Math.floor((m.x + 2) / TILE); cx <= Math.floor((m.x + m.w - 3) / TILE); cx++) {
      if (isSolid(getTile(cx * TILE + 1, mby))) {
        m.y = Math.floor(mby / TILE) * TILE - m.h;
        m.vy = 0;
        break;
      }
    }
    // Walls
    if (m.vx < 0 && isSolid(getTile(m.x, m.y + m.h / 2))) m.vx = 1.2;
    if (m.vx > 0 && isSolid(getTile(m.x + m.w, m.y + m.h / 2))) m.vx = -1.2;

    if (m.y > LEVEL_H * TILE) m.active = false;

    if (rectOverlap(p, m)) {
      m.active = false;
      if (!p.big) {
        p.big = true;
        p.h = 28;
        p.y -= 14;
      }
      score += 1000;
      SFX.powerup();
      addFloatingText(m.x, m.y - 10, '1000');
    }
  });

  // Update coin animations (from blocks)
  coinAnims.forEach(c => {
    c.y += c.vy;
    c.vy += 0.3;
    c.timer--;
  });
  coinAnims = coinAnims.filter(c => c.timer > 0);

  // Update particles
  particles.forEach(pt => {
    if (pt.type === 'brick') {
      pt.x += pt.vx;
      pt.y += pt.vy;
      pt.vy += 0.3;
      pt.timer--;
    } else if (pt.type === 'blockBounce') {
      pt.timer--;
    }
  });
  particles = particles.filter(pt => pt.timer > 0);

  // Update floating texts
  floatingTexts.forEach(ft => {
    ft.y -= 0.8;
    ft.timer--;
  });
  floatingTexts = floatingTexts.filter(ft => ft.timer > 0);

  // Camera
  const targetX = p.x - VIEW_W / 3;
  if (targetX > camera.x) camera.x = targetX;
  if (camera.x < 0) camera.x = 0;
  if (camera.x > LEVEL_W * TILE - VIEW_W) camera.x = LEVEL_W * TILE - VIEW_W;
}

function killPlayer() {
  if (player.invincible > 0) return;
  gameState = 'dying';
  player.vy = -8;
  player.deathTimer = 0;
  SFX.die();
}

  sky: '#5c94fc',
  ground: '#c84c0c',
  groundDark: '#a03800',
  groundLight: '#e09050',
  brick: '#c84c0c',
  brickDark: '#a03800',
  brickLine: '#6b420c',
  qblock: '#e09050',
  qblockDark: '#c84c0c',
  qblockLight: '#fcbcb0',
  used: '#8b7355',
  pipe: '#00a800',
  pipeDark: '#005800',
  pipeLight: '#80d010',
  marioRed: '#e00000',
  marioSkin: '#fca044',
  marioBrown: '#6b420c',
  marioBlue: '#0000e0',
  goomba: '#c84c0c',
  goombaDark: '#6b420c',
  goombaFeet: '#000',
  white: '#fcfcfc',
  black: '#000',
  coinGold: '#fcbcb0',
  coinDark: '#e09050',
  castle: '#c84c0c',
  castleDark: '#a03800',
  flagGreen: '#00a800',

};

function drawTile(tx, ty, t, screenX, screenY) {
  const x = screenX, y = screenY;
  switch(t) {
    case 1: // Ground
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.ground;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.groundLight;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, 2, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.groundDark;
      ctx.fillRect(x + TILE - 2, y, 2, TILE);
      ctx.fillRect(x, y + TILE - 2, TILE, 2);
      // Brick pattern
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.brickLine;
      ctx.fillRect(x + 7, y + 2, 1, 6);
      ctx.fillRect(x, y + 8, TILE, 1);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 3, y + 9, 1, 6);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 11, y + 9, 1, 6);
      break;
    case 2: // Brick
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.brick;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.brickLine;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y + 3, TILE, 1);
      ctx.fillRect(x, y + 7, TILE, 1);
      ctx.fillRect(x, y + 11, TILE, 1);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 7, y, 1, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 3, y + 4, 1, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 11, y + 4, 1, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 7, y + 8, 1, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 3, y + 12, 1, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 11, y + 12, 1, 3);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.groundLight;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, 1);
      break;
    case 3: case 4: // Question block
      const pulse = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.1) > 0;
      ctx.fillStyle = pulse ? COLORS.qblock : COLORS.qblockDark;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.qblockLight;
      ctx.fillRect(x + 1, y + 1, TILE - 2, 1);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 1, y + 1, 1, TILE - 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.qblockDark;
      ctx.fillRect(x + 1, y + TILE - 2, TILE - 2, 1);
      ctx.fillRect(x + TILE - 2, y + 1, 1, TILE - 2);
      // Question mark
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.groundDark;
      ctx.fillRect(x + 5, y + 3, 6, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 9, y + 5, 2, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 7, y + 7, 2, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 7, y + 11, 2, 2);
      break;
    case 5: // Used block
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.used;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#6b5b3a';
      ctx.fillRect(x + 1, y + 1, TILE - 2, 1);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 1, y + 1, 1, TILE - 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#5a4a2a';
      ctx.fillRect(x + 1, y + TILE - 2, TILE - 2, 1);
      ctx.fillRect(x + TILE - 2, y + 1, 1, TILE - 2);
      break;
    case 6: // Pipe top-left
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipe;
      ctx.fillRect(x - 2, y, TILE + 2, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipeLight;
      ctx.fillRect(x - 2, y, 3, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipeDark;
      ctx.fillRect(x + TILE - 1, y, 3, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipeLight;
      ctx.fillRect(x - 2, y, TILE + 4, 2);
      break;
    case 7: // Pipe top-right
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipe;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE + 2, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipeLight;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, 2, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipeDark;
      ctx.fillRect(x + TILE - 1, y, 3, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipeLight;
      ctx.fillRect(x - 2, y, TILE + 4, 2);
      break;
    case 8: // Pipe body-left
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipe;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipeLight;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, 3, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipeDark;
      ctx.fillRect(x + TILE - 2, y, 2, TILE);
      break;
    case 9: // Pipe body-right
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipe;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipeLight;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, 2, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.pipeDark;
      ctx.fillRect(x + TILE - 2, y, 2, TILE);
      break;
    case 10: // Flag pole
      ctx.fillStyle = '#80d010';
      ctx.fillRect(x + 7, y, 2, TILE);
      break;
    case 11: // Flag ball
      ctx.fillStyle = '#80d010';
      ctx.fillRect(x + 7, y + 4, 2, TILE - 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#00a800';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x + 8, y + 4, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      break;
    case 12: // Castle
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.castle;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.castleDark;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y + TILE - 1, TILE, 1);
      ctx.fillRect(x + TILE - 1, y, 1, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.groundLight;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, 1);
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, 1, TILE);
      // Window pattern
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.black;
      ctx.fillRect(x + 4, y + 4, 3, 4);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 10, y + 4, 3, 4);
      break;
    case 13: // Hard block (stairs)
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.ground;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.groundLight;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, 2, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.groundDark;
      ctx.fillRect(x + TILE - 2, y, 2, TILE);
      ctx.fillRect(x, y + TILE - 2, TILE, 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.brickLine;
      ctx.fillRect(x + 7, y + 2, 1, 5);
      ctx.fillRect(x, y + 7, TILE, 1);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 3, y + 8, 1, 6);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 11, y + 8, 1, 6);
      break;
  }
}

function drawMario(p, sx, sy) {
  if (p.invincible > 0 && Math.floor(p.invincible / 3) % 2 === 0) return;

  const f = p.facing;
  const big = p.big;
  const h = big ? 28 : 14;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(sx + p.w / 2, sy);
  ctx.scale(f, 1);
  ctx.translate(-p.w / 2, 0);

  if (gameState === 'dying') {
    // Death pose - X eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioRed;
    ctx.fillRect(1, 0, 10, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioSkin;
    ctx.fillRect(1, 4, 10, 5);
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.black;
    ctx.fillRect(3, 5, 2, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(7, 5, 2, 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioRed;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 9, 12, 5);
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }

  if (big) {
    // Big Mario
    const frame = p.animFrame;
    // Hat
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioRed;
    ctx.fillRect(2, 0, 8, 3);
    ctx.fillRect(1, 2, 11, 2);
    // Face
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioSkin;
    ctx.fillRect(1, 4, 10, 5);
    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.black;
    ctx.fillRect(7, 5, 2, 2);
    // Hair
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioBrown;
    ctx.fillRect(1, 4, 3, 3);
    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioRed;
    ctx.fillRect(1, 9, 10, 5);
    // Overalls
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioBlue;
    ctx.fillRect(2, 14, 8, 6);
    // Arms
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioSkin;
    if (frame === 5) { // jump
      ctx.fillRect(0, 8, 2, 4);
      ctx.fillRect(10, 8, 2, 4);
    } else if (frame === 1) {
      ctx.fillRect(0, 10, 2, 4);
      ctx.fillRect(10, 9, 2, 4);
    } else {
      ctx.fillRect(0, 10, 2, 4);
      ctx.fillRect(10, 10, 2, 4);
    }
    // Legs
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioBlue;
    if (frame === 5) { // jump
      ctx.fillRect(2, 20, 4, 5);
      ctx.fillRect(7, 20, 4, 5);
    } else if (frame === 1) {
      ctx.fillRect(1, 20, 4, 6);
      ctx.fillRect(8, 20, 4, 5);
    } else if (frame === 2) {
      ctx.fillRect(3, 20, 4, 5);
      ctx.fillRect(6, 20, 4, 6);
    } else {
      ctx.fillRect(2, 20, 4, 6);
      ctx.fillRect(7, 20, 4, 6);
    }
    // Shoes
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioBrown;
    if (frame === 5) {
      ctx.fillRect(1, 25, 5, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(7, 24, 5, 3);
    } else {
      ctx.fillRect(1, 26, 5, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(7, 26, 5, 2);
    }
  } else {
    // Small Mario
    const frame = p.animFrame;
    // Hat
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioRed;
    ctx.fillRect(2, 0, 8, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(1, 1, 10, 2);
    // Face
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioSkin;
    ctx.fillRect(1, 3, 10, 4);
    // Eye
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.black;
    ctx.fillRect(7, 4, 2, 2);
    // Hair
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioBrown;
    ctx.fillRect(1, 3, 3, 2);
    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioRed;
    ctx.fillRect(1, 7, 10, 3);
    // Overalls
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioBlue;
    ctx.fillRect(2, 10, 8, 2);
    // Legs & shoes
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioBrown;
    if (frame === 5) { // jump
      ctx.fillRect(1, 12, 4, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(7, 11, 4, 2);
    } else if (frame === 1) {
      ctx.fillRect(0, 12, 4, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(8, 12, 4, 2);
    } else if (frame === 2) {
      ctx.fillRect(3, 12, 4, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(5, 12, 4, 2);
    } else {
      ctx.fillRect(2, 12, 4, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(6, 12, 4, 2);
    }
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawGoomba(g, sx, sy) {
  if (!g.alive) {
    if (g.squishTimer > 0) {
      // Squished
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.goomba;
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy + 10, 14, 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.goombaDark;
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 2, sy + 10, 3, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 9, sy + 10, 3, 2);
    }
    return;
  }
  const walkFrame = Math.floor(g.animTimer / 10) % 2;
  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.goomba;
  ctx.fillRect(sx + 1, sy, 12, 8);
  ctx.fillRect(sx, sy + 2, 14, 6);
  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.white;
  ctx.fillRect(sx + 2, sy + 2, 4, 4);
  ctx.fillRect(sx + 8, sy + 2, 4, 4);
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.black;
  ctx.fillRect(sx + 4, sy + 3, 2, 3);
  ctx.fillRect(sx + 8, sy + 3, 2, 3);
  // Feet
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.goombaFeet;
  if (walkFrame === 0) {
    ctx.fillRect(sx, sy + 10, 5, 4);
    ctx.fillRect(sx + 9, sy + 11, 5, 3);
  } else {
    ctx.fillRect(sx, sy + 11, 5, 3);
    ctx.fillRect(sx + 9, sy + 10, 5, 4);
  }
}

function drawCoin(c, sx, sy) {
  const frame = Math.floor(c.animTimer / 8) % 4;
  const widths = [8, 5, 2, 5];
  const w = widths[frame];
  const ox = (8 - w) / 2;
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.coinGold;
  ctx.fillRect(sx + ox, sy, w, 12);
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.coinDark;
  ctx.fillRect(sx + ox + 1, sy + 1, Math.max(0, w - 2), 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.coinGold;
  ctx.fillRect(sx + ox + 2, sy + 3, Math.max(0, w - 4), 6);
}

function drawMushroom(m, sx, sy) {
  // Cap
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e00000';
  ctx.fillRect(sx + 1, sy, 12, 7);
  ctx.fillRect(sx, sy + 2, 14, 5);
  // Spots
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.white;
  ctx.fillRect(sx + 3, sy + 1, 3, 3);
  ctx.fillRect(sx + 8, sy + 1, 3, 3);
  ctx.fillRect(sx + 5, sy + 4, 4, 2);
  // Stem
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioSkin;
  ctx.fillRect(sx + 3, sy + 7, 8, 7);
  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.black;
  ctx.fillRect(sx + 4, sy + 8, 2, 2);
  ctx.fillRect(sx + 8, sy + 8, 2, 2);
}

function drawBackground() {
  // Sky
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.sky;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, VIEW_W, VIEW_H);

  const cx = camera.x;

  // Clouds
  const cloudPositions = [
    [8, 3, 1], [19, 2, 1], [36, 3, 2], [56, 2, 1], [67, 3, 1],
    [76, 2, 2], [95, 3, 1], [115, 2, 1], [130, 3, 2], [150, 2, 1],
    [165, 3, 1], [185, 2, 2], [200, 3, 1]
  ];
  cloudPositions.forEach(([tx, ty, size]) => {
    const x = tx * TILE - cx * 0.5;
    const y = ty * TILE;
    if (x < -60 || x > VIEW_W + 60) return;
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.cloudWhite;
    for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
      const bx = x + i * 14;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(bx + 8, y + 8, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(bx + 4, y + 12, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(bx + 12, y + 12, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  });

  // Hills
  const hillPositions = [[0, 3], [16, 1], [48, 2], [64, 1], [96, 3], [112, 1], [144, 2], [176, 1], [192, 2]];
  hillPositions.forEach(([tx, size]) => {
    const x = tx * TILE - cx * 0.7;
    const baseY = 13 * TILE;
    const h = size * 16 + 8;
    const w = size * 24 + 16;
    if (x < -w || x > VIEW_W + w) return;
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.hillGreen;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, baseY);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w / 2, baseY - h, x + w, baseY);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.hillDark;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + w * 0.3, baseY);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w / 2, baseY - h * 0.7, x + w * 0.7, baseY);
    ctx.fill();
  });

  // Bushes
  const bushPositions = [[11, 2], [23, 1], [41, 3], [59, 1], [71, 2], [89, 1], [107, 2], [123, 1], [141, 3], [163, 1], [183, 2]];
  bushPositions.forEach(([tx, size]) => {
    const x = tx * TILE - cx;
    const baseY = 13 * TILE;
    if (x < -50 || x > VIEW_W + 50) return;
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.bushGreen;
    for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x + i * 12 + 6, baseY - 4, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.bushLight;
    for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x + i * 12 + 6, baseY - 6, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  });
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.white;
  ctx.font = '8px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';

  ctx.fillText('MARIO', 16, 10);
  ctx.fillText(String(score).padStart(6, '0'), 16, 19);

  ctx.fillText('×' + String(coinCount).padStart(2, '0'), 120, 19);
  // Coin icon
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.coinGold;
  ctx.fillRect(112, 12, 6, 8);
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.coinDark;
  ctx.fillRect(114, 14, 2, 4);

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.white;
  ctx.fillText('WORLD', 176, 10);
  ctx.fillText(' ' + world, 180, 19);

  ctx.fillText('TIME', 248, 10);
  ctx.fillText(' ' + String(Math.max(0, time)).padStart(3, '0'), 252, 19);

  // Lives
  ctx.fillText('♥×' + lives, 320, 19);
}

function drawFlag() {
  const fx = 198 * TILE - camera.x;
  const fy = 4 * TILE;
  // Pole
  ctx.fillStyle = '#80d010';
  ctx.fillRect(fx + 7, fy + 8, 2, 9 * TILE);
  // Ball
  ctx.fillStyle = '#00a800';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(fx + 8, fy + 6, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Flag
  const flagY = gameState === 'flagSlide' ? Math.min(fy + 8 + flagSlideY, fy + 8 * TILE) : fy + 8;
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.flagGreen;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(fx + 7, flagY);
  ctx.lineTo(fx - 8, flagY + 8);
  ctx.lineTo(fx + 7, flagY + 16);
  ctx.fill();
  // Triangle pattern on flag
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.white;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(fx + 5, flagY + 3);
  ctx.lineTo(fx - 2, flagY + 8);
  ctx.lineTo(fx + 5, flagY + 13);
  ctx.fill();
}

function render() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, VIEW_W, VIEW_H);

  if (gameState === 'title') {
    drawBackground();
    // Title screen
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.ground;
    ctx.fillRect(60, 60, 280, 120);
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.groundLight;
    ctx.fillRect(62, 62, 276, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(62, 62, 2, 116);
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.groundDark;
    ctx.fillRect(62, 176, 276, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(336, 62, 2, 116);

    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.white;
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('SUPER MARIO BROS.', VIEW_W / 2, 100);

    ctx.font = '8px monospace';
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.qblockLight;
    ctx.fillText('© 2024 HTML5 TRIBUTE', VIEW_W / 2, 120);

    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.white;
    const blink = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.08) > 0;
    if (blink) ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE OR TAP TO START', VIEW_W / 2, 150);

    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioSkin;
    ctx.fillText('ARROWS/WASD: MOVE   SPACE: JUMP   SHIFT: RUN', VIEW_W / 2, 170);

    // Draw a little Mario
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(VIEW_W / 2 - 6, 130);
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioRed;
    ctx.fillRect(2, 0, 8, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(1, 1, 10, 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioSkin;
    ctx.fillRect(1, 3, 10, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.black;
    ctx.fillRect(7, 4, 2, 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioBrown;
    ctx.fillRect(1, 3, 3, 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioRed;
    ctx.fillRect(1, 7, 10, 3);
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioBlue;
    ctx.fillRect(2, 10, 8, 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.marioBrown;
    ctx.fillRect(2, 12, 4, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(6, 12, 4, 2);
    ctx.restore();

    return;
  }

  if (gameState === 'gameover') {
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.black;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, VIEW_W, VIEW_H);
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.white;
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', VIEW_W / 2, VIEW_H / 2 - 10);
    ctx.font = '8px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, VIEW_W / 2, VIEW_H / 2 + 15);
    if (stateTimer > 180) {
      const blink = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.08) > 0;
      if (blink) ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO CONTINUE', VIEW_W / 2, VIEW_H / 2 + 40);
    }
    return;
  }

  drawBackground();

  // Draw tiles
  const startTx = Math.floor(camera.x / TILE);
  const endTx = startTx + Math.ceil(VIEW_W / TILE) + 1;

  for (let ty = 0; ty < LEVEL_H; ty++) {
    for (let tx = startTx; tx <= endTx && tx < LEVEL_W; tx++) {
      const t = level[ty][tx];
      if (t === 0) continue;
      const sx = tx * TILE - camera.x;
      const sy = ty * TILE;

      // Check for bounce animation
      let bounceOffset = 0;
      particles.forEach(pt => {
        if (pt.type === 'blockBounce' && pt.x === tx * TILE && pt.origY === ty * TILE) {
          bounceOffset = -Math.sin((pt.timer / 8) * Math.PI) * 4;
        }
      });

      drawTile(tx, ty, t, sx, sy + bounceOffset);
    }
  }

  // Draw flag
  drawFlag();

  // Draw coins
  coins.forEach(c => {
    if (c.collected) return;
    const sx = c.x - camera.x;
    if (sx < -20 || sx > VIEW_W + 20) return;
    drawCoin(c, sx, c.y);
  });

  // Draw coin animations
  coinAnims.forEach(c => {
    const sx = c.x - camera.x;
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.coinGold;
    ctx.fillRect(sx, c.y, 8, 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.coinDark;
    ctx.fillRect(sx + 2, c.y + 2, 4, 6);
  });

  // Draw mushrooms
  mushrooms.forEach(m => {
    if (!m.active) return;
    const sx = m.x - camera.x;
    if (sx < -20 || sx > VIEW_W + 20) return;
    drawMushroom(m, sx, m.y);
  });

  // Draw goombas
  goombas.forEach(g => {
    const sx = g.x - camera.x;
    if (sx < -20 || sx > VIEW_W + 20) return;
    drawGoomba(g, sx, g.y);
  });

  // Draw particles
  particles.forEach(pt => {
    if (pt.type === 'brick') {
      const sx = pt.x - camera.x;
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.brick;
      ctx.fillRect(sx, pt.y, 6, 6);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.brickLine;
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 1, pt.y + 1, 4, 4);
    }
  });

  // Draw player
  if (gameState !== 'win' || stateTimer < 60) {
    const px = player.x - camera.x;
    drawMario(player, px, player.y);
  }

  // Draw floating texts
  ctx.font = '7px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  floatingTexts.forEach(ft => {
    const sx = ft.x - camera.x;
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.white;
    ctx.fillText(ft.text, sx + 8, ft.y);
  });

  // HUD
  drawHUD();

  // Win screen overlay
  if (gameState === 'win' && stateTimer > 60) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, VIEW_W, VIEW_H);
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.white;
    ctx.font = 'bold 14px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('COURSE CLEAR!', VIEW_W / 2, VIEW_H / 2 - 20);
    ctx.font = '8px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, VIEW_W / 2, VIEW_H / 2 + 5);
    ctx.fillText('COINS: ' + coinCount, VIEW_W / 2, VIEW_H / 2 + 20);
    if (stateTimer > 120) {
      const blink = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.08) > 0;
      if (blink) ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO PLAY AGAIN', VIEW_W / 2, VIEW_H / 2 + 45);
    }
  }
}

// --- GAME LOOP ---
function gameLoop() {
  update();
  render();
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

resetLevel();
gameLoop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

canvas.height = VIEW_H * SCALE;

const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
let audioCtx = null;
function ensureAudio() { if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new AudioCtx(); }

function playTone(freq, duration, type = 'square', vol = 0.08, slide = 0) {
  if (!audioCtx) return;
  const o = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  const g = audioCtx.createGain();
  o.type = type;
  o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
  if (slide) o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(freq + slide, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, audioCtx.currentTime);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
  o.connect(g); g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
  o.start(); o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
}

function playNoise(duration, vol = 0.06) {
  if (!audioCtx) return;
  const bufferSize = audioCtx.sampleRate * duration;
  const buffer = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, audioCtx.sampleRate);
  const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);
  for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) data[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
  const src = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
  src.buffer = buffer;
  const g = audioCtx.createGain();
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, audioCtx.currentTime);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
  src.connect(g); g.connect(audioCtx.destination);

function drawSprite(spr, pal, x, y, flip = false, alpha = 1) {
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  for (let r = 0; r < spr.length; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < spr[r].length; c++) {
      const ch = spr[r][c];
      if (ch !== '.' && pal[ch]) {
        ctx.fillStyle = pal[ch];
        const px = flip ? x + (spr[r].length - 1 - c) : x + c;
        ctx.fillRect(Math.round(px), Math.round(y + r), 1, 1);
      }
    }
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

const LEVEL_W = 224, LEVEL_H = 15;
const T = { EMPTY:0, GROUND:1, BRICK:2, QCOIN:3, QMUSH:4, QFLOWER:5, USED:6, SOLID:7,
            PIPE_TL:8, PIPE_TR:9, PIPE_BL:10, PIPE_BR:11, COIN:12, FLAG:13, FLAG_TOP:14,
            CASTLE:15, INVIS:16 };

let level = [];
function buildLevel() {
  level = Array.from({length: LEVEL_H}, () => new Array(LEVEL_W).fill(T.EMPTY));
  const set = (x, y, t) => { if (x >= 0 && x < LEVEL_W && y >= 0 && y < LEVEL_H) level[y][x] = t; };
  const ground = (x1, x2) => { for (let x = x1; x <= x2; x++) { set(x, 13, T.GROUND); set(x, 14, T.GROUND); } };
  const pipe = (x, h) => {
    set(x, 13 - h, T.PIPE_TL); set(x+1, 13 - h, T.PIPE_TR);
    for (let y = 13 - h + 1; y < 13; y++) { set(x, y, T.PIPE_BL); set(x+1, y, T.PIPE_BR); }
  };
  const stairs = (x, h, dir) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < h; i++) {
      const col = dir === 1 ? x + i : x - i;
      for (let y = 0; y <= i; y++) set(col, 12 - y, T.SOLID);
    }
  };

  // Ground segments
  ground(0, 68); ground(71, 85); ground(89, 152); ground(155, 223);

  // Question blocks & bricks (Section 1)
  set(16, 9, T.QCOIN);
  set(20, 9, T.BRICK); set(21, 9, T.QCOIN); set(22, 9, T.BRICK);
  set(23, 9, T.QMUSH); set(24, 9, T.BRICK);
  set(22, 5, T.QCOIN);

  // Pipes
  pipe(28, 2); pipe(38, 3); pipe(46, 4); pipe(57, 4);

  // Section 2
  set(77, 9, T.BRICK); set(78, 9, T.QMUSH); set(79, 9, T.BRICK);
  set(80, 5, T.BRICK); set(81, 5, T.BRICK); set(82, 5, T.BRICK);
  set(83, 5, T.BRICK); set(84, 5, T.BRICK); set(85, 5, T.BRICK);
  set(86, 5, T.BRICK); set(87, 5, T.BRICK);

  // Section 3
  set(91, 5, T.BRICK); set(92, 5, T.BRICK); set(93, 5, T.BRICK);
  set(94, 5, T.QCOIN);
  set(94, 9, T.BRICK);

  // Coins in the air
  for (let x = 100; x <= 104; x++) set(x, 8, T.COIN);

  // More pipes
  pipe(107, 2); pipe(112, 3); pipe(118, 2);

  // Section 4 - bricks and question blocks
  set(128, 9, T.BRICK); set(129, 9, T.BRICK);
  set(130, 9, T.QCOIN); set(131, 9, T.QCOIN);
  set(132, 9, T.BRICK); set(133, 9, T.BRICK);
  set(129, 5, T.QCOIN); set(130, 5, T.QCOIN); set(131, 5, T.QCOIN);

  // Invisible 1-up block
  set(135, 9, T.INVIS);

  // Section 5 - staircase area
  set(140, 9, T.QCOIN); set(141, 9, T.QCOIN);
  set(142, 9, T.QCOIN); set(143, 9, T.QCOIN);

  // Staircases
  stairs(148, 4, 1);
  stairs(155, 4, -1);
  stairs(158, 4, 1);
  stairs(165, 4, -1);
  stairs(168, 4, 1);
  stairs(175, 8, 1);
  stairs(181, 8, -1);

  // Final pipe
  pipe(185, 2);

  // Flag
  for (let y = 3; y < 13; y++) set(198, y, T.FLAG);
  set(198, 2, T.FLAG_TOP);

  // Castle (decorative)
  for (let y = 8; y < 13; y++) for (let x = 202; x <= 210; x++) set(x, y, T.CASTLE);
  for (let y = 5; y < 8; y++) for (let x = 204; x <= 208; x++) set(x, y, T.CASTLE);
  for (let x = 205; x <= 207; x++) set(x, 4, T.CASTLE);
  set(206, 3, T.CASTLE);
}
