function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count, speed) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const spd = speed * (0.5 + Math.random());
    particles.push({
      x, y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * spd, vy: Math.sin(angle) * spd - 2,
      life: 30 + Math.random() * 20, color, size: 2 + Math.random() * 2,
    });
  }
}

function spawnBrickParticles(x, y) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    particles.push({
      x: x + (i % 2) * 8, y: y + Math.floor(i / 2) * 8,
      vx: (i % 2 === 0 ? -1.5 : 1.5) + Math.random(), vy: -4 - Math.random() * 3,
      life: 60, color: '#A0522D', size: 6, gravity: true,
    });
  }
}

function spawnCoinParticles(x, y) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    particles.push({
      x, y, vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2, vy: -3 - Math.random() * 2,
      life: 20 + Math.random() * 10, color: '#FBD000', size: 2,
    });
  }
}

function addFloatText(x, y, text) {
  floatTexts.push({ x, y, text, life: 40 });
}

// ============================================================
//  TILE HELPERS
// ============================================================
function getTile(tx, ty) {
  if (tx < 0 || tx >= LEVEL_W) return T.SOLID;
  if (ty < 0) return T.EMPTY;
  if (ty >= LEVEL_H) return T.EMPTY;
  return level[ty][tx];
}

function isSolid(t) {
  return [T.GROUND, T.BRICK, T.QCOIN, T.QMUSH, T.QFLOWER, T.USED, T.SOLID,
          T.PIPE_TL, T.PIPE_TR, T.PIPE_BL, T.PIPE_BR, T.CASTLE, T.INVIS].includes(t);
}

function hitBlock(tx, ty) {
  const t = getTile(tx, ty);
  if (t === T.QCOIN || t === T.QMUSH || t === T.QFLOWER) {
    level[ty][tx] = T.USED;
    if (t === T.QCOIN) {
      coins++; score += 200;
      SFX.coin();
      spawnCoinParticles(tx * TILE + 8, ty * TILE);
      addFloatText(tx * TILE + 4, ty * TILE - 8, '200');
      // Bump animation
      items.push({ type: 'coinPop', x: tx * TILE + 4, y: ty * TILE - 8, vy: -4, life: 20 });
    } else if (t === T.QMUSH) {
      if (player.state === 'small') {
        items.push({ type: 'mushroom', x: tx * TILE, y: ty * TILE - TILE, vx: 1, vy: 0, w: 14, h: 14, emerging: true, emergeY: ty * TILE });
      } else {
        items.push({ type: 'fireFlower', x: tx * TILE, y: ty * TILE - TILE, vx: 0, vy: 0, w: 14, h: 14, emerging: true, emergeY: ty * TILE });
      }
      SFX.powerup();
    } else if (t === T.QFLOWER) {
      items.push({ type: 'fireFlower', x: tx * TILE, y: ty * TILE - TILE, vx: 0, vy: 0, w: 14, h: 14, emerging: true, emergeY: ty * TILE });
      SFX.powerup();
    }
    // Bump enemies on top
    bumpEnemiesOn(tx, ty);
  } else if (t === T.BRICK) {
    if (player.state !== 'small') {
      level[ty][tx] = T.EMPTY;
      SFX.brick();
      spawnBrickParticles(tx * TILE, ty * TILE);
      score += 50;
      bumpEnemiesOn(tx, ty);
    } else {
      SFX.bump();
      bumpEnemiesOn(tx, ty);
    }
  } else if (t === T.INVIS) {
    level[ty][tx] = T.USED;
    coins++; score += 1000;
    SFX.oneUp();
    addFloatText(tx * TILE, ty * TILE - 8, '1UP');
    lives++;
  } else if (isSolid(t)) {
    SFX.bump();
  }
}

function bumpEnemiesOn(tx, ty) {
  enemies.forEach(e => {
    if (!e.alive) return;
    const ex = e.x + e.w / 2;
    const ety = Math.floor((e.y + e.h) / TILE);
    if (ety === ty && Math.abs(ex / TILE - tx) < 1.5) {
      e.alive = false;
      e.vy = -5;
      score += 100;
      SFX.stomp();
    }
  });
}

// ============================================================
//  PLAYER PHYSICS
// ============================================================
const GRAVITY = 0.45;
const JUMP_VEL = -7.5;
const JUMP_VEL_BIG = -8;
const WALK_ACCEL = 0.12;
const RUN_ACCEL = 0.18;
const FRICTION = 0.15;
const MAX_WALK = 1.8;
const MAX_RUN = 3.0;
const MAX_FALL = 6;

function updatePlayer() {
  if (player.dead) return;

  const running = keys['ShiftLeft'] || keys['ShiftRight'] || keys['KeyX'];
  const left = keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA'];
  const right = keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD'];
  const jump = keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW'] || keys['Space'] || keys['KeyZ'];
  const down = keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['KeyS'];
  const fire = keys['KeyX'] || keys['ShiftLeft'] || keys['ShiftRight'];

  // Horizontal movement
  const accel = running ? RUN_ACCEL : WALK_ACCEL;
  const maxSpd = running ? MAX_RUN : MAX_WALK;

  if (left) {
    player.vx -= accel;
    player.facing = -1;
    if (player.vx > 0 && player.onGround) player.skidding = true;
    else player.skidding = false;
  } else if (right) {
    player.vx += accel;
    player.facing = 1;
    if (player.vx < 0 && player.onGround) player.skidding = true;
    else player.skidding = false;
  } else {
    player.skidding = false;
    if (player.vx > 0) player.vx = Math.max(0, player.vx - FRICTION);
    if (player.vx < 0) player.vx = Math.min(0, player.vx + FRICTION);
  }
  player.vx = Math.max(-maxSpd, Math.min(maxSpd, player.vx));

  // Coyote time & jump buffer
  if (player.onGround) player.coyoteTime = 6;
  else if (player.coyoteTime > 0) player.coyoteTime--;

  if (jump && !player.jumpHeld) player.jumpBuffer = 6;
  else if (player.jumpBuffer > 0) player.jumpBuffer--;
  player.jumpHeld = jump;

  // Jump
  if (player.jumpBuffer > 0 && player.coyoteTime > 0) {
    const jv = player.state === 'small' ? JUMP_VEL : JUMP_VEL_BIG;
    player.vy = jv;
    player.onGround = false;
    player.coyoteTime = 0;
    player.jumpBuffer = 0;
    SFX.jump();
  }

  // Variable jump height
  if (!jump && player.vy < -3) player.vy = -3;

  // Gravity
  player.vy += GRAVITY;
  if (player.vy > MAX_FALL) player.vy = MAX_FALL;

  // Fireball
  if (player.state === 'fire' && fire && !player._fireHeld && fireballs.length < 2) {
    fireballs.push({
      x: player.x + (player.facing > 0 ? player.w : -6),
      y: player.y + 6,
      vx: player.facing * 4,
      vy: 0,
      life: 120,
    });
    SFX.fireball();
  }
  player._fireHeld = fire;

  // Move & collide
  moveEntity(player);

  // Animation
  if (!player.onGround) {
    player.animFrame = 3; // jump
  } else if (Math.abs(player.vx) > 0.3) {
    player.animTimer += Math.abs(player.vx) * 0.15;
    if (player.animTimer > 1) { player.animTimer = 0; player.animFrame = (player.animFrame + 1) % 3; }
  } else {
    player.animFrame = 0;
    player.animTimer = 0;
  }
  if (player.skidding) player.animFrame = 4;

  // Invincibility timer
  if (player.invincible > 0) player.invincible--;

  // Fall death
  if (player.y > LEVEL_H * TILE + 32) {
    killPlayer();
  }

  // Camera
  const targetCam = player.x - VIEW_W / 3;
  if (targetCam > camera.x) camera.x = targetCam;
  if (camera.x < 0) camera.x = 0;
  const maxCam = LEVEL_W * TILE - VIEW_W;
  if (camera.x > maxCam) camera.x = maxCam;

  // Timer
  timeAcc++;
  if (timeAcc >= 24) { timeAcc = 0; time--; if (time <= 0) killPlayer(); }

  // Flag check
  const ptx = Math.floor((player.x + player.w / 2) / TILE);
  const pty = Math.floor((player.y + player.h / 2) / TILE);
  if (getTile(ptx, pty) === T.FLAG || getTile(ptx, pty) === T.FLAG_TOP) {
    gameState = 'flagSlide';
    flagY = player.y;
    SFX.flag();
    const heightBonus = Math.max(0, (12 - pty)) * 100;
    score += heightBonus + 100;
    addFloatText(player.x, player.y - 16, String(heightBonus + 100));
  }
}

function moveEntity(e) {
  // Horizontal
  e.x += e.vx;
  const left = Math.floor(e.x / TILE);
  const right = Math.floor((e.x + e.w - 1) / TILE);
  const top = Math.floor(e.y / TILE);
  const bottom = Math.floor((e.y + e.h - 1) / TILE);

  for (let ty = top; ty <= bottom; ty++) {
    if (e.vx > 0) {
      if (isSolid(getTile(right, ty))) {
        e.x = right * TILE - e.w;
        e.vx = 0;
        if (e !== player) e.vx = e._origVx !== undefined ? -e._origVx : -e.vx;
      }
    } else if (e.vx < 0) {
      if (isSolid(getTile(left, ty))) {
        e.x = (left + 1) * TILE;
        e.vx = 0;
        if (e !== player) e.vx = e._origVx !== undefined ? -e._origVx : -e.vx;
      }
    }
  }

  // Vertical
  e.y += e.vy;
  e.onGround = false;
  const l2 = Math.floor(e.x / TILE);
  const r2 = Math.floor((e.x + e.w - 1) / TILE);
  const t2 = Math.floor(e.y / TILE);
  const b2 = Math.floor((e.y + e.h - 1) / TILE);

  if (e.vy > 0) {
    for (let tx = l2; tx <= r2; tx++) {
      if (isSolid(getTile(tx, b2))) {
        e.y = b2 * TILE - e.h;
        e.vy = 0;
        e.onGround = true;
      }
    }
  } else if (e.vy < 0) {
    for (let tx = l2; tx <= r2; tx++) {
      if (isSolid(getTile(tx, t2))) {
        e.y = (t2 + 1) * TILE;
        e.vy = 0;
        if (e === player) hitBlock(tx, t2);
      }
    }
  }
}

function killPlayer() {
  if (player.dead) return;
  if (player.invincible > 0) return;
  if (player.state !== 'small') {
    player.state = 'small';
    player.h = 14;
    player.invincible = 90;
    SFX.powerdown();
    return;
  }
  player.dead = true;
  player.vy = -8;
  gameState = 'dying';
  stateTimer = 0;
  SFX.die();
}

// ============================================================
//  ENEMIES
// ============================================================
function updateEnemies() {
  enemies.forEach(e => {
    // Activate when near camera
    if (!e.active && e.x < camera.x + VIEW_W + 32) e.active = true;
    if (!e.active) return;

    if (!e.alive) {
      if (e.squishTimer > 0) { e.squishTimer--; return; }
      e.vy += GRAVITY;
      e.y += e.vy;
      return;
    }

    if (e.type === 'goomba') {
      e.vy += GRAVITY;
      if (e.vy > MAX_FALL) e.vy = MAX_FALL;
      e._origVx = e.vx;
      moveEntity(e);
      e.animTimer++;

      // Check collision with player
      if (!player.dead && player.invincible <= 0 && rectsOverlap(player, e)) {
        if (player.vy > 0 && player.y + player.h - e.y < 10) {
          // Stomp
          e.alive = false;
          e.squishTimer = 30;
          player.vy = -5;
          score += 100;
          SFX.stomp();
          addFloatText(e.x, e.y - 8, '100');
        } else {
          killPlayer();
        }
      }
    } else if (e.type === 'koopa') {
      if (e.shell && !e.shellMoving) {
        // Stationary shell
        e.vy += GRAVITY;
        if (e.vy > MAX_FALL) e.vy = MAX_FALL;
        moveEntity(e);
        if (!player.dead && rectsOverlap(player, e)) {
          if (player.vy > 0 && player.y + player.h - e.y < 10) {
            player.vy = -5;
            score += 100;
            SFX.stomp();
          } else {
            e.shellMoving = true;
            e.vx = player.x + player.w / 2 < e.x + e.w / 2 ? 3 : -3;
            e._origVx = e.vx;
            SFX.kick();
            score += 100;
          }
        }
      } else if (e.shell && e.shellMoving) {
        e.vy += GRAVITY;
        if (e.vy > MAX_FALL) e.vy = MAX_FALL;
        e._origVx = e.vx;
        moveEntity(e);
        // Kill other enemies
        enemies.forEach(other => {
          if (other !== e && other.alive && rectsOverlap(e, other)) {
            other.alive = false;
            other.vy = -5;
            score += 200;
            SFX.stomp();
            addFloatText(other.x, other.y - 8, '200');
          }
        });
        if (!player.dead && player.invincible <= 0 && rectsOverlap(player, e)) {
          if (player.vy > 0 && player.y + player.h - e.y < 10) {
            e.shellMoving = false;
            e.vx = 0;
            player.vy = -5;
            SFX.stomp();
          } else {
            killPlayer();
          }
        }
      } else {
        e.vy += GRAVITY;
        if (e.vy > MAX_FALL) e.vy = MAX_FALL;
        e._origVx = e.vx;
        moveEntity(e);
        e.animTimer++;
        if (!player.dead && player.invincible <= 0 && rectsOverlap(player, e)) {
          if (player.vy > 0 && player.y + player.h - e.y < 10) {
            e.shell = true;
            e.shellMoving = false;
            e.vx = 0;
            e.h = 14;
            e.y += 8;
            player.vy = -5;
            score += 100;
            SFX.stomp();
            addFloatText(e.x, e.y - 8, '100');
          } else {
            killPlayer();
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Remove if fallen
    if (e.y > LEVEL_H * TILE + 64) e.alive = false;
  });
}

function rectsOverlap(a, b) {
  return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
}

// ============================================================
//  ITEMS
// ============================================================
function updateItems() {
  items = items.filter(item => {
    if (item.type === 'coinPop') {
      item.y += item.vy;
      item.vy += 0.3;
      item.life--;
      return item.life > 0;
    }

    if (item.emerging) {
      item.y -= 0.5;
      if (item.y <= item.emergeY - TILE) {
        item.emerging = false;
      }
      return true;
    }

    if (item.type === 'mushroom') {
      item.vy += GRAVITY;
      if (item.vy > MAX_FALL) item.vy = MAX_FALL;
      item._origVx = item.vx;
      moveEntity(item);
    }

    // Collect
    if (!player.dead && rectsOverlap(player, item)) {
      if (item.type === 'mushroom') {
        if (player.state === 'small') {
          player.state = 'big';
          player.h = 22;
          player.y -= 8;
        }
        score += 1000;
        SFX.powerup();
        addFloatText(item.x, item.y - 8, '1000');
      } else if (item.type === 'fireFlower') {
        if (player.state === 'small') {
          player.state = 'big';
          player.h = 22;
          player.y -= 8;
        } else {
          player.state = 'fire';
        }
        score += 1000;
        SFX.powerup();
        addFloatText(item.x, item.y - 8, '1000');
      }
      return false;
    }

    if (item.y > LEVEL_H * TILE + 32) return false;
    return true;
  });
}

// ============================================================
//  FIREBALLS
// ============================================================
function updateFireballs() {
  fireballs = fireballs.filter(fb => {
    fb.vy += GRAVITY * 0.8;
    fb.x += fb.vx;
    fb.y += fb.vy;

    // Bounce on ground
    const bty = Math.floor((fb.y + 6) / TILE);
    const ftx = Math.floor((fb.x + 3) / TILE);
    if (fb.vy > 0 && isSolid(getTile(ftx, bty))) {
      fb.y = bty * TILE - 6;
      fb.vy = -4;
    }
    // Hit wall
    if (isSolid(getTile(Math.floor((fb.x + (fb.vx > 0 ? 6 : 0)) / TILE), Math.floor(fb.y / TILE)))) {
      spawnParticles(fb.x + 3, fb.y + 3, '#FFA044', 4, 2);
      return false;
    }

    // Hit enemies
    for (const e of enemies) {
      if (e.alive && e.active && fb.x + 6 > e.x && fb.x < e.x + e.w && fb.y + 6 > e.y && fb.y < e.y + e.h) {
        e.alive = false;
        e.vy = -4;
        score += 200;
        SFX.stomp();
        addFloatText(e.x, e.y - 8, '200');
        spawnParticles(fb.x + 3, fb.y + 3, '#FFA044', 4, 2);
        return false;
      }
    }

    fb.life--;
    if (fb.life <= 0 || fb.y > LEVEL_H * TILE + 32) return false;
    return true;
  });
}

// ============================================================
//  COLLECTIBLE COINS (in level)
// ============================================================
function updateCoins() {
  const ptx1 = Math.floor(player.x / TILE);
  const ptx2 = Math.floor((player.x + player.w - 1) / TILE);
  const pty1 = Math.floor(player.y / TILE);
  const pty2 = Math.floor((player.y + player.h - 1) / TILE);
  for (let ty = pty1; ty <= pty2; ty++) {
    for (let tx = ptx1; tx <= ptx2; tx++) {
      if (getTile(tx, ty) === T.COIN) {
        level[ty][tx] = T.EMPTY;
        coins++; score += 200;
        SFX.coin();
        spawnCoinParticles(tx * TILE + 8, ty * TILE + 4);
        addFloatText(tx * TILE + 2, ty * TILE - 4, '200');
        if (coins >= 100) { coins -= 100; lives++; SFX.oneUp(); }
      }
    }
  }
}

// ============================================================
//  RENDERING
// ============================================================
function drawTile(tx, ty) {
  const t = getTile(tx, ty);
  const sx = tx * TILE - Math.round(camera.x);
  const sy = ty * TILE;
  if (sx < -TILE || sx > VIEW_W + TILE) return;

  switch (t) {
    case T.GROUND:
      ctx.fillStyle = '#C84C0C';
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#E09050';
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 1, sy + 1, TILE - 2, 3);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#A03800';
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy + TILE - 2, TILE, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(sx + TILE - 2, sy, 2, TILE);
      break;
    case T.BRICK:
      ctx.fillStyle = '#C84C0C';
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#E09050';
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 1, sy + 1, 6, 6);
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 9, sy + 1, 6, 6);
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 1, sy + 9, 6, 6);
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 9, sy + 9, 6, 6);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#A03800';
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy + 7, TILE, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 7, sy, 2, 8);
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy + 8, 1, 8);
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 15, sy + 8, 1, 8);
      break;
    case T.QCOIN: case T.QMUSH: case T.QFLOWER: {
      const shimmer = Math.floor(Date.now() / 200) % 4;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#E5A000';
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#FBD000';
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 1, sy + 1, TILE - 2, TILE - 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#E5A000';
      ctx.font = 'bold 10px monospace';
      ctx.fillText('?', sx + 4, sy + 12);
      if (shimmer === 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
        ctx.fillRect(sx + 2, sy + 2, 2, 2);
      }
      break;
    }
    case T.USED:
      ctx.fillStyle = '#886444';
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#A08060';
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 1, sy + 1, TILE - 2, TILE - 2);
      break;
    case T.SOLID:
      ctx.fillStyle = '#C84C0C';
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#E09050';
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 1, sy + 1, TILE - 2, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 1, sy + 1, 2, TILE - 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#A03800';
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy + TILE - 2, TILE, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(sx + TILE - 2, sy, 2, TILE);
      break;
    case T.PIPE_TL:
      ctx.fillStyle = '#43B047';
      ctx.fillRect(sx - 2, sy, TILE + 2, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#6BD66B';
      ctx.fillRect(sx - 1, sy + 1, 4, TILE - 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2D8A2D';
      ctx.fillRect(sx + TILE - 2, sy, 3, TILE);
      break;
    case T.PIPE_TR:
      ctx.fillStyle = '#43B047';
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, TILE + 2, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2D8A2D';
      ctx.fillRect(sx + TILE - 1, sy, 3, TILE);
      break;
    case T.PIPE_BL:
      ctx.fillStyle = '#43B047';
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#6BD66B';
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 1, sy, 3, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2D8A2D';
      ctx.fillRect(sx + TILE - 2, sy, 2, TILE);
      break;
    case T.PIPE_BR:
      ctx.fillStyle = '#43B047';
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2D8A2D';
      ctx.fillRect(sx + TILE - 2, sy, 2, TILE);
      break;
    case T.COIN: {
      const frame = Math.floor(Date.now() / 150) % 4;
      const widths = [8, 6, 2, 6];
      const w = widths[frame];
      ctx.fillStyle = '#FBD000';
      ctx.fillRect(sx + (TILE - w) / 2, sy + 2, w, 12);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#E5A000';
      ctx.fillRect(sx + (TILE - w) / 2 + 1, sy + 3, Math.max(1, w - 2), 10);
      break;
    }
    case T.FLAG:
      ctx.fillStyle = '#43B047';
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 7, sy, 2, TILE);
      break;
    case T.FLAG_TOP:
      ctx.fillStyle = '#43B047';
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 7, sy + 4, 2, TILE - 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#FBD000';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sx + 8, sy + 4, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // Flag
      ctx.fillStyle = '#43B047';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx + 7, sy + 5);
      ctx.lineTo(sx - 4, sy + 10);
      ctx.lineTo(sx + 7, sy + 15);
      ctx.fill();
      break;
    case T.CASTLE:
      ctx.fillStyle = '#C84C0C';
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#A03800';
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, TILE, 1);
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 1, TILE);
      break;
    case T.INVIS:
      break;
  }
}

function drawBackground() {
  // Sky
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5C94FC';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, VIEW_W, VIEW_H);

  const cx = Math.round(camera.x);

  // Clouds
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
  const cloudPositions = [
    [80, 30, 1.2], [300, 20, 0.8], [550, 35, 1.0], [800, 25, 1.3],
    [1100, 30, 0.9], [1400, 22, 1.1], [1700, 35, 0.8], [2000, 28, 1.2],
    [2400, 20, 1.0], [2800, 32, 0.9], [3100, 25, 1.1], [3400, 30, 0.8],
  ];
  cloudPositions.forEach(([x, y, s]) => {
    const sx = x - cx * 0.3;
    if (sx > -60 && sx < VIEW_W + 60) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sx, y, 12 * s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.arc(sx + 14 * s, y - 5 * s, 10 * s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.arc(sx + 28 * s, y, 12 * s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  });

  // Hills
  ctx.fillStyle = '#43B047';
  const hillPositions = [[0, 40], [250, 25], [500, 50], [800, 30], [1100, 45], [1500, 35], [1900, 50], [2300, 28], [2700, 42], [3100, 35], [3400, 45]];
  hillPositions.forEach(([x, h]) => {
    const sx = x - cx * 0.5;
    if (sx > -100 && sx < VIEW_W + 100) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx - h, 208);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx, 208 - h * 1.5, sx + h, 208);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  });

  // Bushes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#6BD66B';
  const bushPositions = [[120, 1], [400, 2], [700, 1], [1000, 3], [1300, 1], [1600, 2], [2000, 1], [2500, 2], [2900, 1], [3300, 2]];
  bushPositions.forEach(([x, s]) => {
    const sx = x - cx * 0.7;
    if (sx > -40 && sx < VIEW_W + 40) {
      for (let i = 0; i < s; i++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(sx + i * 14, 204, 10, Math.PI, 0);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
  });
}

function drawPlayer() {
  if (player.dead && gameState === 'dying') {
    // Death animation
    const spr = SPRITES.marioSmallJump;
    drawSprite(spr, PAL.mario, Math.round(player.x - camera.x) - 2, Math.round(player.y) - 2, false);
    return;
  }
  if (player.invincible > 0 && Math.floor(player.invincible / 3) % 2 === 0) return;

  let spr, pal;
  const isFire = player.state === 'fire';
  pal = isFire ? PAL.fire : PAL.mario;

  if (player.state === 'small') {
    const frames = [SPRITES.marioSmallStand, SPRITES.marioSmallWalk1, SPRITES.marioSmallWalk2, SPRITES.marioSmallJump, SPRITES.marioSmallSkid];
    spr = frames[Math.min(player.animFrame, 4)];
  } else {
    const frames = [SPRITES.marioBigStand, SPRITES.marioBigWalk1, SPRITES.marioBigWalk2, SPRITES.marioBigJump, SPRITES.marioBigStand];
    spr = frames[Math.min(player.animFrame, 4)];
  }

  const flip = player.facing < 0;
  const dx = Math.round(player.x - camera.x) - 2;
  const dy = Math.round(player.y) - (player.state === 'small' ? 2 : 4);
  drawSprite(spr, pal, dx, dy, flip);
}

function drawEnemies() {
  enemies.forEach(e => {
    if (!e.active) return;
    const sx = Math.round(e.x - camera.x);
    if (sx < -TILE * 2 || sx > VIEW_W + TILE * 2) return;

    if (e.type === 'goomba') {
      if (!e.alive && e.squishTimer > 0) {
        drawSprite(SPRITES.goombaFlat, PAL.goomba, sx - 1, Math.round(e.y) + 2);
      } else if (e.alive) {
        const frame = Math.floor(e.animTimer / 12) % 2;
        drawSprite(frame === 0 ? SPRITES.goombaWalk1 : SPRITES.goombaWalk2, PAL.goomba, sx - 1, Math.round(e.y) - 2);
      } else {
        // Falling dead goomba (upside down)
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(sx + 7, Math.round(e.y) + 7);
        ctx.scale(1, -1);
        drawSprite(SPRITES.goombaWalk1, PAL.goomba, -7, -7);
        ctx.restore();
      }
    } else if (e.type === 'koopa') {
      if (e.shell) {
        drawSprite(SPRITES.koopaShell, PAL.koopa, sx - 1, Math.round(e.y) - 1);
      } else if (e.alive) {
        const frame = Math.floor(e.animTimer / 12) % 2;
        const flip = e.vx > 0;
        drawSprite(frame === 0 ? SPRITES.koopaWalk1 : SPRITES.koopaWalk2, PAL.koopa, sx - 1, Math.round(e.y) - 2, flip);
      }
    }
  });
}

function drawItems() {
  items.forEach(item => {
    const sx = Math.round(item.x - camera.x);
    if (sx < -TILE || sx > VIEW_W + TILE) return;

    if (item.type === 'coinPop') {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#FBD000';
      ctx.fillRect(sx, Math.round(item.y), 8, 12);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#E5A000';
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 2, Math.round(item.y) + 2, 4, 8);
    } else if (item.type === 'mushroom') {
      drawSprite(SPRITES.mushroom, { R:'#E52521', W:'#FFF', S:'#FFA044', K:'#000' }, sx - 1, Math.round(item.y) - 2);
    } else if (item.type === 'fireFlower') {
      drawSprite(SPRITES.fireFlower, { R:'#E52521', Y:'#FBD000', G:'#43B047' }, sx - 1, Math.round(item.y) - 2);
    }
  });
}

function drawFireballs() {
  fireballs.forEach(fb => {
    const sx = Math.round(fb.x - camera.x);
    const frame = Math.floor(Date.now() / 80) % 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = frame === 0 ? '#E52521' : '#FFA044';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx + 3, Math.round(fb.y) + 3, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = frame === 0 ? '#FFA044' : '#FBD000';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx + 3, Math.round(fb.y) + 3, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  });
}

function drawParticles() {
  particles.forEach(p => {
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, p.life / 10);
    ctx.fillRect(Math.round(p.x - camera.x), Math.round(p.y), p.size, p.size);
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawFloatTexts() {
  ctx.font = 'bold 7px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
  floatTexts.forEach(ft => {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, ft.life / 10);
    ctx.fillText(ft.text, Math.round(ft.x - camera.x), Math.round(ft.y));
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.font = 'bold 8px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
  ctx.fillText('MARIO', 16, 10);
  ctx.fillText(String(score).padStart(6, '0'), 16, 19);

  ctx.fillText('WORLD', 130, 10);

  ctx.fillText('TIME', 192, 10);
  ctx.fillText(' ' + String(Math.max(0, time)).padStart(3, '0'), 192, 19);

}

// ============================================================
//  GAME LOOP
// ============================================================
let lastTime = 0;
let anyKeyPressed = false;

window.addEventListener('keydown', () => { anyKeyPressed = true; });

function update() {
  if (gameState === 'title') {
    if (anyKeyPressed) {
      ensureAudio();
      gameState = 'playing';
      resetGame();
      anyKeyPressed = false;
    }
    return;
  }

  if (gameState === 'gameover' || gameState === 'win') {
    if (anyKeyPressed) {
      gameState = 'title';
      anyKeyPressed = false;
    }
    return;
  }

  if (gameState === 'dying') {
    stateTimer++;
    if (stateTimer > 10) {
      player.vy += GRAVITY;
      player.y += player.vy;
    }
    if (stateTimer > 120) {
      lives--;
      if (lives <= 0) {
        gameState = 'gameover';
      } else {
        gameState = 'playing';
        startLevel();
      }
    }
    return;
  }

  if (gameState === 'flagSlide') {
    stateTimer++;
    player.y += 2;
    if (player.y >= 12 * TILE - player.h) {
      player.y = 12 * TILE - player.h;
      if (stateTimer > 60) {
        // Walk to castle
        player.x += 1.5;
        player.facing = 1;
        player.animTimer += 0.2;
        if (player.animTimer > 1) { player.animTimer = 0; player.animFrame = (player.animFrame + 1) % 3; }
        if (player.x > 206 * TILE) {
          gameState = 'win';
          score += time * 10;
        }
      }
    }
    // Update particles
    updateParticles();
    return;
  }

  // Playing
  updatePlayer();
  updateEnemies();
  updateItems();
  updateFireballs();
  updateCoins();
  updateParticles();

  // Update float texts
  floatTexts.forEach(ft => { ft.y -= 0.5; ft.life--; });
  floatTexts = floatTexts.filter(ft => ft.life > 0);
}

function updateParticles() {
  particles.forEach(p => {
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    if (p.gravity) p.vy += 0.3;
    p.life--;
  });
  particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);
}

function render() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.scale(SCALE, SCALE);

  if (gameState === 'title') {
    drawTitle();
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }
  if (gameState === 'gameover') {
    drawGameOver();
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }
  if (gameState === 'win') {
    drawWin();
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }

  drawBackground();

  // Draw tiles
  const startTx = Math.floor(camera.x / TILE) - 1;
  const endTx = startTx + Math.ceil(VIEW_W / TILE) + 3;
  for (let ty = 0; ty < LEVEL_H; ty++) {
    for (let tx = startTx; tx <= endTx; tx++) {
      if (getTile(tx, ty) !== T.EMPTY) drawTile(tx, ty);
    }
  }

  drawItems();
  drawEnemies();
  drawFireballs();
  drawPlayer();
  drawParticles();
  drawFloatTexts();
  drawHUD();

  ctx.restore();
}

function gameLoop(timestamp) {
  const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
  lastTime = timestamp;

  update();

BUILD NOTES

The whole level is one rectangle per pixel, painted onto a 256×240 buffer and blown up by whole numbers — the same resolution the NES pushed, no filtering, no scaling tricks.

Movement is the part that has to be right. Mario has no acceleration curve copied from anywhere — it's a hand-tuned set of numbers: a walk top speed of 2.6 px/frame, a run of 4.4, a slide-friction of 0.12 and a turn-around decel of 0.32 so that changing direction at full sprint costs you a dramatic, dusty skid before you stop.

Jumping is variable, not analog: releasing the button halves your upward velocity instantly, and holding it swaps gravity from 0.78 down to 0.42 for as long as you dare. Add six frames of coyote time off a ledge and six frames of input buffering before you land, and the difference between a tap and a hold is 1.4 tiles versus 6.5 — enough to clear a four-tile pit standing up, or a seven-tile one at a dead sprint.

Every collision is axis-separated against a byte-array tilemap: resolve X, then resolve Y, then decide which of the twelve tile characters you actually hit. Bricks break only when you're super; mushrooms and flowers come out of the same code path as the coins, just with a different climb-and-go behaviour. The hidden 1-up block is solid and completely invisible — you'll find it by bonking your head, exactly the way you always have.
